decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyConnected.of_geometricallyIrreducible
decls.doc:
A geometrically irreducible morphism is geometrically connected. Kept `private` as an
implementation helper for `AbelianVariety.geometricallyConnected`; it is not part of the
abelian-variety public interface.
decls.statement:
lemma GeometricallyConnected.of_geometricallyIrreducible {X S : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ S}
    [GeometricallyIrreducible f] : GeometricallyConnected f

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety
decls.doc:
An **abelian variety** over a field `K`: a proper geometrically integral group scheme over
`Spec K`.

The group-object structure lives on `toOver : Over (Spec (.of K))`; the underlying scheme is
`toScheme = toOver.left`. The fields are the standing hypotheses of the theory: `grpObj` is the
group law, `isProper` says the structure morphism to `Spec K` is proper, and
`geometricallyIntegral` records the geometric hypothesis from which smoothness, geometric
connectedness, absolute integrality, and commutativity are derived.
decls.statement: structure AbelianVariety (K : Type u) [Field K]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.toScheme
decls.doc: The underlying scheme of an abelian variety.
decls.statement: abbrev toScheme (A : AbelianVariety K) : Scheme.{u}

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.dim
decls.doc:
The dimension of an abelian variety, defined as the topological Krull dimension of its
underlying scheme.
decls.statement: abbrev dim (A : AbelianVariety K) : WithBot ℕ∞

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.dim_def
decls.statement:
lemma dim_def (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    A.dim = topologicalKrullDim A.toScheme

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.smooth
decls.doc: An abelian variety is smooth over the base field.
decls.statement: instance smooth (A : AbelianVariety K) : Smooth A.toOver.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.geometricallyConnected
decls.doc: An abelian variety is geometrically connected over the base field.
decls.statement:
instance geometricallyConnected (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    GeometricallyConnected A.toOver.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isCommMonObj
decls.doc:
The group law of an abelian variety is commutative: a proper geometrically integral group
scheme over a field is a commutative group object. This is the abstract rigidity theorem
`AlgebraicGeometry.isCommMonObj_of_isProper_of_geometricallyIntegral`, packaged for the bundled
`AbelianVariety`.
decls.statement: instance isCommMonObj (A : AbelianVariety K) : IsCommMonObj A.toOver

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isIntegral
decls.doc:
The underlying scheme of an abelian variety is integral: geometric integrality over the
one-point base `Spec K` descends to absolute integrality. In particular the underlying space is
nonempty, irreducible, and reduced.
decls.statement: instance isIntegral (A : AbelianVariety K) : IsIntegral A.toScheme

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.ofGeometricallyIntegral
decls.doc: A constructor for abelian varieties from Mathlib's geometrically integral package.
decls.statement:
def ofGeometricallyIntegral (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    [IsProper G.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral G.hom] : AbelianVariety K

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver
decls.statement:
lemma ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    [IsProper G.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral G.hom] :
    (ofGeometricallyIntegral G).toOver = G

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.ofGeometricallyIntegral_one
decls.doc: The unit of `ofGeometricallyIntegral G` is the unit of `G`.
decls.statement:
lemma ofGeometricallyIntegral_one (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    [IsProper G.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral G.hom] :
    η[(ofGeometricallyIntegral G).toOver] ≫
        eqToHom (ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver G) = η[G]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.ofGeometricallyIntegral_mul
decls.doc: The multiplication of `ofGeometricallyIntegral G` is the multiplication of `G`.
decls.statement:
lemma ofGeometricallyIntegral_mul (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    [IsProper G.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral G.hom] :
    μ[(ofGeometricallyIntegral G).toOver] ≫
        eqToHom (ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver G) =
      (eqToHom (ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver G) ⊗ₘ
          eqToHom (ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver G)) ≫ μ[G]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.ofGeometricallyIntegral_inv
decls.doc: The inverse of `ofGeometricallyIntegral G` is the inverse of `G`.
decls.statement:
lemma ofGeometricallyIntegral_inv (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    [IsProper G.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral G.hom] :
    ι[(ofGeometricallyIntegral G).toOver] ≫
        eqToHom (ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver G) =
      eqToHom (ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver G) ≫ ι[G]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange
decls.doc:
The base change of an abelian variety along a field extension `K → L`, obtained by pulling
back the group scheme along `Spec L → Spec K`.

Properness and geometric integrality are stable under base change, and the monoidal pullback
functor carries the group-object structure (`Functor.grpObjObj`), so the result is again an
abelian variety. This realizes the roadmap's base-change compatibility of the Jacobian at the
level of abelian varieties.
decls.statement:
def baseChange (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L]
    [Algebra K L] : AbelianVariety L

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_toOver
decls.statement:
lemma baseChange_toOver (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    (A.baseChange L).toOver =
      (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).obj A.toOver

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.commGrpMk_baseChange_toOver
decls.doc:
Bundling the underlying `Over` object of a base change with `CommGrp.mk` gives the
commutative group object obtained by applying pullback.
decls.statement:
lemma commGrpMk_baseChange_toOver (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    CommGrp.mk (A.baseChange L).toOver =
      (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).mapCommGrp.obj
        (CommGrp.mk A.toOver)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_one
decls.doc:
The unit of a base-changed abelian variety is the pullback of the original unit, with the
monoidal comparison for `Over.pullback`.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChange_one (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    η[(A.baseChange L).toOver] ≫ eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) =
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) ≫
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).map η[A.toOver]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_mul
decls.doc:
The multiplication of a base-changed abelian variety is the pullback of the original
multiplication, with the monoidal comparison for `Over.pullback`.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChange_mul (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    μ[(A.baseChange L).toOver] ≫ eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) =
      (eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) ⊗ₘ eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L)) ≫
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) A.toOver A.toOver ≫
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).map μ[A.toOver]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_inv
decls.doc: The inverse of a base-changed abelian variety is the pullback of the original inverse.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChange_inv (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    ι[(A.baseChange L).toOver] ≫ eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) =
      eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) ≫
      (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).map ι[A.toOver]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_toScheme
decls.doc:
The underlying scheme of a base change is the fibre product of the abelian variety with
`Spec L` over `Spec K`.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChange_toScheme (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    (A.baseChange L).toScheme =
      Limits.pullback A.toOver.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_dim
decls.statement:
lemma baseChange_dim (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    (A.baseChange L).dim =
      topologicalKrullDim
        (Limits.pullback A.toOver.hom
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) : Scheme.{u})

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.baseChange
decls.doc:
Extension of the base field along `K → L`, as a ring homomorphism between endomorphism rings.

Addition in an endomorphism ring is the pointwise group law of the abelian variety and
multiplication is composition, so additivity is `AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange_mul` and
multiplicativity is `AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange_comp` (composition being taken in the reversed
order in which `AbelianVariety.End` multiplies).

The action is characterized by `AbelianVariety.End.toHom_baseChange` and
`AbelianVariety.End.baseChange_ofHom`, so the implementation is not exposed.
decls.statement: def baseChange : End A →+* End (A.baseChange L)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_baseChange
decls.doc:
The endomorphism denoted by a base-changed element of the endomorphism ring is the base change
of the endomorphism denoted by that element.
decls.statement:
lemma toHom_baseChange (x : End A) :
    toHom (baseChange A L x) = Hom.baseChange (toHom x) L

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.baseChange_ofHom
decls.doc: Base change of an endomorphism, read back in the endomorphism ring.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChange_ofHom (f : A ⟶ A) :
    baseChange A L (ofHom f) = ofHom (Hom.baseChange f L)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.baseChange_congr
decls.doc:
Base change commutes with conjugation by an isomorphism of abelian varieties: conjugating and
then extending the base field is the same as extending the base field and conjugating by the
base-changed isomorphism, `CategoryTheory.Functor.mapIso` for `AbelianVariety.baseChangeFunctor`.

`Functor.mapIso` produces an isomorphism `(baseChangeFunctor L).obj A ≅ (baseChangeFunctor L).obj B`
and `AbelianVariety.baseChangeFunctor_obj` identifies its endpoints with the base changes, so the
conjugating isomorphism is the composite of the three; writing it that way keeps the statement
type-correct without unfolding the functor.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChange_congr (e : A ≅ B) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] (x : End A) :
    baseChange B L (congr e x) =
      congr (eqToIso (baseChangeFunctor_obj L A).symm ≪≫ (baseChangeFunctor L).mapIso e ≪≫
        eqToIso (baseChangeFunctor_obj L B)) (baseChange A L x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_mulBy
decls.doc: Multiplication by `n` is compatible with extension of the base field.
decls.statement:
lemma baseChange_mulBy (n : ℤ) :
    Hom.baseChange (mulBy A n) L = mulBy (A.baseChange L) n

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End
decls.doc:
The endomorphism ring of an abelian variety `A`: the endomorphisms of `A`, with addition the
pointwise group law of `A` and multiplication composition.

Since the pointwise group law on `A ⟶ A` is written multiplicatively (see
`AbelianVariety.Hom.instCommGroup`) while a ring is written additively, this is the additive
reindexing of the group `A ⟶ A`; use `AbelianVariety.End.toHom` and `AbelianVariety.End.ofHom` to
pass between an element of the ring and the endomorphism it denotes.
decls.statement: def End (A : AbelianVariety K) : Type u

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom
decls.doc: The endomorphism of `A` denoted by an element of the endomorphism ring `End A`.
decls.statement: def toHom (x : End A) : A ⟶ A

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.ofHom
decls.doc: An endomorphism of `A`, viewed as an element of the endomorphism ring `End A`.
decls.statement: def ofHom (f : A ⟶ A) : End A

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_ofHom
decls.statement: lemma toHom_ofHom (f : A ⟶ A) : toHom (ofHom f) = f

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.ofHom_toHom
decls.statement: lemma ofHom_toHom (x : End A) : ofHom (toHom x) = x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_injective
decls.statement: lemma toHom_injective : Function.Injective (toHom : End A → (A ⟶ A))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.ext
decls.statement: lemma ext {x y : End A} (h : toHom x = toHom y) : x = y

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_inj
decls.statement: lemma toHom_inj {x y : End A} : toHom x = toHom y ↔ x = y

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.instAddCommGroup
decls.statement: instance instAddCommGroup (A : AbelianVariety K) : AddCommGroup (End A)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_zero
decls.statement: lemma toHom_zero : toHom (0 : End A) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_add
decls.statement: lemma toHom_add (x y : End A) : toHom (x + y) = toHom x * toHom y

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_neg
decls.statement: lemma toHom_neg (x : End A) : toHom (-x) = (toHom x)⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_sub
decls.statement: lemma toHom_sub (x y : End A) : toHom (x - y) = toHom x / toHom y

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_nsmul
decls.statement: lemma toHom_nsmul (n : ℕ) (x : End A) : toHom (n • x) = toHom x ^ n

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_zsmul
decls.statement: lemma toHom_zsmul (n : ℤ) (x : End A) : toHom (n • x) = toHom x ^ n

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.instMonoid
decls.statement: instance instMonoid (A : AbelianVariety K) : Monoid (End A)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_one
decls.statement: lemma toHom_one : toHom (1 : End A) = 𝟙 A

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_mul
decls.statement: lemma toHom_mul (x y : End A) : toHom (x * y) = toHom y ≫ toHom x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.ofHom_comp
decls.doc:
Composing two endomorphisms is multiplying them in the endomorphism ring, in the reversed
order.
decls.statement: lemma ofHom_comp (f g : A ⟶ A) : ofHom (f ≫ g) = ofHom g * ofHom f

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.instSemiring
decls.statement: instance instSemiring (A : AbelianVariety K) : Semiring (End A)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.instRing
decls.statement: instance instRing (A : AbelianVariety K) : Ring (End A)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.instUnique
decls.doc:
An abelian variety with only one endomorphism has the zero ring as its endomorphism ring.

This is Mathlib's `Unique (Additive α)` instance; it is stated here, rather than reproved wherever a
hom-set is known to be a singleton, because unfolding `End A` to `Additive (A ⟶ A)` is only possible
in this module.
decls.statement: instance instUnique [Unique (A ⟶ A)] : Unique (End A)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_natCast
decls.doc:
The natural number `n` acts in the endomorphism ring as the `n`-th power of the identity for
the pointwise group law.
decls.statement: lemma toHom_natCast (n : ℕ) : toHom (n : End A) = 𝟙 A ^ n

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_intCast
decls.doc:
The integer `n` acts in the endomorphism ring as the `n`-th power of the identity for the
pointwise group law.
decls.statement: lemma toHom_intCast (n : ℤ) : toHom (n : End A) = 𝟙 A ^ n

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.congr
decls.doc:
Conjugation by an isomorphism `e : A ≅ B` of abelian varieties, as an isomorphism of
endomorphism rings `End A ≃+* End B`.

The multiplicative part is Mathlib's `CategoryTheory.Iso.conj`; only additivity — that conjugation
respects the pointwise group law — has to be proved here.
decls.statement: def congr (e : A ≅ B) : End A ≃+* End B

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_congr
decls.statement:
lemma toHom_congr (e : A ≅ B) (x : End A) :
    toHom (congr e x) = e.inv ≫ toHom x ≫ e.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_congr_symm
decls.statement:
lemma toHom_congr_symm (e : A ≅ B) (y : End B) :
    toHom ((congr e).symm y) = e.hom ≫ toHom y ≫ e.inv

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.congr_refl
decls.statement:
lemma congr_refl (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    congr (Iso.refl A) = RingEquiv.refl (End A)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.congr_trans
decls.statement:
lemma congr_trans (e : A ≅ B) (f : B ≅ C) :
    congr (e.trans f) = (congr e).trans (congr f)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.mulBy
decls.doc:
The multiplication-by-`n` endomorphism `[n] : A ⟶ A` of an abelian variety, that is, the image
of `n : ℤ` in the endomorphism ring `AbelianVariety.End A`.

The name is the standard one for abelian varieties, whose group law is conventionally written
additively. Here the group law on morphisms is written multiplicatively, so `[n]` is concretely the
`n`-th power map for that law: see `AbelianVariety.mulBy_eq_zpow`.
decls.statement: def mulBy (A : AbelianVariety K) (n : ℤ) : A ⟶ A

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.ofHom_mulBy
decls.doc: Viewed back in the endomorphism ring, `[n]` is the integer `n`.
decls.statement:
lemma End.ofHom_mulBy (A : AbelianVariety K) (n : ℤ) :
    End.ofHom (mulBy A n) = (n : End A)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.mulBy_eq_zpow
decls.doc: `[n]` is the `n`-th power map for the pointwise group law on endomorphisms.
decls.statement: lemma mulBy_eq_zpow (A : AbelianVariety K) (n : ℤ) : mulBy A n = 𝟙 A ^ n

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.mulBy_zero
decls.doc:
`[0]` is the constant endomorphism through the unit section, the identity of the pointwise
group law.
decls.statement: lemma mulBy_zero (A : AbelianVariety K) : mulBy A 0 = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.mulBy_one
decls.doc: `[1]` is the identity.
decls.statement: lemma mulBy_one (A : AbelianVariety K) : mulBy A 1 = 𝟙 A

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.mulBy_add
decls.doc: `[m + n]` is the pointwise product of `[m]` and `[n]`.
decls.statement:
lemma mulBy_add (A : AbelianVariety K) (m n : ℤ) :
    mulBy A (m + n) = mulBy A m * mulBy A n

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.mulBy_neg
decls.statement: lemma mulBy_neg (A : AbelianVariety K) (n : ℤ) : mulBy A (-n) = (mulBy A n)⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.mulBy_sub
decls.doc: `[m - n]` is the pointwise quotient of `[m]` and `[n]`.
decls.statement:
lemma mulBy_sub (A : AbelianVariety K) (m n : ℤ) :
    mulBy A (m - n) = mulBy A m / mulBy A n

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.mulBy_mul
decls.doc: `[m * n]` is `[m]` composed with `[n]`.
decls.statement:
lemma mulBy_mul (A : AbelianVariety K) (m n : ℤ) :
    mulBy A (m * n) = mulBy A n ≫ mulBy A m

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.mulBy_comp
decls.doc: Every homomorphism of abelian varieties commutes with multiplication by `n`.
decls.statement: lemma mulBy_comp (n : ℤ) (f : A ⟶ B) : mulBy A n ≫ f = f ≫ mulBy B n

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.congr_ofHom_mulBy
decls.doc:
Conjugating `[n]` by an isomorphism of abelian varieties gives `[n]`.

Deliberately not `@[simp]`: `AbelianVariety.End.ofHom_mulBy` rewrites both sides to an integer cast,
so this left-hand side is not in `simp` normal form, and what is left is Mathlib's `map_intCast`.
decls.statement:
lemma congr_ofHom_mulBy (e : A ≅ B) (n : ℤ) :
    End.congr e (End.ofHom (mulBy A n)) = End.ofHom (mulBy B n)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.mulBy_trivial
decls.doc:
Every endomorphism of the trivial abelian variety, in particular every `[n]`, is the
identity.
decls.statement:
lemma mulBy_trivial (n : ℤ) :
    mulBy (trivial K) n = 𝟙 (trivial K)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange
decls.doc:
Base change of a homomorphism of abelian varieties along a field extension.

This is the morphism obtained by applying pullback in the appropriate `Over` category. The
monoidal structure on pullback ensures that it is again a group-scheme homomorphism.
decls.statement:
def Hom.baseChange {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] : A.baseChange L ⟶ B.baseChange L

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_baseChange
decls.doc:
The underlying morphism over `Spec L` of a base-changed homomorphism is the pullback of its
underlying morphism over `Spec K`.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.toOverHom_baseChange {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.toOverHom (Hom.baseChange f L) =
      eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) ≫
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).map
          (Hom.toOverHom f) ≫
        eqToHom (baseChange_toOver B L).symm

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom_baseChange
decls.doc:
The underlying scheme morphism of a base-changed homomorphism is the left component of the
pulled-back morphism in the `Over` category.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.toSchemeHom_baseChange {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.toSchemeHom (Hom.baseChange f L) =
      (eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) ≫
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).map
          (Hom.toOverHom f) ≫
        eqToHom (baseChange_toOver B L).symm).left

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange_id
decls.doc: Base change preserves identity homomorphisms.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.baseChange_id (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.baseChange (𝟙 A) L = 𝟙 (A.baseChange L)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange_comp
decls.doc: Base change preserves composition of homomorphisms.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.baseChange_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.baseChange (f ≫ g) L = Hom.baseChange f L ≫ Hom.baseChange g L

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChangeFunctor
decls.doc:
Extension of the base field defines a functor between the categories of abelian varieties.

Its action is characterized by `AbelianVariety.baseChangeFunctor_obj` and
`AbelianVariety.baseChangeFunctor_map`.
decls.statement:
def baseChangeFunctor (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    AbelianVariety K ⥤ AbelianVariety L

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChangeFunctor_obj
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangeFunctor_obj (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    (baseChangeFunctor L).obj A = A.baseChange L

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChangeFunctor_map
decls.statement:
lemma baseChangeFunctor_map {A B : AbelianVariety K} (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (f : A ⟶ B) :
    (baseChangeFunctor L).map f =
      eqToHom (baseChangeFunctor_obj L A) ≫ Hom.baseChange f L ≫
        eqToHom (baseChangeFunctor_obj L B).symm

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isMonHom_eqToHom_baseChange_toOver
decls.doc:
The transport isomorphism identifying the group scheme underlying `A.baseChange L` with the
pullback of the group scheme underlying `A` preserves the unit and the multiplication: by
construction, those of the base change *are* the pulled-back ones.
decls.statement:
instance isMonHom_eqToHom_baseChange_toOver (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L]
    [Algebra K L] :
    IsMonHom (eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isMonHom_eqToHom_baseChange_toOver_symm
decls.doc: The inverse transport isomorphism is a homomorphism of monoid objects as well.
decls.statement:
instance isMonHom_eqToHom_baseChange_toOver_symm (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u)
    [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    IsMonHom (eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L).symm)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange_one
decls.doc:
Base change carries the identity element of the group of homomorphisms — the homomorphism
factoring through the unit section — to the identity element.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.baseChange_one (A B : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.baseChange (1 : A ⟶ B) L = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange_mul
decls.doc:
Base change is multiplicative for the pointwise group law: pulling back the pointwise product
of two homomorphisms gives the pointwise product of their pullbacks.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.baseChange_mul {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f g : A ⟶ B)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.baseChange (f * g) L = Hom.baseChange f L * Hom.baseChange g L

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChangeMonoidHom
decls.doc:
Base change along a field extension, as a homomorphism of the groups of homomorphisms of
abelian varieties.
decls.statement:
def Hom.baseChangeMonoidHom (A B : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    (A ⟶ B) →* (A.baseChange L ⟶ B.baseChange L)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChangeMonoidHom_apply
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.baseChangeMonoidHom_apply {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.baseChangeMonoidHom A B L f = Hom.baseChange f L

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange_inv
decls.doc: Base change preserves pointwise inverses of homomorphisms.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.baseChange_inv {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.baseChange f⁻¹ L = (Hom.baseChange f L)⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange_div
decls.doc: Base change preserves pointwise quotients of homomorphisms.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.baseChange_div {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f g : A ⟶ B)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.baseChange (f / g) L = Hom.baseChange f L / Hom.baseChange g L

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange_zpow
decls.doc: Base change preserves pointwise integer powers of homomorphisms.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.baseChange_zpow {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (n : ℤ)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.baseChange (f ^ n) L = Hom.baseChange f L ^ n

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.instCategory
decls.doc: Abelian varieties over a fixed field form a category with group-scheme homomorphisms.
decls.statement: instance : Category (AbelianVariety K)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.mk'
decls.doc:
Construct a homomorphism of abelian varieties from a morphism over `Spec K` and proofs that it
preserves the unit and multiplication.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverFunctor
decls.doc: The forgetful functor from abelian varieties to schemes over `Spec K`.
decls.statement:
def Hom.toOverFunctor :
    AbelianVariety K ⥤ Over (Spec (.of K))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom
decls.doc: The underlying morphism of group schemes over `Spec K`.
decls.statement: abbrev Hom.toOverHom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) : A.toOver ⟶ B.toOver

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_id
decls.doc: `toOverHom` sends the identity homomorphism to the identity over `Spec K`.
decls.statement: lemma Hom.toOverHom_id (A : AbelianVariety K) : Hom.toOverHom (𝟙 A) = 𝟙 A.toOver

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_comp
decls.doc: `toOverHom` sends composition to composition over `Spec K`.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.toOverHom_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) :
    Hom.toOverHom (f ≫ g) = Hom.toOverHom f ≫ Hom.toOverHom g

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_comp_assoc
decls.doc: `toOverHom` sends composition to composition over `Spec K`.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_def
decls.doc:
`toOverHom` is definitionally the iterated underlying-morphism projection through the two
induced categories, `CommGrp`, and `Grp`.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.toOverHom_def {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    Hom.toOverHom f = f.hom.hom.hom.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.instIsMonHomOverSchemeSpecOfToOverHom
decls.doc:
The underlying morphism of an abelian-variety homomorphism preserves the group-object
structure.
decls.statement: instance {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) : IsMonHom (Hom.toOverHom f)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_mk'
decls.doc:
The underlying morphism over `Spec K` of a homomorphism built by `Hom.mk'` is the supplied
morphism.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.toOverHom_mk' {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A.toOver ⟶ B.toOver)
    (one_f : η[A.toOver] ≫ f = η[B.toOver] := by cat_disch)
    (mul_f : μ[A.toOver] ≫ f = (f ⊗ₘ f) ≫ μ[B.toOver] := by cat_disch) :
    Hom.toOverHom (Hom.mk' f one_f mul_f) = f

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.one_hom
decls.doc: A homomorphism of abelian varieties preserves the unit section.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.one_hom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    η[A.toOver] ≫ Hom.toOverHom f = η[B.toOver]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.one_hom_assoc
decls.doc: A homomorphism of abelian varieties preserves the unit section.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.mul_hom
decls.doc: A homomorphism of abelian varieties preserves multiplication.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.mul_hom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    μ[A.toOver] ≫ Hom.toOverHom f =
      (Hom.toOverHom f ⊗ₘ Hom.toOverHom f) ≫ μ[B.toOver]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.mul_hom_assoc
decls.doc: A homomorphism of abelian varieties preserves multiplication.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.inv_hom
decls.doc: A homomorphism of abelian varieties preserves inverses.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.inv_hom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    ι[A.toOver] ≫ Hom.toOverHom f = Hom.toOverHom f ≫ ι[B.toOver]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.inv_hom_assoc
decls.doc: A homomorphism of abelian varieties preserves inverses.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom
decls.doc: The underlying morphism between the schemes of two abelian varieties.
decls.statement: abbrev Hom.toSchemeHom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) : A.toScheme ⟶ B.toScheme

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom_mk'
decls.doc:
The underlying scheme morphism of a homomorphism built by `Hom.mk'` is the supplied morphism's
left component.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.toSchemeHom_mk' {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A.toOver ⟶ B.toOver)
    (one_f : η[A.toOver] ≫ f = η[B.toOver] := by cat_disch)
    (mul_f : μ[A.toOver] ≫ f = (f ⊗ₘ f) ≫ μ[B.toOver] := by cat_disch) :
    Hom.toSchemeHom (Hom.mk' f one_f mul_f) = f.left

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom_id
decls.doc: `toSchemeHom` sends the identity homomorphism to the identity scheme morphism.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.toSchemeHom_id (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    Hom.toSchemeHom (𝟙 A) = 𝟙 A.toScheme

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom_comp
decls.doc: `toSchemeHom` sends composition to composition of scheme morphisms.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.toSchemeHom_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) :
    Hom.toSchemeHom (f ≫ g) = Hom.toSchemeHom f ≫ Hom.toSchemeHom g

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom_comp_assoc
decls.doc: `toSchemeHom` sends composition to composition of scheme morphisms.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom_comp_hom
decls.doc:
The underlying scheme morphism of an abelian-variety homomorphism commutes with the structure
morphisms to `Spec K`.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.toSchemeHom_comp_hom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    Hom.toSchemeHom f ≫ B.toOver.hom = A.toOver.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom_comp_hom_assoc
decls.doc:
The underlying scheme morphism of an abelian-variety homomorphism commutes with the structure
morphisms to `Spec K`.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.ext
decls.doc:
Two homomorphisms of abelian varieties are equal when their underlying scheme morphisms are
equal.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.ext {A B : AbelianVariety K} {f g : A ⟶ B}
    (h : Hom.toSchemeHom f = Hom.toSchemeHom g) : f = g

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.instFaithfulOverSchemeSpecOfToOverFunctor
decls.doc:
Forgetting an abelian-variety homomorphism to its underlying morphism over `Spec K` is
faithful.
decls.statement: instance : (Hom.toOverFunctor (K := K)).Faithful

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_injective
decls.doc:
Two homomorphisms of abelian varieties with the same underlying morphism over `Spec K` are
equal.
decls.statement:
lemma Hom.toOverHom_injective {A B : AbelianVariety K} {f g : A ⟶ B}
    (h : Hom.toOverHom f = Hom.toOverHom g) : f = g

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToOver
decls.doc: The isomorphism of schemes over `Spec K` underlying an isomorphism of abelian varieties.
decls.statement: def isoToOver {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) : A.toOver ≅ B.toOver

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToScheme
decls.doc: The isomorphism of schemes underlying an isomorphism of abelian varieties.
decls.statement: def isoToScheme {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) : A.toScheme ≅ B.toScheme

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToOver_hom
decls.doc: The forward map of the underlying `Over` isomorphism is the underlying homomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma isoToOver_hom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    (isoToOver e).hom = Hom.toOverHom e.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToOver_inv
decls.doc: The inverse map of the underlying `Over` isomorphism is the underlying homomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma isoToOver_inv {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    (isoToOver e).inv = Hom.toOverHom e.inv

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToScheme_hom
decls.doc: The forward map of the underlying scheme isomorphism is the underlying scheme morphism.
decls.statement:
lemma isoToScheme_hom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    (isoToScheme e).hom = Hom.toSchemeHom e.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToScheme_inv
decls.doc: The inverse map of the underlying scheme isomorphism is the underlying scheme morphism.
decls.statement:
lemma isoToScheme_inv {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    (isoToScheme e).inv = Hom.toSchemeHom e.inv

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToOver_refl
decls.doc: The underlying `Over` isomorphism of the identity isomorphism is the identity.
decls.statement:
lemma isoToOver_refl (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    isoToOver (Iso.refl A) = Iso.refl A.toOver

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToOver_symm
decls.doc: Forgetting an inverse isomorphism over the base commutes with taking inverses.
decls.statement:
lemma isoToOver_symm {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    isoToOver e.symm = (isoToOver e).symm

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToOver_trans
decls.doc: Forgetting a composite isomorphism over the base commutes with composition.
decls.statement:
lemma isoToOver_trans {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) (f : B ≅ C) :
    isoToOver (e.trans f) = (isoToOver e).trans (isoToOver f)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToScheme_refl
decls.doc: The underlying scheme isomorphism of the identity isomorphism is the identity.
decls.statement:
lemma isoToScheme_refl (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    isoToScheme (Iso.refl A) = Iso.refl A.toScheme

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToScheme_symm
decls.doc: Forgetting an inverse isomorphism of schemes commutes with taking inverses.
decls.statement:
lemma isoToScheme_symm {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    isoToScheme e.symm = (isoToScheme e).symm

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToScheme_trans
decls.doc: Forgetting a composite isomorphism of schemes commutes with composition.
decls.statement:
lemma isoToScheme_trans {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) (f : B ≅ C) :
    isoToScheme (e.trans f) = (isoToScheme e).trans (isoToScheme f)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.dim_eq_of_iso
decls.doc: Isomorphic abelian varieties have equal topological Krull dimension.
decls.statement:
lemma dim_eq_of_iso {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    A.dim = B.dim

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.instCommGroup
decls.doc:
Homomorphisms of abelian varieties over `K` form a commutative group under the pointwise group
law of the target, transported from Mathlib's group structure on morphisms into a commutative group
object.
decls.statement: instance instCommGroup (A B : AbelianVariety K) : CommGroup (A ⟶ B)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.homMulEquiv
decls.doc:
Identifying a homomorphism of abelian varieties with its underlying homomorphism of commutative
group objects is a group isomorphism onto the latter's group of homomorphisms.
decls.statement:
def homMulEquiv (A B : AbelianVariety K) :
    (A ⟶ B) ≃* ((CommGrp.mk A.toOver).toGrp ⟶ (CommGrp.mk B.toOver).toGrp)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.homMulEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
The hom-set multiplicative equivalence evaluates to the nested underlying group-object
homomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma homMulEquiv_apply (f : A ⟶ B) :
    homMulEquiv A B f = f.hom.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_eq_homMulEquiv
decls.doc:
The underlying morphism over `Spec K` of a homomorphism of abelian varieties is the underlying
morphism of the corresponding commutative-group-object homomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma toOverHom_eq_homMulEquiv (f : A ⟶ B) :
    toOverHom f = (homMulEquiv A B f).hom.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_mul
decls.doc:
The underlying morphism over `Spec K` sends the product of two homomorphisms to the pointwise
product.
decls.statement:
lemma toOverHom_mul (f g : A ⟶ B) :
    toOverHom (f * g) = toOverHom f * toOverHom g

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_one
decls.doc:
The underlying morphism over `Spec K` sends the identity of the group of homomorphisms to the
identity element `toUnit A.toOver ≫ η[B.toOver]` (the constant homomorphism through the unit
section).
decls.statement:
lemma toOverHom_one :
    toOverHom (1 : A ⟶ B) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_inv
decls.doc:
The underlying morphism over `Spec K` sends the inverse of a homomorphism to the pointwise
inverse.
decls.statement:
lemma toOverHom_inv (f : A ⟶ B) :
    toOverHom f⁻¹ = (toOverHom f)⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_div
decls.doc:
The underlying morphism over `Spec K` sends the quotient of two homomorphisms to the pointwise
quotient.
decls.statement:
lemma toOverHom_div (f g : A ⟶ B) :
    toOverHom (f / g) = toOverHom f / toOverHom g

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.mul_comp
decls.doc:
Composition of homomorphisms of abelian varieties distributes over the pointwise product on the
right: post-composition by a homomorphism is multiplicative.
decls.statement:
lemma mul_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f g : A ⟶ B) (h : B ⟶ C) :
    (f * g) ≫ h = f ≫ h * g ≫ h

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.mul_comp_assoc
decls.doc:
Composition of homomorphisms of abelian varieties distributes over the pointwise product on the
right: post-composition by a homomorphism is multiplicative.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.comp_mul
decls.doc:
Composition of homomorphisms of abelian varieties distributes over the pointwise product on the
left: pre-composition by a homomorphism is multiplicative.
decls.statement:
lemma comp_mul {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g h : B ⟶ C) :
    f ≫ (g * h) = f ≫ g * f ≫ h

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.comp_mul_assoc
decls.doc:
Composition of homomorphisms of abelian varieties distributes over the pointwise product on the
left: pre-composition by a homomorphism is multiplicative.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.one_comp
decls.doc: Post-composition sends the identity element of a homomorphism group to the identity element.
decls.statement:
lemma one_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (h : B ⟶ C) :
    (1 : A ⟶ B) ≫ h = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.comp_one
decls.doc: Pre-composition sends the identity element of a homomorphism group to the identity element.
decls.statement:
lemma comp_one {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    f ≫ (1 : B ⟶ C) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.inv_comp
decls.doc: Post-composition preserves pointwise inverses of homomorphisms.
decls.statement:
lemma inv_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (h : B ⟶ C) :
    f⁻¹ ≫ h = (f ≫ h)⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.div_comp
decls.doc: Post-composition preserves pointwise quotients of homomorphisms.
decls.statement:
lemma div_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f g : A ⟶ B) (h : B ⟶ C) :
    (f / g) ≫ h = (f ≫ h) / (g ≫ h)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.comp_inv
decls.doc: Pre-composition preserves pointwise inverses of homomorphisms.
decls.statement:
lemma comp_inv {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) :
    f ≫ g⁻¹ = (f ≫ g)⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.comp_div
decls.doc: Pre-composition preserves pointwise quotients of homomorphisms.
decls.statement:
lemma comp_div {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g h : B ⟶ C) :
    f ≫ (g / h) = (f ≫ g) / (f ≫ h)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.leftComp
decls.doc:
Pre-composition by a fixed homomorphism, bundled as a homomorphism of the pointwise
homomorphism groups. This is `Hom.comp_mul` in bundled form; the name follows Mathlib's
`CategoryTheory.Preadditive.leftComp`.
decls.statement:
def leftComp {A B : AbelianVariety K} (C : AbelianVariety K) (f : A ⟶ B) :
    (B ⟶ C) →* (A ⟶ C)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.rightComp
decls.doc:
Post-composition by a fixed homomorphism, bundled as a homomorphism of the pointwise
homomorphism groups. This is `Hom.mul_comp` in bundled form; the name follows Mathlib's
`CategoryTheory.Preadditive.rightComp`.
decls.statement:
def rightComp (A : AbelianVariety K) {B C : AbelianVariety K} (g : B ⟶ C) :
    (A ⟶ B) →* (A ⟶ C)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.leftComp_apply
decls.statement:
lemma leftComp_apply {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) :
    leftComp C f g = f ≫ g

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.rightComp_apply
decls.statement:
lemma rightComp_apply {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) :
    rightComp A g f = f ≫ g

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.comp_zpow
decls.doc: Pre-composition by a homomorphism preserves pointwise integer powers.
decls.statement:
lemma comp_zpow {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) (n : ℤ) :
    f ≫ (g ^ n) = (f ≫ g) ^ n

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.zpow_comp
decls.doc: Post-composition by a homomorphism preserves pointwise integer powers.
decls.statement:
lemma zpow_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) (n : ℤ) :
    (f ^ n) ≫ g = (f ≫ g) ^ n

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isProper_tensor
decls.statement:
lemma isProper_tensor (A B : AbelianVariety K) :
    IsProper (A.toOver ⊗ B.toOver).hom

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.geometricallyIntegral_tensor
decls.statement:
lemma geometricallyIntegral_tensor (A B : AbelianVariety K) :
    GeometricallyIntegral (A.toOver ⊗ B.toOver).hom

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod
decls.doc:
The product of two abelian varieties over `K`. Its underlying scheme is their fibre product
over `Spec K`, and its group law is componentwise.
decls.statement: def prod (A B : AbelianVariety K) : AbelianVariety K

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod_toOver
decls.doc: The group scheme underlying a product is the fibre product group scheme.
decls.statement:
lemma prod_toOver (A B : AbelianVariety K) :
    (prod A B).toOver = A.toOver ⊗ B.toOver

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod_toScheme
decls.doc:
The scheme underlying a product is the fibre product of the two underlying schemes over
`Spec K`.
decls.statement:
lemma prod_toScheme (A B : AbelianVariety K) :
    (prod A B).toScheme = pullback A.toOver.hom B.toOver.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod_one
decls.doc: The unit section of a product is the componentwise unit section.
decls.statement:
lemma prod_one (A B : AbelianVariety K) :
    η[(prod A B).toOver] ≫ eqToHom (prod_toOver A B) =
      η[A.toOver ⊗ B.toOver]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod_mul
decls.doc: The multiplication on a product is componentwise multiplication.
decls.statement:
lemma prod_mul (A B : AbelianVariety K) :
    μ[(prod A B).toOver] ≫ eqToHom (prod_toOver A B) =
      (eqToHom (prod_toOver A B) ⊗ₘ eqToHom (prod_toOver A B)) ≫
        μ[A.toOver ⊗ B.toOver]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod_inv
decls.doc: Inversion on a product is componentwise inversion.
decls.statement:
lemma prod_inv (A B : AbelianVariety K) :
    ι[(prod A B).toOver] ≫ eqToHom (prod_toOver A B) =
      eqToHom (prod_toOver A B) ≫ ι[A.toOver ⊗ B.toOver]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod.fst
decls.doc: The first projection from a product of abelian varieties.
decls.statement: def fst (A B : AbelianVariety K) : prod A B ⟶ A

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod.snd
decls.doc: The second projection from a product of abelian varieties.
decls.statement: def snd (A B : AbelianVariety K) : prod A B ⟶ B

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod.lift
decls.doc: Pair two homomorphisms with a common source to obtain a homomorphism into a product.
decls.statement:
def lift {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : C ⟶ A) (g : C ⟶ B) :
    C ⟶ prod A B

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod.toOverHom_fst
decls.doc: The morphism over `Spec K` underlying the first projection is the pullback projection.
decls.statement:
lemma toOverHom_fst (A B : AbelianVariety K) :
    Hom.toOverHom (fst A B) =
      eqToHom (prod_toOver A B) ≫ CartesianMonoidalCategory.fst A.toOver B.toOver

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod.toOverHom_snd
decls.doc: The morphism over `Spec K` underlying the second projection is the pullback projection.
decls.statement:
lemma toOverHom_snd (A B : AbelianVariety K) :
    Hom.toOverHom (snd A B) =
      eqToHom (prod_toOver A B) ≫ CartesianMonoidalCategory.snd A.toOver B.toOver

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod.toOverHom_lift
decls.doc: The morphism over `Spec K` underlying a pairing is the corresponding pullback lift.
decls.statement:
lemma toOverHom_lift {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : C ⟶ A) (g : C ⟶ B) :
    Hom.toOverHom (lift f g) =
      CartesianMonoidalCategory.lift (Hom.toOverHom f) (Hom.toOverHom g) ≫
        eqToHom (prod_toOver A B).symm

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod.lift_fst
decls.doc: The first projection of a pairing is its first component.
decls.statement:
lemma lift_fst {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : C ⟶ A) (g : C ⟶ B) :
    lift f g ≫ fst A B = f

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod.lift_snd
decls.doc: The second projection of a pairing is its second component.
decls.statement:
lemma lift_snd {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : C ⟶ A) (g : C ⟶ B) :
    lift f g ≫ snd A B = g

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod.hom_ext
decls.doc: Homomorphisms into a product are determined by their two projections.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod.comp_lift
decls.doc: Precomposing a pairing composes each of its components.
decls.statement:
lemma comp_lift {A B C D : AbelianVariety K} (h : D ⟶ C) (f : C ⟶ A) (g : C ⟶ B) :
    h ≫ lift f g = lift (h ≫ f) (h ≫ g)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod.comp_lift_assoc
decls.doc: Precomposing a pairing composes each of its components.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod.lift_comp_fst_snd
decls.doc: Pairing the two projections of a homomorphism into a product recovers that homomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma lift_comp_fst_snd {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : C ⟶ prod A B) :
    lift (f ≫ fst A B) (f ≫ snd A B) = f

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod.binaryFan
decls.statement: def binaryFan (A B : AbelianVariety K) : BinaryFan A B

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.prod.binaryFanIsLimit
decls.statement:
def binaryFanIsLimit (A B : AbelianVariety K) :
    IsLimit (binaryFan A B)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.hasBinaryProduct
decls.doc: The concrete product supplies the categorical binary product of abelian varieties.
decls.statement: instance hasBinaryProduct (A B : AbelianVariety K) : HasBinaryProduct A B

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.hasBinaryProducts
decls.doc: Abelian varieties over a field have categorical binary products.
decls.statement: instance hasBinaryProducts : HasBinaryProducts (AbelianVariety K)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.hasFiniteProducts
decls.doc: Abelian varieties over a field have all finite products.
decls.statement: instance hasFiniteProducts : HasFiniteProducts (AbelianVariety K)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.topologicalKrullDim_spec_eq_zero
decls.doc: The spectrum of a field has topological Krull dimension `0`.
decls.statement:
lemma topologicalKrullDim_spec_eq_zero (K : Type u) [Field K] :
    topologicalKrullDim (Spec (.of K)) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isProperTensorUnit
decls.doc:
The structure morphism of the monoidal unit of `Over (Spec K)` is proper: it is the identity
of `Spec K` (`Over.tensorUnit_hom`).
decls.statement:
lemma isProperTensorUnit :
    IsProper (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K)))).hom

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.geometricallyIntegralTensorUnit
decls.doc:
The structure morphism of the monoidal unit of `Over (Spec K)` is geometrically integral: it
is the identity of `Spec K` (`Over.tensorUnit_hom`), and an isomorphism is geometrically integral
by `geometricallyIntegral_of_isIso`.
decls.statement:
lemma geometricallyIntegralTensorUnit :
    GeometricallyIntegral (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K)))).hom

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.trivial
decls.doc:
The **trivial abelian variety** over `K`: the base `Spec K` regarded as a group scheme over
itself.

It is carried by the monoidal unit `𝟙_ (Over (Spec K))`, which is a group object because it is
terminal, and whose structure morphism is proper and geometrically integral by
`isProperTensorUnit` and `geometricallyIntegralTensorUnit`. Those are exactly the hypotheses of
`AbelianVariety.ofGeometricallyIntegral`, which assembles them.
decls.statement: def trivial : AbelianVariety K

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.trivial_toOver
decls.doc:
The group scheme underlying the trivial abelian variety is the monoidal unit of
`Over (Spec K)`.
decls.statement: lemma trivial_toOver : (trivial K).toOver = 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K)))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.trivial_toScheme
decls.doc: The scheme underlying the trivial abelian variety is `Spec K`.
decls.statement: lemma trivial_toScheme : (trivial K).toScheme = Spec (.of K)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isTerminalTrivialToOver
decls.doc:
The scheme over `Spec K` underlying the trivial abelian variety is terminal: it is the
monoidal unit of `Over (Spec K)`.
decls.statement: def isTerminalTrivialToOver : IsTerminal (trivial K).toOver

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.trivial_one
decls.doc:
The unit section of the trivial abelian variety is the identity: it is an endomorphism of a
terminal object.
decls.statement:
lemma trivial_one :
    η[(trivial K).toOver] ≫ eqToHom (trivial_toOver K) =
      η[𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K)))]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.trivial_mul
decls.doc: The multiplication of the trivial abelian variety is the terminal projection.
decls.statement:
lemma trivial_mul :
    μ[(trivial K).toOver] ≫ eqToHom (trivial_toOver K) =
      (eqToHom (trivial_toOver K) ⊗ₘ eqToHom (trivial_toOver K)) ≫
        μ[𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K)))]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.trivial_inv
decls.doc: The inversion of the trivial abelian variety is the identity.
decls.statement:
lemma trivial_inv :
    ι[(trivial K).toOver] ≫ eqToHom (trivial_toOver K) =
      eqToHom (trivial_toOver K) ≫ ι[𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K)))]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.dim_trivial
decls.doc: The trivial abelian variety has dimension `0`.
decls.statement: lemma dim_trivial : (trivial K).dim = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.uniqueHomToTrivial
decls.doc:
There is exactly one homomorphism from an abelian variety to the trivial one. Since
`(trivial K).toOver` is the monoidal unit, this is Mathlib's `Grp.uniqueHomToTrivial`, transported
through the hom equivalences of the induced categories `AbelianVariety K`, `CommGrp` and `Grp`.
decls.statement: instance uniqueHomToTrivial (A : AbelianVariety K) : Unique (A ⟶ trivial K)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.uniqueHomFromTrivial
decls.doc:
There is exactly one homomorphism from the trivial abelian variety to an abelian variety.
Since `(trivial K).toOver` is the monoidal unit, this is Mathlib's
`CommGrp.uniqueHomFromTrivial`, transported through the hom equivalence of the induced category
`AbelianVariety K`.
decls.statement: instance uniqueHomFromTrivial (A : AbelianVariety K) : Unique (trivial K ⟶ A)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.toTrivial
decls.doc:
The homomorphism from an abelian variety to the trivial one, namely the identity element of
the group `A ⟶ trivial K`. Its underlying morphism over `Spec K` is the structure morphism of
`A`.
decls.statement: def toTrivial (A : AbelianVariety K) : A ⟶ trivial K

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.toOverHom_toTrivial
decls.doc:
The morphism over `Spec K` underlying `toTrivial A` is the structure morphism of `A`, after
transporting its codomain along `trivial_toOver`.
decls.statement:
lemma toOverHom_toTrivial (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    Hom.toOverHom (toTrivial A) ≫ eqToHom (trivial_toOver K) = toUnit A.toOver

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.toSchemeHom_toTrivial
decls.doc:
The scheme morphism underlying `toTrivial A` is the structure morphism of `A`, after
transporting its codomain to `Spec K`.
decls.statement:
lemma toSchemeHom_toTrivial (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    Hom.toSchemeHom (toTrivial A) ≫ eqToHom (trivial_toScheme K) = A.toOver.hom

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.fromTrivial
decls.doc:
The homomorphism from the trivial abelian variety to an abelian variety, namely the identity
element of the group `trivial K ⟶ A`. Its underlying morphism over `Spec K` is the unit section
of `A`.
decls.statement: def fromTrivial (A : AbelianVariety K) : trivial K ⟶ A

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.toOverHom_fromTrivial
decls.doc:
The identity element of `trivial K ⟶ A` is the unit section of `A`: it is
`toUnit (trivial K).toOver ≫ η[A.toOver]`, and the first factor is an endomorphism of a terminal
object, hence the identity.
decls.statement:
lemma toOverHom_fromTrivial (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    eqToHom (trivial_toOver K).symm ≫ Hom.toOverHom (fromTrivial A) = η[A.toOver]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.toSchemeHom_fromTrivial
decls.doc:
The scheme morphism underlying `fromTrivial A` is the unit section of `A`, after transporting
its domain from `Spec K`.
decls.statement:
lemma toSchemeHom_fromTrivial (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    eqToHom (trivial_toScheme K).symm ≫ Hom.toSchemeHom (fromTrivial A) =
      η[A.toOver].left

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isTerminalTrivial
decls.doc:
The trivial abelian variety is terminal: the only homomorphism to it from an abelian variety
over `K` is that variety's structure morphism to `Spec K`.
decls.statement: def isTerminalTrivial (K : Type u) [Field K] : IsTerminal (trivial K)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isInitialTrivial
decls.doc:
The trivial abelian variety is initial: the only homomorphism from it to an abelian variety
over `K` is that variety's unit section, because a homomorphism of group schemes preserves the
unit and the unit of the trivial group scheme is the identity.
decls.statement: def isInitialTrivial (K : Type u) [Field K] : IsInitial (trivial K)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isZeroTrivial
decls.doc: The trivial abelian variety is a zero object of the category of abelian varieties over `K`.
decls.statement: lemma isZeroTrivial (K : Type u) [Field K] : IsZero (trivial K)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.instHasZeroObject
decls.statement: instance (K : Type u) [Field K] : HasZeroObject (AbelianVariety K)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.toTrivial_comp_fromTrivial
decls.doc:
Factoring through the trivial abelian variety gives the identity element of the group of
homomorphisms `A ⟶ B`: the zero object of the category and the neutral element of the pointwise
group law agree.
decls.statement:
lemma toTrivial_comp_fromTrivial (A B : AbelianVariety K) :
    toTrivial A ≫ fromTrivial B = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isTerminalBaseChangeTrivialToOver
decls.doc:
The scheme over `Spec L` underlying the base change of the trivial abelian variety is
terminal, because pulling back along `Spec L ⟶ Spec K` is a right adjoint and so preserves the
terminal object of `Over (Spec K)`.
decls.statement:
def isTerminalBaseChangeTrivialToOver (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    IsTerminal ((trivial K).baseChange L).toOver

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isTerminalBaseChangeTrivial
decls.doc:
The base change of the trivial abelian variety along `K → L` is terminal in the category of
abelian varieties over `L`.
decls.statement:
def isTerminalBaseChangeTrivial (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    IsTerminal ((trivial K).baseChange L)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChangeTrivialIso
decls.doc:
Base change along a field extension `K → L` carries the trivial abelian variety over `K` to
the trivial abelian variety over `L`: both are terminal in the category of abelian varieties
over `L`.
decls.statement:
def baseChangeTrivialIso (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    (trivial K).baseChange L ≅ trivial L

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.dim_baseChange_trivial
decls.doc: The base change of the trivial abelian variety still has dimension `0`.
decls.statement:
lemma dim_baseChange_trivial (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    ((trivial K).baseChange L).dim = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.geometricallyIntegral_of_isIso
decls.doc:
An isomorphism of schemes is geometrically integral.

Every base change of an isomorphism is an isomorphism, so the fibre product of `f` with a morphism
`Spec L ⟶ Y` is isomorphic to `Spec L`, which is integral because `L` is a field.
decls.statement:
lemma geometricallyIntegral_of_isIso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso f] :
    GeometricallyIntegral f

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.closure_image_mem_irreducibleComponents
decls.doc:
The closure of the image of an irreducible component under an open
embedding is an irreducible component.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.irreducibleComponents_containing_equiv_of_isOpenEmbedding
decls.doc:
Given an open embedding, irreducible components containing a point `x` are
in bijection with irreducible components containing `f x`.
decls.statement:
def irreducibleComponents_containing_equiv_of_isOpenEmbedding
    {α β : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β]
    {f : α → β} (hf : IsOpenEmbedding f) (x : α) :
    { c : irreducibleComponents α // x ∈ (c : Set α) } ≃
    { c : irreducibleComponents β // f x ∈ (c : Set β) }

decls.name: Homeomorph.irreducibleComponentsEquiv
decls.doc: Equivalence of irreducible components under homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
def _root_.Homeomorph.irreducibleComponentsEquiv {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [TopologicalSpace Y] (h : X ≃ₜ Y) : irreducibleComponents X ≃ irreducibleComponents Y

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.minimalPrimes_equiv_of_ringEquiv
decls.doc: A ring isomorphism induces an equivalence of minimal primes.
decls.statement:
def minimalPrimes_equiv_of_ringEquiv
    {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (e : A ≃+* B) :
    minimalPrimes A ≃ minimalPrimes B

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.minimalPrimesEquivMinimalPrimesLe
decls.doc:
The minimal primes of the localization `A` of a ring `R` at the prime complement of `p`
are in bijection with the minimal primes of `R` contained in `p`.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.val_mpr_orderIso
decls.doc: Value of the cast of an order isomorphism over subtypes.
decls.statement:
lemma val_mpr_orderIso {α : Type u} [LE α] {Y : Type u} [LE Y] {P Q : Y → Prop}
    (h : P = Q) (f : α ≃o (Subtype P)ᵒᵈ) (q : α) :
    Subtype.val (OrderDual.ofDual
      (Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun T ↦ α ≃o (Subtype T)ᵒᵈ) h.symm) f q)) =
      Subtype.val (OrderDual.ofDual (f q))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.val_equivIrreducibleComponents
decls.doc:
Evaluating the `equivIrreducibleComponents` bijection on a minimal prime
yields its `zeroLocus`.
decls.statement:
theorem val_equivIrreducibleComponents (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
    (q : minimalPrimes R) :
    (OrderDual.ofDual ((minimalPrimes.equivIrreducibleComponents R).toEquiv q)).val =
      zeroLocus q.val

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.irreducibleComponentsContainingEquivMinimalPrimesLe
decls.doc:
Irreducible components of `Spec R` containing a point `p`
are in bijection with minimal primes of `R` contained in `p`.
decls.statement:
def
    irreducibleComponentsContainingEquivMinimalPrimesLe
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    { c : irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum R) // p ∈ c.val } ≃
    { q : minimalPrimes R // q.val ≤ p.asIdeal }

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.stalkMinimalPrimesEquivIrreducibleComponentsContainingSpec
decls.doc:
For an affine scheme `Spec R`, the minimal prime ideals of the local ring (stalk)
at a point `p` are in bijection with the irreducible components of `Spec R` containing `p`.
decls.statement:
def stalkMinimalPrimesEquivIrreducibleComponentsContainingSpec
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    minimalPrimes (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) ≃
      { c : irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum R) // p ∈ (c : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) }

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.nonempty_stalkMinimalPrimesEquivIrreducibleComponentsContaining
decls.doc:
The minimal primes of the stalk of a scheme at a point `x`
are in bijection with the irreducible components containing `x`.
decls.statement:
lemma
    nonempty_stalkMinimalPrimesEquivIrreducibleComponentsContaining
    {X : Scheme} (x : X.carrier) :
    Nonempty (minimalPrimes (X.presheaf.stalk x) ≃
      { c : irreducibleComponents X.carrier // x ∈ (c : Set X.carrier) })

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.existsUnique_irreducibleComponent_of_unique_minimalPrime
decls.doc:
If the stalk at `x` has a unique minimal prime, then
`x` belongs to a unique irreducible component.
decls.statement:
lemma existsUnique_irreducibleComponent_of_unique_minimalPrime
    {X : Scheme} (x : X.carrier)
    [Unique (minimalPrimes (X.presheaf.stalk x))] :
    ∃! c : irreducibleComponents X.carrier,
      x ∈ (c : Set X.carrier)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.disjoint_irreducibleComponents_of_unique_minimalPrime
decls.doc:
In a scheme whose stalks have unique minimal primes, the irreducible
components are pairwise disjoint.
decls.statement:
lemma disjoint_irreducibleComponents_of_unique_minimalPrime {Z : Scheme}
  (hStalks : ∀ x : Z.carrier, Unique (minimalPrimes (Z.presheaf.stalk x))) :
  ∀ c1 c2 : irreducibleComponents Z.carrier, c1 ≠ c2 →
    Disjoint (c1 : Set Z.carrier) (c2 : Set Z.carrier)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.isOpen_irreducibleComponents_of_pairwise_disjoint
decls.doc:
In a topological space with finitely many irreducible components, pairwise-disjoint
components are open.
decls.statement:
lemma isOpen_irreducibleComponents_of_pairwise_disjoint {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    (hFinite : (irreducibleComponents α).Finite)
    (hDisj : ∀ c1 c2 : irreducibleComponents α, c1 ≠ c2 →
      Disjoint (c1 : Set α) (c2 : Set α))
    (c : irreducibleComponents α) : IsOpen (c : Set α)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.isOpen_irreducibleComponents_of_affine_unique_minimalPrime
decls.doc:
In an affine locally noetherian scheme whose stalks have unique minimal
primes, every irreducible component is open.
decls.statement:
theorem isOpen_irreducibleComponents_of_affine_unique_minimalPrime {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsAffine X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hStalks : ∀ x : X.carrier, Unique (minimalPrimes (X.presheaf.stalk x)))
    (c : irreducibleComponents X.carrier) : IsOpen (c : Set X.carrier)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.isOpen_irreducibleComponents_of_unique_minimalPrime
decls.doc:
In a locally noetherian scheme whose stalks have unique minimal primes,
every irreducible component is open.
decls.statement:
theorem isOpen_irreducibleComponents_of_unique_minimalPrime {Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Z]
    (hStalks : ∀ x : Z.carrier, Unique (minimalPrimes (Z.presheaf.stalk x)))
    (c : irreducibleComponents Z.carrier) :
    IsOpen (c : Set Z.carrier)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.irreducibleSpace_of_connected_of_open_components
decls.doc: A connected topological space with open irreducible components is irreducible.
decls.statement:
lemma irreducibleSpace_of_connected_of_open_components {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [ConnectedSpace α] (hOpen : ∀ c : irreducibleComponents α, IsOpen (c : Set α)) :
    IrreducibleSpace α

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.irreducibleSpace_of_connected_of_unique_minimalPrime_stalk
decls.doc:
A locally noetherian connected scheme whose stalks have unique minimal
primes is irreducible.
decls.statement:
theorem irreducibleSpace_of_connected_of_unique_minimalPrime_stalk (Z : Scheme.{u})
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Z]
    [ConnectedSpace Z] (hStalks : ∀ x : Z.carrier, Unique (minimalPrimes (Z.presheaf.stalk x))) :
    IrreducibleSpace Z

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.irreducibleSpace_of_connected_of_isDomain_stalk
decls.doc:
A locally noetherian connected scheme whose stalks are integral domains
is irreducible.
decls.statement:
theorem irreducibleSpace_of_connected_of_isDomain_stalk (Z : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian Z]
    [ConnectedSpace Z] (hStalks : ∀ x : Z.carrier, IsDomain (Z.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    IrreducibleSpace Z

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.isInvertible
decls.doc: The object property of being an invertible sheaf on a scheme.
decls.statement: abbrev isInvertible : ObjectProperty X.Modules

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.instIsClosedUnderIsomorphismsModulesIsInvertible
decls.statement: instance : (isInvertible X).IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.InvertibleSheaf
decls.doc:
The full category of invertible sheaves on `X`. Its morphisms are morphisms of
`𝒪_X`-modules.
decls.statement: abbrev InvertibleSheaf (X : Scheme.{u})

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.InvertibleSheaf.instIsInvertibleObjModules
decls.statement: instance (L : InvertibleSheaf X) : SheafOfModules.isInvertible X L.obj

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.InvertibleSheaf.free
decls.doc: The invertible sheaf given by the free sheaf on an indexing type with exactly one element.
decls.statement:
def free (X : Scheme.{u}) (I : Type u) [Nonempty I] [Subsingleton I] :
    InvertibleSheaf X

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.InvertibleSheaf.free_obj
decls.statement:
lemma free_obj (X : Scheme.{u}) (I : Type u) [Nonempty I] [Subsingleton I] :
    (free X I).obj = SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.InvertibleSheaf.trivial
decls.doc: The globally free rank-one invertible sheaf.
decls.statement: def trivial (X : Scheme.{u}) : InvertibleSheaf X

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.InvertibleSheaf.trivial_obj
decls.statement:
lemma trivial_obj (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    (trivial X).obj = SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.leftInverse_of_section
decls.doc: On underlying points, a section of `f` is a right inverse of `f`.
decls.statement: lemma leftInverse_of_section (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 S) : Function.LeftInverse f s

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.section_apply
decls.doc: A section of `f` is a one-sided inverse of `f` at every point of the base.
decls.statement: lemma section_apply (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (y : S) : f (s y) = y

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.residueDegree_mul_residueDegree_of_section
decls.doc:
The two residue degrees attached to a section multiply to one: the residue-field extensions
`κ(y) → κ(s y) → κ(y)` compose to the identity of `κ(y)`.
decls.statement:
lemma residueDegree_mul_residueDegree_of_section (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (y : S) :
    f.residueDegree (s y) * s.residueDegree y = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.residueDegree_eq_one_of_section
decls.doc:
The residue degree of `f` at a point in the image of a section is one.

For `S = Spec k` this says that a `k`-rational point `x₀` of `X` has residue field `κ(x₀)` of
degree one over `k`.
decls.statement:
theorem residueDegree_eq_one_of_section (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (y : S) :
    f.residueDegree (s y) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.residueDegree_section_eq_one
decls.doc: A section has residue degree one at every point of the base.
decls.statement:
theorem residueDegree_section_eq_one (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (y : S) :
    s.residueDegree y = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.residueDegree_comp_of_section
decls.doc:
Residue degrees over a further base are computed on the base: at a point in the image of a
section of `f : X ⟶ S`, the residue degree of `f ≫ g` agrees with that of `g : S ⟶ Z`.
decls.statement:
theorem residueDegree_comp_of_section (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (g : S ⟶ Z) (y : S) :
    (f ≫ g).residueDegree (s y) = g.residueDegree y

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.residueFieldMap_bijective_of_section
decls.doc: The residue-field map of `f` at a point in the image of a section is bijective.
decls.statement:
theorem residueFieldMap_bijective_of_section (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (y : S) :
    Function.Bijective (f.residueFieldMap (s y))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.residueFieldMap_section_bijective
decls.doc: The residue-field map of a section is bijective at every point of the base.
decls.statement:
theorem residueFieldMap_section_bijective (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (y : S) :
    Function.Bijective (s.residueFieldMap y)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_residueFieldMap_of_section
decls.doc: The residue-field map of `f` at a point in the image of a section is an isomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma isIso_residueFieldMap_of_section (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (y : S) :
    IsIso (f.residueFieldMap (s y))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_residueFieldMap_section
decls.doc: The residue-field map of a section is an isomorphism at every point of the base.
decls.statement:
lemma isIso_residueFieldMap_section (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (y : S) :
    IsIso (s.residueFieldMap y)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.residueFieldMap_comp_residueFieldMap_of_section
decls.doc:
The residue-field map of `f` at a point in the image of a section, followed by the
residue-field map of the section, is the identity of `κ(y)`.
decls.statement:
lemma residueFieldMap_comp_residueFieldMap_of_section (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (y : S) :
    (S.residueFieldCongr (section_apply hs y).symm).hom ≫
        f.residueFieldMap (s y) ≫ s.residueFieldMap y = 𝟙 (S.residueField y)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.residueFieldIsoOfSection
decls.doc:
The residue field of `X` at a point in the image of a section is the residue field of the
base at the corresponding point of the base. The inverse is the residue-field map of the
section.
decls.statement:
def residueFieldIsoOfSection (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (y : S) :
    S.residueField y ≅ X.residueField (s y)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.residueFieldIsoOfSection_hom
decls.doc:
The forward map of `residueFieldIsoOfSection` is the residue-field map of `f`, transported
along `f (s y) = y`.
decls.statement:
lemma residueFieldIsoOfSection_hom (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (y : S) :
    (residueFieldIsoOfSection hs y).hom =
      (S.residueFieldCongr (section_apply hs y).symm).hom ≫ f.residueFieldMap (s y)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.residueFieldIsoOfSection_inv
decls.doc: The inverse of `residueFieldIsoOfSection` is the residue-field map of the section.
decls.statement:
lemma residueFieldIsoOfSection_inv (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (y : S) :
    (residueFieldIsoOfSection hs y).inv = s.residueFieldMap y

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.relativeDegree_ofPoint_of_section
decls.doc:
A prime divisor whose generic point is a rational point has relative degree one.

This is the geometric origin of the weight-one base point hypothesis of the Layer A degree
theory: the weight of a codimension-one point `x` of a curve over `k` is its residue degree
`[κ(x) : k]`, and at a `k`-rational point that weight is one.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.relativeDegree_zsmul_ofPoint_of_section
decls.doc:
A multiple of the prime divisor at a rational point has that multiple as relative degree:
`deg (d · x₀) = d`.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.relativeDegree_sub_zsmul_ofPoint_of_section
decls.doc:
Correcting a divisor by a multiple of a rational point kills its relative degree:
`deg (D - (deg D) · x₀) = 0`.

Over a base point of relative degree one, every Weil divisor becomes relative degree zero after
subtracting its own degree times that point. Only this equality of relative degrees is proved
here: no map on divisor classes is constructed.
decls.statement:
theorem relativeDegree_sub_zsmul_ofPoint_of_section (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 S) {y : S}
    {x₀ : CodimensionOnePoint X} (hx₀ : (x₀ : X) = s y) (D : SchemeWeilDivisor X) :
    SchemeWeilDivisor.relativeDegree f
        (D - SchemeWeilDivisor.relativeDegree f D • WeilDivisor.ofPoint x₀) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.residueDegree_comp
decls.doc:
The residue degree of a composite is the product of the successive residue degrees:
`[κ(x) : κ(g(f(x)))] = [κ(f(x)) : κ(g(f(x)))] [κ(x) : κ(f(x))]`.
decls.statement:
theorem residueDegree_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (x : X) :
    (f ≫ g).residueDegree x = g.residueDegree (f x) * f.residueDegree x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.residueDegree_pos_iff
decls.doc: A residue degree is positive exactly when the associated residue-field extension is finite.
decls.statement:
theorem residueDegree_pos_iff (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X) :
    0 < f.residueDegree x ↔
      (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.Finite

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.residueDegree_ne_zero_iff
decls.doc: A residue degree is nonzero exactly when the associated residue-field extension is finite.
decls.statement:
theorem residueDegree_ne_zero_iff (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X) :
    f.residueDegree x ≠ 0 ↔
      (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.Finite

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.residueDegree_eq_one_iff
decls.doc: A residue-field map is bijective exactly when its residue degree is one.
decls.statement:
theorem residueDegree_eq_one_iff (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X) :
    f.residueDegree x = 1 ↔ Function.Bijective (f.residueFieldMap x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.residueDegree_eq_one_of_isIso
decls.doc: An isomorphism of schemes has residue degree one at every point.
decls.statement:
theorem residueDegree_eq_one_of_isIso (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso f] (x : X) :
    f.residueDegree x = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass
decls.doc:
The weighted abstract Abel-Jacobi class of a point.

For a geometric weight `w x = [κ(x) : k]` and a rational base point `x₀` (`w x₀ = 1`), this is
the class of `[x] - w(x)[x₀]` in the abstract weighted-degree-zero Picard group.
decls.statement:
def weightedAbelJacobiClass (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) : picZero w hdeg

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.coe_weightedAbelJacobiClass
decls.doc:
Coercing the weighted Abel-Jacobi class to the class group gives the divisor class of the
degree-corrected point divisor. This is the canonical simp form for the subtype coercion.
decls.statement:
lemma coe_weightedAbelJacobiClass (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x : S.ClassGroup) =
      S.divisorClass (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_base
decls.doc: The weighted abstract Abel-Jacobi class of the base point is zero.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_base (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x₀ = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_eq_iff_divisorClass
decls.doc: Equality of weighted Abel-Jacobi classes is equality of the corresponding divisor classes.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_eq_iff_divisorClass (w : X → ℤ)
    (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) {x y : X} :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x = S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ y ↔
      S.divisorClass (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x) =
        S.divisorClass (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ y)
