decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
decls.doc:
Equality of weighted Abel-Jacobi classes is linear equivalence of the corresponding
degree-corrected point divisors.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent (w : X → ℤ)
    (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) {x y : X} :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x = S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ y ↔
      S.LinearlyEquivalent (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x)
        (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ y)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection_divisorClass_ofPoint
decls.doc:
Correcting the degree of the point class `[x]` by the base point `x₀` gives exactly the
class-group representative of the weighted Abel-Jacobi class of `x`.
decls.statement:
lemma degreeCorrection_divisorClass_ofPoint (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ (S.divisorClass (ofPoint x)) =
      (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x : S.ClassGroup)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_divisorClass_ofPoint
decls.doc:
Under the splitting `Cl(X) ≃+ Pic⁰ × ℤ`, the class of the point divisor `[x]` has
`Pic⁰` component the weighted Abel-Jacobi class of `x`, and degree component `w x`.
decls.statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_divisorClass_ofPoint (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    S.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt w h hx₀ (S.divisorClass (ofPoint x)) =
      (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x, w x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_coe_weightedAbelJacobiClass
decls.doc:
Under the splitting `Cl(X) ≃+ Pic⁰ × ℤ`, a coerced weighted Abel-Jacobi class has degree
zero and `Pic⁰` component itself.
decls.statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_coe_weightedAbelJacobiClass (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    S.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt w h hx₀
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x : S.ClassGroup) =
      (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x, 0)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_divisorClass_weightedPointBaseDifference
decls.doc:
The degree-corrected point divisor `[x] - w(x)[x₀]` maps to the weighted Abel-Jacobi class
and degree `0` under the splitting `Cl(X) ≃+ Pic⁰ × ℤ`.
decls.statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_divisorClass_weightedPointBaseDifference
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    S.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt w h hx₀
        (S.divisorClass (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x)) =
      (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x, 0)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_symm_weightedAbelJacobiClass
decls.doc:
The inverse splitting reconstructs the point class `[x]` from its weighted Abel-Jacobi
component and its degree `w x`.
decls.statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_symm_weightedAbelJacobiClass (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    (S.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt w h hx₀).symm
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x, w x) =
      S.divisorClass (ofPoint x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofFinsupp
decls.doc:
The weighted Abel-Jacobi sum of a divisor from finitely supported natural multiplicities is
the finite sum of the point Abel-Jacobi classes with those multiplicities.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofFinsupp (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (m : X →₀ ℕ) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (ofFinsupp m) =
      ∑ x ∈ m.support, (m x : ℤ) • S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity
decls.doc:
The weighted Abel-Jacobi sum of a finite-set divisor with multiplicities is the finite sum
of the point Abel-Jacobi classes with those multiplicities.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (s : Finset X)
    (m : X → ℕ) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (ofFinsetWithMultiplicity s m) =
      ∑ x ∈ s, (m x : ℤ) • S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofFinset
decls.doc:
The weighted Abel-Jacobi sum of a coefficient-one finite-set divisor is the sum of the
point Abel-Jacobi classes over the finite set.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofFinset (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (s : Finset X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (ofFinset s) =
      ∑ x ∈ s, S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_cast
decls.doc:
Changing only the degree index of a fixed-degree divisor does not change its weighted
Abel-Jacobi class.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_cast (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) {d e : ℕ} (hde : d = e)
    (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀
        (WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast hde D : WeilDivisor X) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (D : WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_effectiveDivisorOfDegree_zero
decls.doc: The weighted Abel-Jacobi class of the zero effective divisor is zero.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_effectiveDivisorOfDegree_zero (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.zero X) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_effectiveDivisorOfDegree_add
decls.doc:
Adding fixed-degree effective divisors sends their weighted Abel-Jacobi class to the sum
of the two classes.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_effectiveDivisorOfDegree_add (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.add D E) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (D : WeilDivisor X) +
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (E : WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofSym_append
decls.doc:
Appending symmetric-power divisors sends their weighted Abel-Jacobi class to the sum of
the two classes.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofSym_append (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (s : Sym X d) (t : Sym X e) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym (s.append t)) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym s) +
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym t)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_effectiveDivisorOfDegree_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
decls.doc:
For effective divisors of the same fixed degree, equality of normalized Abel-Jacobi
classes is exactly linear equivalence of the underlying divisors.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_effectiveDivisorOfDegree_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
    (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero) (x₀ : X)
    (D E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) h (x₀ := x₀) rfl
        (D : WeilDivisor X) =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) h (x₀ := x₀) rfl
          (E : WeilDivisor X) ↔
      S.LinearlyEquivalent (D : WeilDivisor X) E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_effectiveDivisorOfDegree_eq_iff_mem_completeLinearSystem
decls.doc:
The fixed-degree Abel-Jacobi fiber through `D` is the complete linear system `|D|`, restricted
to effective divisors of the same degree.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_effectiveDivisorOfDegree_eq_iff_mem_completeLinearSystem
    (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero) (x₀ : X)
    (D E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) h (x₀ := x₀) rfl
        (E : WeilDivisor X) =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) h (x₀ := x₀) rfl
          (D : WeilDivisor X) ↔
      (E : WeilDivisor X) ∈ S.completeLinearSystem (D : WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.setOf_weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_effectiveDivisorOfDegree_eq
decls.doc:
As a set of fixed-degree effective divisors, the Abel-Jacobi fiber through `D` is the
restriction of the complete linear system `|D|`.
decls.statement:
lemma setOf_weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_effectiveDivisorOfDegree_eq
    (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero) (x₀ : X)
    (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    {E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d |
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) h (x₀ := x₀) rfl
          (E : WeilDivisor X) =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) h (x₀ := x₀) rfl
          (D : WeilDivisor X)} =
      {E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d |
        (E : WeilDivisor X) ∈ S.completeLinearSystem (D : WeilDivisor X)}

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_ofSym_eq_iff_mem_completeLinearSystem
decls.doc:
On symmetric powers, equality of normalized Abel-Jacobi classes is exactly membership of the
corresponding divisor in the complete linear system.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_ofSym_eq_iff_mem_completeLinearSystem
    (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero) (x₀ : X) (s t : Sym X d) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) h (x₀ := x₀) rfl
        (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym t : WeilDivisor X) =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) h (x₀ := x₀) rfl
          (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym s : WeilDivisor X) ↔
      (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym t : WeilDivisor X) ∈
        S.completeLinearSystem (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym s : WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.setOf_weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_ofSym_eq
decls.doc:
As a set of symmetric-power points, the Abel-Jacobi fiber through `s` is the preimage of the
complete linear system `|ofSym s|`.
decls.statement:
lemma setOf_weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_ofSym_eq
    (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero) (x₀ : X) (s : Sym X d) :
    {t : Sym X d |
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) h (x₀ := x₀) rfl
          (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym t : WeilDivisor X) =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) h (x₀ := x₀) rfl
          (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym s : WeilDivisor X)} =
      {t : Sym X d |
        (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym t : WeilDivisor X) ∈
          S.completeLinearSystem (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym s : WeilDivisor X)}

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass
decls.doc:
The quotient class of the degree-corrected representative
`D - weightedDegree(D) • [x₀]`.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_mk_def
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_mk_def (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (weightedAbelJacobiDegreeZeroDivisor w hx₀ D)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_mk
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_mk (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (weightedAbelJacobiDegreeZeroDivisor w hx₀ D)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_add
decls.doc:
The quotient Abel-Jacobi representative of a sum is the sum of the quotient
representatives.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_add (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    (D E : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ (D + E) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D +
        S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_zsmul
decls.doc:
The quotient Abel-Jacobi representative of an integral multiple is the corresponding
multiple of the quotient representative.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_zsmul (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    (n : ℤ) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ (n • D) =
      n • S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero_weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass
decls.doc:
The quotient representative maps to the weighted Abel-Jacobi divisor class under the
degree-zero quotient equivalence.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero_weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero w h
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero_weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_ofPoint
decls.doc: For point divisors, the quotient representative maps to the point Abel-Jacobi class.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero_weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_ofPoint
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    S.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero w h
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ (ofPoint x)) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_eq_sum
decls.doc:
The quotient Abel-Jacobi representative of a finitely supported formal divisor is the
finite sum of the quotient representatives of its point divisors.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_eq_sum (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D =
      D.sum fun x n => n • S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ (ofPoint x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_ofPoint_base
decls.doc: The base-point divisor represents zero in the degree-zero quotient.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_ofPoint_base (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ (ofPoint x₀) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_principalDivisor
decls.doc: A principal divisor has zero weighted quotient Abel-Jacobi representative.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_principalDivisor (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (g : G) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ (S.principalDivisor g) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_eq_iff_divisorClass
decls.doc:
Equality of weighted quotient Abel-Jacobi representatives is equality of the corresponding
degree-corrected divisor classes.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_eq_iff_divisorClass
    (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ E ↔
      S.divisorClass (D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀) =
        S.divisorClass (E - weightedDegree w E • ofPoint x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
decls.doc:
Equality of weighted quotient Abel-Jacobi representatives is linear equivalence of the
corresponding degree-corrected divisors.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
    (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ E ↔
      S.LinearlyEquivalent (D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀)
        (E - weightedDegree w E • ofPoint x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_change_base
decls.doc:
Changing the base point in the weighted Abel-Jacobi sum adds the weighted degree times the
base-point-change class.

Geometrically, for the residue-degree weight and rational base points `x₀`, `y₀`, this is the
formal divisor-class identity
`[D - deg(D)y₀] = [D - deg(D)x₀] + deg(D)[x₀ - y₀]` in `Pic⁰`.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_change_base (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hy₀ D =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D +
        weightedDegree w D • S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w h (hx₀.trans hy₀.symm)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_sub_change_base_coe
decls.doc:
In the class group, the difference between weighted Abel-Jacobi divisor sums with two
base points is the weighted degree times the class `[x₀] - [y₀]`.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_sub_change_base_coe (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    (S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hy₀ D : S.ClassGroup) -
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D : S.ClassGroup) =
      weightedDegree w D • S.divisorClass (pointDifference x₀ y₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_of_weightedDegree_eq_zero
decls.doc:
If a divisor has weighted degree zero, its weighted Abel-Jacobi sum is independent of the
choice of weight-one base point.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_of_weightedDegree_eq_zero (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1)
    {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : weightedDegree w D = 0) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hy₀ D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass
decls.doc:
The additive Abel-Jacobi sum of a Weil divisor.

For a divisor `D`, this is the class of `D - weightedDegree w D • [x₀]` in the abstract
weighted-degree-zero Picard group. On point divisors it recovers `weightedAbelJacobiClass`,
and on finite sums it is the corresponding sum of point Abel-Jacobi classes.
decls.statement:
def weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) : WeilDivisor X →+ picZero w h

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.coe_weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_apply
decls.doc:
Coercing the weighted Abel-Jacobi sum to the class group gives the divisor class of
`D - weightedDegree w D • [x₀]`. This is the canonical class-group form of the construction.
decls.statement:
lemma coe_weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_apply (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    (S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D : S.ClassGroup) =
      S.divisorClass (D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofPoint_base
decls.doc: The weighted Abel-Jacobi sum is zero on the base-point divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofPoint_base (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (ofPoint x₀) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofPoint
decls.doc: On a point divisor, the Abel-Jacobi sum is the point Abel-Jacobi class.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofPoint (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (ofPoint x) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_add
decls.doc: The Abel-Jacobi sum of a sum of divisors is the sum of their Abel-Jacobi sums.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_add (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (D E : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (D + E) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D +
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_zsmul
decls.doc:
The Abel-Jacobi sum of an integral multiple of a divisor is the corresponding multiple of
the Abel-Jacobi sum.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_zsmul (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (n : ℤ) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (n • D) =
      n • S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_sum
decls.doc:
The Abel-Jacobi sum of a finitely supported formal divisor is the finite sum of the
point Abel-Jacobi classes weighted by the divisor coefficients.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_sum (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D =
      D.sum fun x n => n • S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_iff_divisorClass
decls.doc:
Equality of weighted Abel-Jacobi sums is equality of the corresponding degree-corrected
divisor classes.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_iff_divisorClass
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ E ↔
      S.divisorClass (D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀) =
        S.divisorClass (E - weightedDegree w E • ofPoint x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
decls.doc:
Equality of weighted Abel-Jacobi sums is linear equivalence of the corresponding
degree-corrected divisors.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ E ↔
      S.LinearlyEquivalent (D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀)
        (E - weightedDegree w E • ofPoint x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent_of_weightedDegree_eq
decls.doc:
If two divisors have the same weighted degree, equality of their weighted Abel-Jacobi
classes is exactly linear equivalence of the original divisors.

The equal-degree hypothesis is essential: the Abel-Jacobi class only records the `Pic⁰`
component of the divisor class after subtracting the same degree from the chosen base point.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent_of_weightedDegree_eq
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hDE : weightedDegree w D = weightedDegree w E) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ E ↔
      S.LinearlyEquivalent D E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent_of_degree_eq
decls.doc:
In the unweighted theory, equal-degree divisors have the same Abel-Jacobi class exactly when
they are linearly equivalent.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent_of_degree_eq
    (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero) (x₀ : X) {D E : WeilDivisor X}
    (hDE : degree D = degree E) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) h (x₀ := x₀) rfl D =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) h (x₀ := x₀) rfl E ↔
      S.LinearlyEquivalent D E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_of_linearlyEquivalent
decls.doc:
The Abel-Jacobi sum is invariant under linear equivalence of divisors with the same
weighted degree.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_of_linearlyEquivalent
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hlin : S.LinearlyEquivalent D E) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_divisorClass
decls.doc:
Under the splitting `Cl(X) ≃+ Pic⁰ × ℤ`, the class of a divisor has `Pic⁰` component
its weighted Abel-Jacobi sum and degree component its weighted degree.
decls.statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_divisorClass (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt w h hx₀ (S.divisorClass D) =
      (S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D, weightedDegree w D)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_symm_weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass
decls.doc:
The inverse splitting reconstructs the divisor class from its weighted Abel-Jacobi sum and
weighted degree.
decls.statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_symm_weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    (S.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt w h hx₀).symm
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D, weightedDegree w D) =
      S.divisorClass D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_principalDivisor
decls.doc: A principal divisor has zero Abel-Jacobi sum.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_principalDivisor (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (g : G) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (S.principalDivisor g) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedBasepointChangeClass
decls.doc:
The degree-zero class `[x₀] - [y₀]` measuring the translation between two equal-weight
base points.
decls.statement:
def weightedBasepointChangeClass (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ y₀ : X} (hxy : w x₀ = w y₀) : picZero w hdeg

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.coe_weightedBasepointChangeClass
decls.statement:
lemma coe_weightedBasepointChangeClass (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ y₀ : X} (hxy : w x₀ = w y₀) :
    (S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg hxy : S.ClassGroup) =
      S.divisorClass (pointDifference x₀ y₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedBasepointChangeClass_self
decls.statement:
lemma weightedBasepointChangeClass_self (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} :
    S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg (x₀ := x₀) rfl = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedBasepointChangeClass_swap
decls.doc: Reversing the two base points negates the base-point-change class.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedBasepointChangeClass_swap (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ y₀ : X} (hxy : w x₀ = w y₀) :
    S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg hxy.symm =
      -S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg hxy

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedBasepointChangeClass_add
decls.doc:
Base-point-change classes compose: the translation from `x₀` to `z₀` is the sum of the
translations from `x₀` to `y₀` and from `y₀` to `z₀`.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedBasepointChangeClass_add (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ y₀ z₀ : X} (hxy : w x₀ = w y₀) (hyz : w y₀ = w z₀) :
    S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg hxy +
        S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg hyz =
      S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg (hxy.trans hyz)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_change_base
decls.doc:
Changing the Abel-Jacobi base point from `x₀` to `y₀` adds `w x` times the class
`[x₀] - [y₀]`. For the geometric specialization, `w x` is the residue-field degree.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_change_base (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hy₀ x =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x +
      w x • S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg (hx₀.trans hy₀.symm)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_oldBase_eq_basepointChangeClass
decls.doc:
The base-point-change class is the Abel-Jacobi class of the old base point with respect to
the new base point.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_oldBase_eq_basepointChangeClass (w : X → ℤ)
    (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hy₀ x₀ =
      S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg (hx₀.trans hy₀.symm)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedBasepointChangeClass_eq_abelJacobiClass
decls.doc:
The base-point-change class equals the Abel-Jacobi class of the old base point with respect
to the new base point.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedBasepointChangeClass_eq_abelJacobiClass (w : X → ℤ)
    (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1) :
    S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg (hx₀.trans hy₀.symm) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hy₀ x₀

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_sub_change_base_coe
decls.doc:
In the class group, the difference between two weighted Abel-Jacobi classes with different
base points is `w(x)` times the class `[x₀] - [y₀]`.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_sub_change_base_coe (w : X → ℤ)
    (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1)
    (x : X) :
    (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hy₀ x : S.ClassGroup) -
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x : S.ClassGroup) =
      w x • S.divisorClass (pointDifference x₀ y₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_sub_coe
decls.doc:
The difference between two weighted Abel-Jacobi classes with the same base point is the
class `[x] - [y]` when the two points have equal weight.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_sub_coe (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ x y : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hxy : w x = w y) :
    (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x : S.ClassGroup) -
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ y : S.ClassGroup) =
      S.divisorClass (pointDifference x y)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor
decls.doc: A Weil divisor on a type of points `X` is a finite formal integer sum of points of `X`.
decls.statement: abbrev WeilDivisor (X : Type*) : Type _

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff
decls.doc: The coefficient of a point in a Weil divisor.
decls.statement: def coeff (D : WeilDivisor X) (x : X) : ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_zero
decls.statement: lemma coeff_zero (x : X) : coeff (0 : WeilDivisor X) x = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_add
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_add (D E : WeilDivisor X) (x : X) :
    coeff (D + E) x = coeff D x + coeff E x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_neg
decls.statement: lemma coeff_neg (D : WeilDivisor X) (x : X) : coeff (-D) x = -coeff D x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_sub
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_sub (D E : WeilDivisor X) (x : X) :
    coeff (D - E) x = coeff D x - coeff E x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ext
decls.statement: lemma ext {D E : WeilDivisor X} (h : ∀ x, coeff D x = coeff E x) : D = E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.mem_support_iff
decls.doc:
A point lies in the support of a Weil divisor exactly when its coefficient is nonzero. This
is the `coeff`-level restatement of `Finsupp.mem_support_iff`.
decls.statement: lemma mem_support_iff {D : WeilDivisor X} {x : X} : x ∈ D.support ↔ coeff D x ≠ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofPoint
decls.doc: The prime/point divisor supported at a single point with coefficient `1`.
decls.statement: def ofPoint (x : X) : WeilDivisor X

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_ofPoint_self
decls.statement: lemma coeff_ofPoint_self (x : X) : coeff (ofPoint x) x = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_ofPoint_of_ne
decls.statement: lemma coeff_ofPoint_of_ne {x y : X} (h : y ≠ x) : coeff (ofPoint x) y = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.support_ofPoint
decls.statement: lemma support_ofPoint (x : X) : (ofPoint x).support = {x}

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.single_eq_zsmul_ofPoint
decls.doc:
The scaled point divisor `b • ofPoint a` is the single spike `Finsupp.single a b`. This is the
`ofPoint`/`Finsupp.single` bridge in its integer-scaled form, shared by the divisor files that
expand a divisor into its point contributions.
decls.statement:
lemma single_eq_zsmul_ofPoint (a : X) (b : ℤ) :
    (Finsupp.single a b : WeilDivisor X) = b • ofPoint a

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.IsEffective
decls.doc: A divisor is effective when every coefficient is nonnegative.
decls.statement: def IsEffective (D : WeilDivisor X) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.isEffective_iff
decls.statement: lemma isEffective_iff (D : WeilDivisor X) : IsEffective D ↔ ∀ x, 0 ≤ coeff D x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.isEffective_zero
decls.statement: lemma isEffective_zero : IsEffective (0 : WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.IsEffective.add
decls.statement:
lemma IsEffective.add {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D) (hE : IsEffective E) :
    IsEffective (D + E)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.IsEffective.nsmul
decls.statement:
lemma IsEffective.nsmul {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D) (n : ℕ) :
    IsEffective (n • D)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.IsEffective.exists_pos_coeff_of_ne_zero
decls.doc: A nonzero effective divisor has some point with positive coefficient.
decls.statement:
lemma IsEffective.exists_pos_coeff_of_ne_zero {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D)
    (hD0 : D ≠ 0) : ∃ x, 0 < coeff D x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.isEffective_ofPoint
decls.statement: lemma isEffective_ofPoint (x : X) : IsEffective (ofPoint x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.effectiveSubmonoid
decls.doc: Effective Weil divisors form an additive submonoid of the group of all Weil divisors.
decls.statement: def effectiveSubmonoid (X : Type*) : AddSubmonoid (WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.mem_effectiveSubmonoid
decls.statement:
lemma mem_effectiveSubmonoid (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    D ∈ effectiveSubmonoid X ↔ IsEffective D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforward
decls.doc:
Push forward a formal divisor along a map of point sets by summing coefficients over
fibres.  Geometric pushforward of Weil divisors will specialize this once the relevant point
maps and residue-degree factors are available.
decls.statement: def pushforward (f : X → Y) : WeilDivisor X →+ WeilDivisor Y

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforward_apply
decls.doc:
The explicit unfolding equation for formal pushforward: `pushforward f D` is `D.mapDomain f`.
Use this for manual rewriting rather than as a simp normal form.
decls.statement:
lemma pushforward_apply (f : X → Y) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    pushforward f D = D.mapDomain f

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_pushforward
decls.doc:
The coefficient of the pushed-forward divisor at `y` is the sum of the coefficients over
the fibre of `f` above `y`.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_pushforward [DecidableEq Y] (f : X → Y) (D : WeilDivisor X) (y : Y) :
    coeff (pushforward f D) y = ∑ x ∈ D.support with f x = y, coeff D x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforward_zero
decls.statement: lemma pushforward_zero (f : X → Y) : pushforward f (0 : WeilDivisor X) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforward_add
decls.statement:
lemma pushforward_add (f : X → Y) (D E : WeilDivisor X) :
    pushforward f (D + E) = pushforward f D + pushforward f E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforward_ofPoint
decls.statement:
lemma pushforward_ofPoint (f : X → Y) (x : X) :
    pushforward f (ofPoint x) = ofPoint (f x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforward_id
decls.statement: lemma pushforward_id : pushforward (fun x : X => x) = AddMonoidHom.id (WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforward_comp
decls.statement:
lemma pushforward_comp (g : Y → Z) (f : X → Y) :
    pushforward (g ∘ f) = (pushforward g).comp (pushforward f)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.IsEffective.pushforward
decls.statement:
lemma IsEffective.pushforward {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D) (f : X → Y) :
    IsEffective (pushforward f D)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforward_mem_effectiveSubmonoid
decls.statement:
lemma pushforward_mem_effectiveSubmonoid {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : D ∈ effectiveSubmonoid X)
    (f : X → Y) : pushforward f D ∈ effectiveSubmonoid Y

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree
decls.doc:
The unweighted degree of a Weil divisor, summing its coefficients.  On a curve over a
non-algebraically-closed field, use `weightedDegree` with residue-field degrees instead.
decls.statement: def degree : WeilDivisor X →+ ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_apply
decls.statement: lemma degree_apply (D : WeilDivisor X) : degree D = ∑ x ∈ D.support, D x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_zero
decls.statement: lemma degree_zero : degree (0 : WeilDivisor X) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_add
decls.statement: lemma degree_add (D E : WeilDivisor X) : degree (D + E) = degree D + degree E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_neg
decls.statement: lemma degree_neg (D : WeilDivisor X) : degree (-D) = -degree D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_sub
decls.statement: lemma degree_sub (D E : WeilDivisor X) : degree (D - E) = degree D - degree E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_ofPoint
decls.statement: lemma degree_ofPoint (x : X) : degree (ofPoint x) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_pushforward
decls.statement:
lemma degree_pushforward (f : X → Y) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    degree (pushforward f D) = degree D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_surjective
decls.doc:
On a nonempty point type the unweighted degree map is surjective: a single point has degree
`1`, so its integer multiples realise every degree.
decls.statement: lemma degree_surjective [Nonempty X] : Function.Surjective (degree : WeilDivisor X →+ ℤ)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_range_eq_top
decls.doc: On a nonempty point type the unweighted degree map hits all of `ℤ`.
decls.statement: lemma degree_range_eq_top [Nonempty X] : (degree : WeilDivisor X →+ ℤ).range = ⊤

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree
decls.doc:
The weighted degree of a Weil divisor against an integer-valued weight on points.

For a curve over `k`, the intended weight is `x ↦ [κ(x) : k]`.
decls.statement: def weightedDegree (w : X → ℤ) : WeilDivisor X →+ ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_apply
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_apply (w : X → ℤ) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    weightedDegree w D = D.sum fun x n => n * w x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_zero
decls.statement: lemma weightedDegree_zero (w : X → ℤ) : weightedDegree w (0 : WeilDivisor X) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_add
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_add (w : X → ℤ) (D E : WeilDivisor X) :
    weightedDegree w (D + E) = weightedDegree w D + weightedDegree w E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_neg
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_neg (w : X → ℤ) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    weightedDegree w (-D) = -weightedDegree w D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_sub
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_sub (w : X → ℤ) (D E : WeilDivisor X) :
    weightedDegree w (D - E) = weightedDegree w D - weightedDegree w E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_ofPoint
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_ofPoint (w : X → ℤ) (x : X) :
    weightedDegree w (ofPoint x) = w x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_pushforward
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_pushforward (wY : Y → ℤ) (f : X → Y) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    weightedDegree wY (pushforward f D) = weightedDegree (wY ∘ f) D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_range
decls.doc:
The image of the weighted degree homomorphism is the subgroup of `ℤ` generated by the
weights. The point divisors generate the free abelian group of Weil divisors and
`weightedDegree w (ofPoint x) = w x`, so the image is `AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range w)`; being
a subgroup of `ℤ`, it is `d·ℤ` for a unique `d ≥ 0`, the index of the weights.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_range (w : X → ℤ) :
    (weightedDegree w : WeilDivisor X →+ ℤ).range = AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range w)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.IsEffective.weightedDegree_nonneg
decls.doc: An effective divisor has nonnegative weighted degree when all weights are nonnegative.
decls.statement:
lemma IsEffective.weightedDegree_nonneg {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x)
    {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D) : 0 ≤ weightedDegree w D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.IsEffective.weightedDegree_eq_zero_iff_of_pos_on_support
decls.doc:
With strictly positive weights on the support, an effective divisor has weighted degree
zero iff it is zero.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.IsEffective.eq_zero_of_weightedDegree_eq_zero_of_pos_on_support
decls.doc:
With strictly positive weights on the support, an effective divisor of weighted degree zero
is zero.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.IsEffective.weightedDegree_eq_zero_iff_of_pos
decls.doc:
With strictly positive weights, an effective divisor has weighted degree zero iff it is
zero.
decls.statement:
lemma IsEffective.weightedDegree_eq_zero_iff_of_pos {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x)
    {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D) :
    weightedDegree w D = 0 ↔ D = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.IsEffective.eq_zero_of_weightedDegree_eq_zero_of_pos
decls.doc: With strictly positive weights, an effective divisor of weighted degree zero is zero.
decls.statement:
lemma IsEffective.eq_zero_of_weightedDegree_eq_zero_of_pos {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x)
    {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D) (hdeg : weightedDegree w D = 0) : D = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.IsEffective.weightedDegree_pos_of_pos
decls.doc: With strictly positive weights, a nonzero effective divisor has positive weighted degree.
decls.statement:
lemma IsEffective.weightedDegree_pos_of_pos {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x)
    {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D) (hD0 : D ≠ 0) :
    0 < weightedDegree w D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_one_eq_degree
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_one_eq_degree (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    weightedDegree (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) D = degree D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.IsEffective.degree_nonneg
decls.doc: An effective divisor has nonnegative degree.
decls.statement:
lemma IsEffective.degree_nonneg {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D) :
    0 ≤ degree D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.IsEffective.degree_eq_zero_iff
decls.doc: An effective divisor has degree zero iff it is zero.
decls.statement:
lemma IsEffective.degree_eq_zero_iff {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D) :
    degree D = 0 ↔ D = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.IsEffective.eq_zero_of_degree_eq_zero
decls.doc: An effective divisor of degree zero is zero.
decls.statement:
lemma IsEffective.eq_zero_of_degree_eq_zero {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D)
    (hdeg : degree D = 0) : D = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.IsEffective.degree_pos
decls.doc: A nonzero effective divisor has positive degree.
decls.statement:
lemma IsEffective.degree_pos {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D) (hD0 : D ≠ 0) :
    0 < degree D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degreeZeroSubgroup
decls.doc:
The subgroup of divisors of unweighted degree zero.

For a smooth proper curve over an algebraically closed field this is the formal divisor group
whose quotient by principal divisors gives the abstract degree-zero Picard group. Over a
general field, use `weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup` with residue-field degrees as weights.
decls.statement: def degreeZeroSubgroup (X : Type*) : AddSubgroup (WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.mem_degreeZeroSubgroup
decls.statement:
lemma mem_degreeZeroSubgroup (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    D ∈ degreeZeroSubgroup X ↔ degree D = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_coe_degreeZeroSubgroup
decls.statement:
lemma degree_coe_degreeZeroSubgroup (D : degreeZeroSubgroup X) :
    degree (D : WeilDivisor X) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coe_degreeZeroSubgroup_eq_zero_of_isEffective
decls.doc: An effective divisor lying in the unweighted degree-zero subgroup is zero.
decls.statement:
lemma coe_degreeZeroSubgroup_eq_zero_of_isEffective {D : degreeZeroSubgroup X}
    (hD : IsEffective (D : WeilDivisor X)) : (D : WeilDivisor X) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pointDifference
decls.doc: The formal divisor `[x] - [y]`, a basic source of degree-zero divisors.
decls.statement: def pointDifference (x y : X) : WeilDivisor X

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pointDifference_self
decls.statement: lemma pointDifference_self (x : X) : pointDifference x x = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pointDifference_add_pointDifference_cancel
decls.doc: Point differences telescope additively: `[x] - [y] + ([y] - [z]) = [x] - [z]`.
decls.statement:
lemma pointDifference_add_pointDifference_cancel (x y z : X) :
    pointDifference x y + pointDifference y z = pointDifference x z

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pointDifference_swap
decls.doc: Reversing a point difference negates it.
decls.statement: lemma pointDifference_swap (x y : X) : pointDifference y x = -pointDifference x y

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_pointDifference_left
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_pointDifference_left (x y : X) :
    coeff (pointDifference x y) x = 1 - coeff (ofPoint y) x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_pointDifference_right
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_pointDifference_right (x y : X) :
    coeff (pointDifference x y) y = coeff (ofPoint x) y - 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_pointDifference
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_pointDifference [DecidableEq X] (x y z : X) :
    coeff (pointDifference x y) z =
      (if z = x then 1 else 0) - (if z = y then 1 else 0)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.support_pointDifference_subset
decls.statement:
lemma support_pointDifference_subset [DecidableEq X] (x y : X) :
    (pointDifference x y).support ⊆ {x, y}

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_pointDifference
decls.statement: lemma degree_pointDifference (x y : X) : degree (pointDifference x y) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_pointDifference
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_pointDifference (w : X → ℤ) (x y : X) :
    weightedDegree w (pointDifference x y) = w x - w y

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pointDifference_mem_degreeZeroSubgroup
decls.statement:
lemma pointDifference_mem_degreeZeroSubgroup (x y : X) :
    pointDifference x y ∈ degreeZeroSubgroup X

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforward_pointDifference
decls.statement:
lemma pushforward_pointDifference (f : X → Y) (x y : X) :
    pushforward f (pointDifference x y) = pointDifference (f x) (f y)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforwardDegreeZero
decls.doc: Pushforward as a homomorphism on unweighted degree-zero divisors.
decls.statement:
def pushforwardDegreeZero (f : X → Y) :
    degreeZeroSubgroup X →+ degreeZeroSubgroup Y

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforwardDegreeZero_apply
decls.statement:
lemma pushforwardDegreeZero_apply (f : X → Y) (D : degreeZeroSubgroup X) :
    (pushforwardDegreeZero f D : WeilDivisor Y) = pushforward f D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforwardDegreeZero_id
decls.statement:
lemma pushforwardDegreeZero_id :
    pushforwardDegreeZero (fun x : X => x) = AddMonoidHom.id (degreeZeroSubgroup X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforwardDegreeZero_comp
decls.statement:
lemma pushforwardDegreeZero_comp (g : Y → Z) (f : X → Y) :
    pushforwardDegreeZero (g ∘ f) =
      (pushforwardDegreeZero g).comp (pushforwardDegreeZero f)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup
decls.doc:
The subgroup of divisors of weighted degree zero for a weight function on points.

For a curve over a field `k`, the intended weight is `x ↦ [κ(x) : k]`, giving the formal
degree-zero divisor group before principal divisors are introduced.
decls.statement: def weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup (w : X → ℤ) : AddSubgroup (WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.mem_weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup
decls.statement:
lemma mem_weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup (w : X → ℤ) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    D ∈ weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w ↔ weightedDegree w D = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_coe_weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_coe_weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup (w : X → ℤ)
    (D : weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w) : weightedDegree w (D : WeilDivisor X) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedAbelJacobiDegreeZeroDivisor
decls.doc:
The degree-corrected representative of a divisor in the weighted degree-zero divisor group.

For a weight-one base point `x₀`, this is `D - weightedDegree(D) • [x₀]`, viewed as a
weighted-degree-zero divisor.
decls.statement:
def weightedAbelJacobiDegreeZeroDivisor (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) : weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coe_weightedAbelJacobiDegreeZeroDivisor_def
decls.statement:
lemma coe_weightedAbelJacobiDegreeZeroDivisor_def (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X}
    (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    (weightedAbelJacobiDegreeZeroDivisor w hx₀ D : WeilDivisor X) =
      D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coe_weightedAbelJacobiDegreeZeroDivisor
decls.statement:
lemma coe_weightedAbelJacobiDegreeZeroDivisor (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X}
    (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    (weightedAbelJacobiDegreeZeroDivisor w hx₀ D : WeilDivisor X) =
      D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coe_weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup_eq_zero_of_isEffective
decls.doc:
For strictly positive weights, an effective divisor lying in the weighted degree-zero
subgroup is zero.
decls.statement:
lemma coe_weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup_eq_zero_of_isEffective {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x)
    {D : weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w} (hD : IsEffective (D : WeilDivisor X)) :
    (D : WeilDivisor X) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pointDifference_mem_weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup
decls.statement:
lemma pointDifference_mem_weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup {w : X → ℤ} {x y : X}
    (h : w x = w y) : pointDifference x y ∈ weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedPointBaseDifference
decls.doc:
The divisor `[x] - w(x)[x₀]`.

For the geometric weight `w x = [κ(x) : k]` and a rational base point `x₀` with `w x₀ = 1`,
this is the degree-zero divisor underlying the Abel-Jacobi class of the closed point `x`.
In the algebraically closed/unweighted specialization, this recovers `pointDifference x x₀`.
decls.statement: def weightedPointBaseDifference (w : X → ℤ) (x₀ x : X) : WeilDivisor X

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedPointBaseDifference_def
decls.statement:
lemma weightedPointBaseDifference_def (w : X → ℤ) (x₀ x : X) :
    weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x = ofPoint x - w x • ofPoint x₀

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedPointBaseDifference_eq_ofPoint_sub_zsmul
decls.doc:
The degree-corrected point divisor is `[x]` minus `w x` copies of the base point `[x₀]`.
This exposes the definition as a public equation for use across modules.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedPointBaseDifference_eq_ofPoint_sub_zsmul (w : X → ℤ) (x₀ x : X) :
    weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x = ofPoint x - w x • ofPoint x₀

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedPointBaseDifference_eq_pointDifference
decls.doc:
At the constant weight `1`, the degree-corrected point divisor is the usual point
difference. This lets unweighted API reuse the weighted construction.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedPointBaseDifference_eq_pointDifference (x₀ x : X) :
    weightedPointBaseDifference (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) x₀ x = pointDifference x x₀

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedPointBaseDifference_eq_pointDifference_of_weight_eq_one
decls.doc:
If the point has weight `1`, the degree-corrected point divisor is the usual point
difference.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedPointBaseDifference_eq_pointDifference_of_weight_eq_one {w : X → ℤ} {x₀ x : X}
    (hx : w x = 1) : weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x = pointDifference x x₀

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_weightedPointBaseDifference
decls.doc:
Coefficients of the degree-corrected point divisor, used as the pointwise simp form of
`weightedPointBaseDifference`.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_weightedPointBaseDifference [DecidableEq X] (w : X → ℤ) (x₀ x y : X) :
    coeff (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x) y =
      (if y = x then 1 else 0) - if y = x₀ then w x else 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.support_weightedPointBaseDifference_subset
decls.doc: The support of `[x] - w(x)[x₀]` is contained in `{x, x₀}`.
decls.statement:
lemma support_weightedPointBaseDifference_subset [DecidableEq X] (w : X → ℤ) (x₀ x : X) :
    (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x).support ⊆ {x, x₀}

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedPointBaseDifference_self
decls.doc: If the base point has weight `1`, the divisor `[x₀] - w(x₀)[x₀]` is zero.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedPointBaseDifference_self {w : X → ℤ} {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) :
    weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x₀ = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_weightedPointBaseDifference
decls.doc: The weighted degree of `[x] - w(x)[x₀]` is `w(x) * (1 - w(x₀))`.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_weightedPointBaseDifference (w : X → ℤ) (x₀ x : X) :
    weightedDegree w (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x) = w x * (1 - w x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedPointBaseDifference_mem_weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup
decls.doc: If the base point has weight `1`, then `[x] - w(x)[x₀]` has weighted degree zero.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedPointBaseDifference_change_base
decls.doc:
Changing the base point in the weighted point-base divisor translates it by
`w(x) • ([x₀] - [y₀])`.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedPointBaseDifference_change_base (w : X → ℤ) (x₀ y₀ x : X) :
    weightedPointBaseDifference w y₀ x =
      weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x + w x • pointDifference x₀ y₀

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedPointBaseDifference_sub_change_base
decls.doc:
The difference between the weighted point-base divisors for two base points is
`w(x) • ([x₀] - [y₀])`.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedPointBaseDifference_sub_change_base (w : X → ℤ) (x₀ y₀ x : X) :
    weightedPointBaseDifference w y₀ x - weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x =
      w x • pointDifference x₀ y₀

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedPointBaseDifference_sub_same_base
decls.doc:
Subtracting two degree-corrected point divisors with the same base point cancels the base
term when the two points have equal weight.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedPointBaseDifference_sub_same_base (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ x y : X} (hxy : w x = w y) :
    weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x - weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ y =
      pointDifference x y

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforwardWeightedDegreeZero
decls.doc:
Pushforward as a homomorphism on weighted degree-zero divisors, when the target weight
pulls back to the source weight.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforwardWeightedDegreeZero_apply
decls.statement:
lemma pushforwardWeightedDegreeZero_apply (wX : X → ℤ) (wY : Y → ℤ) (f : X → Y)
    (hw : ∀ x, wY (f x) = wX x) (D : weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup wX) :
    (pushforwardWeightedDegreeZero wX wY f hw D : WeilDivisor Y) = pushforward f D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforwardWeightedDegreeZero_id
decls.statement:
lemma pushforwardWeightedDegreeZero_id (w : X → ℤ) :
    pushforwardWeightedDegreeZero w w (fun x : X => x) (fun _ => rfl) =
      AddMonoidHom.id (weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforwardWeightedDegreeZero_comp
decls.statement:
lemma pushforwardWeightedDegreeZero_comp (wX : X → ℤ) (wY : Y → ℤ) (wZ : Z → ℤ)
    (f : X → Y) (g : Y → Z) (hf : ∀ x, wY (f x) = wX x)
    (hg : ∀ y, wZ (g y) = wY y) :
    pushforwardWeightedDegreeZero wX wZ (g ∘ f) (fun x => by simp [hg (f x), hf x]) =
      (pushforwardWeightedDegreeZero wY wZ g hg).comp
        (pushforwardWeightedDegreeZero wX wY f hf)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.exists_inf
decls.statement:
lemma exists_inf (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    ∃ F : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X (degree ((D : WeilDivisor X) ⊓ E)).toNat,
      (F : WeilDivisor X) = (D : WeilDivisor X) ⊓ E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.inf
decls.doc:
The common effective part of two fixed-degree effective divisors.

Its underlying Weil divisor is the pointwise minimum `D ⊓ E`; its degree index is the actual
degree of that minimum.
decls.statement:
def inf (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X (degree ((D : WeilDivisor X) ⊓ E)).toNat

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_inf
decls.statement:
lemma coe_inf (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (inf D E : WeilDivisor X) = (D : WeilDivisor X) ⊓ E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coeff_inf
decls.doc: The coefficient of the common part is the minimum of the two coefficients.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_inf (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e)
    (x : X) :
    coeff (inf D E : WeilDivisor X) x =
      coeff (D : WeilDivisor X) x ⊓ coeff (E : WeilDivisor X) x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.multiplicityFinsupp_inf
decls.doc: The multiplicity function of the common part is the pointwise minimum of multiplicities.
decls.statement:
lemma multiplicityFinsupp_inf (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (inf D E).multiplicityFinsupp = D.multiplicityFinsupp ⊓ E.multiplicityFinsupp

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.equivSym_inf
decls.doc:
The symmetric-power representative of the common part is the pointwise minimum of
multiplicity functions.
decls.statement:
lemma equivSym_inf (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    equivSym (inf D E) =
      (letI := Classical.decEq X;
        (Sym.equivNatSum X (degree ((D : WeilDivisor X) ⊓ E)).toNat).symm
          ⟨D.multiplicityFinsupp ⊓ E.multiplicityFinsupp, by
            rw [← multiplicityFinsupp_inf D E]
            exact (inf D E).sum_multiplicityFinsupp⟩)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.inf_le_left
decls.doc: The common part lies below the left input divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma inf_le_left (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (inf D E : WeilDivisor X) ≤ D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.inf_le_right
decls.doc: The common part lies below the right input divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma inf_le_right (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (inf D E : WeilDivisor X) ≤ E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.le_inf
decls.doc: Any Weil divisor below both inputs lies below their common part.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.inf_eq_left
decls.doc: The common part is the left input exactly when the left input is below the right input.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.inf_eq_right
decls.doc: The common part is the right input exactly when the right input is below the left input.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.degree_inf_le_left
decls.doc: The degree of the common part is bounded by the left degree index.
decls.statement:
lemma degree_inf_le_left (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (degree ((D : WeilDivisor X) ⊓ E)).toNat ≤ d

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.degree_inf_le_right
decls.doc: The degree of the common part is bounded by the right degree index.
decls.statement:
lemma degree_inf_le_right (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (degree ((D : WeilDivisor X) ⊓ E)).toNat ≤ e

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.leftResidual
decls.doc:
The residual part of the left divisor after removing the common part.

It is the fixed-degree difference `D - (D ⊓ E)`, available since the common part lies below `D`.
decls.statement:
def leftResidual (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X (d - (degree ((D : WeilDivisor X) ⊓ E)).toNat)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.rightResidual
decls.doc:
The residual part of the right divisor after removing the common part.

It is the fixed-degree difference `E - (D ⊓ E)`, available since the common part lies below `E`.
decls.statement:
def rightResidual (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X (e - (degree ((D : WeilDivisor X) ⊓ E)).toNat)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_leftResidual
decls.statement:
lemma coe_leftResidual (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (leftResidual D E : WeilDivisor X) = (D : WeilDivisor X) - inf D E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_rightResidual
decls.statement:
lemma coe_rightResidual (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (rightResidual D E : WeilDivisor X) = (E : WeilDivisor X) - inf D E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coeff_leftResidual
decls.doc: The coefficient of the left residual is `coeff D x - min (coeff D x) (coeff E x)`.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_leftResidual (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) (x : X) :
    coeff (leftResidual D E : WeilDivisor X) x =
      coeff (D : WeilDivisor X) x -
        (coeff (D : WeilDivisor X) x ⊓ coeff (E : WeilDivisor X) x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coeff_rightResidual
decls.doc: The coefficient of the right residual is `coeff E x - min (coeff D x) (coeff E x)`.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_rightResidual (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) (x : X) :
    coeff (rightResidual D E : WeilDivisor X) x =
      coeff (E : WeilDivisor X) x -
        (coeff (D : WeilDivisor X) x ⊓ coeff (E : WeilDivisor X) x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.multiplicityFinsupp_leftResidual
decls.doc: The multiplicity function of the left residual is the truncated multiplicity difference.
decls.statement:
lemma multiplicityFinsupp_leftResidual (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (leftResidual D E).multiplicityFinsupp =
      D.multiplicityFinsupp - (inf D E).multiplicityFinsupp

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.multiplicityFinsupp_rightResidual
decls.doc: The multiplicity function of the right residual is the truncated multiplicity difference.
decls.statement:
lemma multiplicityFinsupp_rightResidual (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (rightResidual D E).multiplicityFinsupp =
      E.multiplicityFinsupp - (inf D E).multiplicityFinsupp

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.equivSym_leftResidual
decls.doc:
The symmetric-power representative of the left residual is the truncated multiplicity
difference from the left divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma equivSym_leftResidual (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    equivSym (leftResidual D E) =
      (letI := Classical.decEq X;
        (Sym.equivNatSum X (d - (degree ((D : WeilDivisor X) ⊓ E)).toNat)).symm
          ⟨D.multiplicityFinsupp - (inf D E).multiplicityFinsupp, by
            rw [← multiplicityFinsupp_leftResidual D E]
            exact (leftResidual D E).sum_multiplicityFinsupp⟩)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.equivSym_rightResidual
decls.doc:
The symmetric-power representative of the right residual is the truncated multiplicity
difference from the right divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma equivSym_rightResidual (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    equivSym (rightResidual D E) =
      (letI := Classical.decEq X;
        (Sym.equivNatSum X (e - (degree ((D : WeilDivisor X) ⊓ E)).toNat)).symm
          ⟨E.multiplicityFinsupp - (inf D E).multiplicityFinsupp, by
            rw [← multiplicityFinsupp_rightResidual D E]
            exact (rightResidual D E).sum_multiplicityFinsupp⟩)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.leftResidual_inf_rightResidual_eq_zero
decls.doc:
The two residual divisors left after removing the common part are coefficientwise
disjoint.
decls.statement:
lemma leftResidual_inf_rightResidual_eq_zero (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    ((leftResidual D E : WeilDivisor X) ⊓ rightResidual D E) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.leftResidual_add_inf
decls.doc:
Removing the common part from the left divisor and adding it back recovers the left
divisor, up to the natural degree-index cast.
decls.statement:
lemma leftResidual_add_inf (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    add (leftResidual D E) (inf D E) =
      EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast
        (Nat.sub_add_cancel (degree_inf_le_left D E)).symm D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.inf_add_leftResidual
decls.doc:
Adding the common part before the left residual also recovers the left divisor, up to the
natural degree-index cast.
decls.statement:
lemma inf_add_leftResidual (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    add (inf D E) (leftResidual D E) =
      EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast
        (Nat.add_sub_of_le (degree_inf_le_left D E)).symm D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.rightResidual_add_inf
decls.doc:
Removing the common part from the right divisor and adding it back recovers the right
divisor, up to the natural degree-index cast.
decls.statement:
lemma rightResidual_add_inf (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    add (rightResidual D E) (inf D E) =
      EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast
        (Nat.sub_add_cancel (degree_inf_le_right D E)).symm E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.inf_add_rightResidual
decls.doc:
Adding the common part before the right residual also recovers the right divisor, up to the
natural degree-index cast.
decls.statement:
lemma inf_add_rightResidual (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    add (inf D E) (rightResidual D E) =
      EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast
        (Nat.add_sub_of_le (degree_inf_le_right D E)).symm E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.adicOrd
decls.doc:
The order of vanishing `ord_v(f) = -log v(f)` of a nonzero rational function `f : Kˣ` at a
height-one prime `v` of a Dedekind domain `R`, as a homomorphism `Additive Kˣ →+ ℤ`. It is the
additive, sign-flipped form of Mathlib's multiplicative valuation
`IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuationOfNeZero v : Kˣ →* Multiplicative ℤ`; the sign is
chosen so that a uniformizer at `v` has order `+1` (a simple zero) and a pole has negative
order.
decls.statement: def adicOrd (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) : Additive Kˣ →+ ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.log_eq_zero_iff_eq_one
decls.doc:
For a nonzero element `x : ℤᵐ⁰`, its logarithm vanishes exactly when `x = 1`. This is the
shared logarithm fact behind both the `≠ 1` step of the finiteness proof and the support
criterion `mem_support_principalDivisor_iff_valuation_ne_one`.
decls.statement:
lemma log_eq_zero_iff_eq_one {x : ℤᵐ⁰} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    WithZero.log x = 0 ↔ x = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.adicOrd_apply
decls.doc:
The computational form of `adicOrd`: the order at `v` of an element `u : Additive Kˣ` is the
sign-flipped logarithm `-log v(u)` of its `v`-adic valuation, where the underlying rational
function is `(Additive.toMul u : Kˣ) : K`. The minus sign makes a uniformizer have order `+1`.
decls.statement:
lemma adicOrd_apply (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (u : Additive Kˣ) :
    adicOrd R K v u = -WithZero.log (v.valuation K ((Additive.toMul u : Kˣ) : K))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.adicOrd_ofMul
decls.doc:
The computational form of `adicOrd` applied to `Additive.ofMul u` for a multiplicative unit
`u : Kˣ`: it is the sign-flipped logarithm `-log v(u)` of the `v`-adic valuation of `u : K`.
decls.statement:
lemma adicOrd_ofMul (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (u : Kˣ) :
    adicOrd R K v (Additive.ofMul u) = -WithZero.log (v.valuation K (u : K))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.adicOrd_nonneg_iff
decls.doc:
The order `ord_v(f)` is nonnegative exactly when `f` is integral at `v`, i.e. has
valuation at most one.
decls.statement:
lemma adicOrd_nonneg_iff (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (u : Additive Kˣ) :
    0 ≤ adicOrd R K v u ↔ v.valuation K ((Additive.toMul u : Kˣ) : K) ≤ 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.adicOrd_ne_zero_mem_support_union
decls.doc:
A nonzero `v`-adic order means that `v` lies in the support of the function or of its
inverse. This is the implementation helper that drives the finiteness proof of
`OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain`.
decls.statement:
lemma adicOrd_ne_zero_mem_support_union (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (u : Additive Kˣ)
    (h : adicOrd R K v u ≠ 0) :
    v ∈ HeightOneSpectrum.Support R ((Additive.toMul u : Kˣ) : K) ∪
      HeightOneSpectrum.Support R (((Additive.toMul u : Kˣ) : K)⁻¹)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.toPrincipalIdeal_eq_spanSingleton_inv_mul_span_mk'_num
decls.statement:
lemma toPrincipalIdeal_eq_spanSingleton_inv_mul_span_mk'_num (u : Kˣ) (n : R)
    (d : R⁰) (hnd : IsLocalization.mk' K n d = (u : K)) :
    (toPrincipalIdeal R K u : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) =
      FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton R⁰ ((algebraMap R K) (d : R))⁻¹ *
        ↑(Ideal.span {n} : Ideal R)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.valuation_mk'_eq_intValuation_div
decls.statement:
lemma valuation_mk'_eq_intValuation_div (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (n : R) (d : R⁰) :
    v.valuation K (IsLocalization.mk' K n d) =
      v.intValuation n / v.intValuation (d : R)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdeal_count_spanSingleton_eq_neg_log_intValuation
decls.statement:
lemma fractionalIdeal_count_spanSingleton_eq_neg_log_intValuation
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (r : R) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    FractionalIdeal.count K v (FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton R⁰ (algebraMap R K r)) =
      -WithZero.log (v.intValuation r)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdeal_spanSingleton_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
decls.statement:
lemma fractionalIdeal_spanSingleton_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (r : R) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton R⁰ (algebraMap R K r) ≠ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdeal_count_spanSingleton_inv_eq_log_intValuation
decls.statement:
lemma fractionalIdeal_count_spanSingleton_inv_eq_log_intValuation
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (r : R) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    FractionalIdeal.count K v (FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton R⁰ (algebraMap R K r))⁻¹ =
      WithZero.log (v.intValuation r)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdeal_count_spanSingleton_inv_mul_spanSingleton_eq_neg_log_div
decls.statement:
lemma fractionalIdeal_count_spanSingleton_inv_mul_spanSingleton_eq_neg_log_div
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (n d : R) (hn : n ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    FractionalIdeal.count K v
        (FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton R⁰ ((algebraMap R K d)⁻¹) *
          FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton R⁰ (algebraMap R K n)) =
      -WithZero.log (v.intValuation n / v.intValuation d)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdeal_count_toPrincipalIdeal_eq_neg_log_valuation
decls.doc:
Mathlib's exponent of a principal fractional ideal is the sign-flipped logarithm of the
corresponding height-one valuation. Stated at the multiplicative-units level `u : Kˣ`, matching
Mathlib's `toPrincipalIdeal R K : Kˣ →* _`; the order-system/`Additive` form is recovered by
`adicOrd_eq_fractionalIdeal_count`.
decls.statement:
lemma fractionalIdeal_count_toPrincipalIdeal_eq_neg_log_valuation (v : HeightOneSpectrum R)
    (u : Kˣ) :
    FractionalIdeal.count K v
      (toPrincipalIdeal R K u : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) =
        -WithZero.log (v.valuation K (u : K))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.adicOrd_eq_fractionalIdeal_count
decls.doc:
The `v`-adic order of a rational function agrees with Mathlib's exponent of the
corresponding principal fractional ideal.
decls.statement:
lemma adicOrd_eq_fractionalIdeal_count (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (u : Additive Kˣ) :
    adicOrd R K v u =
      FractionalIdeal.count K v
        (toPrincipalIdeal R K (Additive.toMul u) : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain
decls.doc:
The order system of a Dedekind domain `R` with fraction field `K`: its points are the
height-one primes `v` of `R`, the group is the multiplicative group `Kˣ` of nonzero rational
functions, and the order at `v` is the `v`-adic order of vanishing. The finiteness condition is
exactly the statement that a nonzero rational function has zeros and poles at only finitely many
primes.
decls.statement:
def OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain :
    OrderSystem (HeightOneSpectrum R) (Additive Kˣ)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain_ord
decls.doc:
The order map of the Dedekind-domain order system at a height-one prime `v` is the `v`-adic
order of vanishing `adicOrd R K v`.
decls.statement:
lemma OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain_ord (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    (OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).ord v = adicOrd R K v

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_principalDivisor_eq_neg_log_valuation
decls.doc:
The coefficient of the principal divisor of `f : Kˣ` at a height-one prime `v` is the
`v`-adic order of vanishing `-log v(f)`.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_principalDivisor_eq_neg_log_valuation (u : Additive Kˣ) (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    coeff ((OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).principalDivisor u) v =
      -WithZero.log (v.valuation K ((Additive.toMul u : Kˣ) : K))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_principalDivisor_eq_fractionalIdeal_count
decls.doc:
The coefficient of a Dedekind-domain principal divisor agrees with Mathlib's exponent of the
corresponding principal fractional ideal.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_principalDivisor_eq_fractionalIdeal_count (u : Additive Kˣ)
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    coeff ((OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).principalDivisor u) v =
      FractionalIdeal.count K v
        (toPrincipalIdeal R K (Additive.toMul u) : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.mem_support_principalDivisor_iff_valuation_ne_one
