decls.doc:
A height-one prime lies in the support of a principal divisor exactly when the corresponding
valuation is not one.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_support_principalDivisor_iff_valuation_ne_one (u : Additive Kˣ)
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    v ∈ ((OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).principalDivisor u).support ↔
      v.valuation K ((Additive.toMul u : Kˣ) : K) ≠ 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_principalDivisor_pos_iff_valuation_lt_one
decls.doc:
A coefficient of a principal divisor is positive exactly when the corresponding valuation is
strictly less than one.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_principalDivisor_pos_iff_valuation_lt_one (u : Additive Kˣ)
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    0 < coeff ((OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).principalDivisor u) v ↔
      v.valuation K ((Additive.toMul u : Kˣ) : K) < 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.isEffective_principalDivisor_of_integral
decls.doc:
The principal divisor of a nonzero *integral* element is effective: an element of `R` has
no poles, only zeros. The element is presented as any unit `u : Kˣ` whose value is
`algebraMap R K r`. This is the divisor-of-functions sanity check that rules out a vacuous
order system.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_principalDivisor_pos_iff_mem
decls.doc:
The divisor of a nonzero integral element `r : R`, presented as a unit `u : Kˣ` with value
`algebraMap R K r`, has a strictly positive coefficient (a genuine zero) at `v` exactly when `r`
lies in the prime `v`.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_principalDivisor_pos_iff_mem {r : R} {u : Kˣ} (hu : (u : K) = algebraMap R K r)
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    0 < coeff ((OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).principalDivisor (Additive.ofMul u)) v ↔
      r ∈ v.asIdeal

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.mem_support_principalDivisor_of_integral_iff_mem_asIdeal
decls.doc:
The support of the divisor of a nonzero integral element `r : R`, presented as a unit
`u : Kˣ` with value `algebraMap R K r`, is the set of height-one primes containing `r`.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_support_principalDivisor_of_integral_iff_mem_asIdeal {r : R} {u : Kˣ}
    (hu : (u : K) = algebraMap R K r) (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    v ∈ ((OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).principalDivisor (Additive.ofMul u)).support ↔
      r ∈ v.asIdeal

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.map_toPrincipalIdeal_range
decls.doc:
The isomorphism `fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv R K` between invertible fractional ideals and
Weil divisors carries the subgroup of principal fractional ideals onto the subgroup of principal
divisors: this is `fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_toPrincipalIdeal` at the level of subgroups, and
it is exactly the compatibility needed to descend the isomorphism to the class groups.
decls.statement:
lemma map_toPrincipalIdeal_range :
    AddSubgroup.map (fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv R K).toAddMonoidHom
        (Subgroup.toAddSubgroup (toPrincipalIdeal R K).range) =
      (OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).principalSubgroup

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.classGroupAddEquiv
decls.doc:
**The divisor class group of the affine Dedekind curve is the ideal class group.**

For a Dedekind domain `R` with fraction field `K`, the Weil-divisor divisor class group
`(OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).ClassGroup` of the height-one spectrum is isomorphic to the
ideal class group `ClassGroup R`, via the isomorphism `fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv R K` of
invertible fractional ideals with Weil divisors descended to the quotient by principal
divisors/ideals. This is the affine `Cl(X) ≅ Pic X` of the Jacobian roadmap. See
`classGroupAddEquiv_divisorClass_fractionalIdealDivisor` and
`classGroupAddEquiv_symm_ofMul_mk` for the characterizing formulas.
decls.title: The divisor class group of the affine Dedekind curve is the ideal class group
decls.statement:
def classGroupAddEquiv :
    (OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).ClassGroup ≃+ Additive (ClassGroup R)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.classGroupAddEquiv_divisorClass_fractionalIdealDivisor
decls.doc:
The class group isomorphism sends the class of the Weil divisor of an invertible fractional
ideal `I` to the ideal class of `I`. Together with the surjectivity of `fractionalIdealDivisor`
and of `divisorClass` this pins down `classGroupAddEquiv` on every element.
decls.statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquiv_divisorClass_fractionalIdealDivisor (I : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    classGroupAddEquiv R K
        ((OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).divisorClass
          (fractionalIdealDivisor R K (Additive.ofMul I)))
      = Additive.ofMul (ClassGroup.mk K I)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.classGroupAddEquiv_symm_ofMul_mk
decls.doc:
The inverse of the class group isomorphism sends the ideal class of an invertible fractional
ideal `I` to the divisor class of the Weil divisor of `I`. This is the canonical inverse formula,
dual to `classGroupAddEquiv_divisorClass_fractionalIdealDivisor`.
decls.statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquiv_symm_ofMul_mk (I : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    (classGroupAddEquiv R K).symm (Additive.ofMul (ClassGroup.mk K I)) =
      (OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).divisorClass
        (fractionalIdealDivisor R K (Additive.ofMul I))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.classGroupAddEquiv_divisorClass
decls.doc:
The class group isomorphism on a general divisor class: the class of a Weil divisor `D` maps to
the ideal class of the invertible fractional ideal `∏_v v ^ (D v)` recovered from `D`.
decls.statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquiv_divisorClass (D : WeilDivisor (HeightOneSpectrum R)) :
    classGroupAddEquiv R K ((OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).divisorClass D) =
      Additive.ofMul (ClassGroup.mk K (Additive.toMul
        ((fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv R K).symm D)))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.classGroupAddEquiv_divisorClass_ofPoint
decls.doc:
Non-vacuity: the class group isomorphism sends the class of the point divisor `[v]` of a
height-one prime `v` to the ideal class of `v`, viewed as an invertible fractional ideal.
decls.statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquiv_divisorClass_ofPoint (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    classGroupAddEquiv R K ((OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).divisorClass (ofPoint v)) =
      Additive.ofMul (ClassGroup.mk K
        (Units.mk0 (v.asIdeal : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)
          (FractionalIdeal.coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr v.ne_bot)))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_range
decls.doc:
The image of the descended weighted degree on the class group is the same subgroup of `ℤ`
generated by the weights. The class map `divisorClass` is surjective, so it does not change the
image of the degree; the value is `weightedDegree_range` transported through the quotient.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_range (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) :
    (weightedDegreeClass w h).range = AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range w)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_range_eq_top
decls.doc:
The descended weighted degree hits all of `ℤ` exactly when the weights generate `ℤ`, i.e.
`AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range w) = ⊤`. This is the general surjectivity criterion; a weight-one
base point is the special case `weightedDegreeClass_range_eq_top_of_weight_one`, but weights such
as `2` and `3` already generate `ℤ` with no weight-one point.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_range_eq_top (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (hw : AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range w) = ⊤) : (weightedDegreeClass w h).range = ⊤

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivDegreeRange
decls.doc:
**The degree quotient.** The class group modulo the abstract `Pic⁰` is isomorphic to the image
of the degree, `Cl(X) ⧸ Pic⁰ ≃+ (weightedDegreeClass w h).range`. This is Noether's first
isomorphism theorem for the descended weighted degree, whose kernel is `picZero` by definition;
the image is `AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range w)` by `weightedDegreeClass_range`. It is the degree
quotient of the class group, the divisor-class analogue of `Pic/Pic⁰`; no Picard scheme is
constructed here.
decls.title: The degree quotient

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.coe_classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivDegreeRange_mk
decls.statement:
lemma coe_classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivDegreeRange_mk (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (c : S.ClassGroup) :
    (S.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivDegreeRange w h (QuotientAddGroup.mk c) : ℤ) =
      weightedDegreeClass w h c

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivDegreeRange_symm_apply
decls.statement:
lemma classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivDegreeRange_symm_apply (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) (c : S.ClassGroup) :
    (S.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivDegreeRange w h).symm
        ⟨weightedDegreeClass w h c, c, rfl⟩ = QuotientAddGroup.mk c

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivInt
decls.doc:
**The degree quotient at a surjective degree.** When the descended weighted degree is
surjective — equivalently when the weights generate `ℤ`, see `weightedDegreeClass_range_eq_top` —
the class group modulo the abstract `Pic⁰` is `ℤ`, `Cl(X) ⧸ Pic⁰ ≃+ ℤ`. A weight-one base point
is the special case `classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivIntOfWeightOne`.
decls.title: The degree quotient at a surjective degree

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivInt_mk
decls.statement:
lemma classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivInt_mk (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (weightedDegreeClass w h)) (c : S.ClassGroup) :
    S.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivInt w h hsurj (QuotientAddGroup.mk c) =
      weightedDegreeClass w h c

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivInt_symm_weightedDegreeClass
decls.doc:
The inverse of `classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivInt` sends `weightedDegreeClass w h c` back to
the class `[c]`. Since `weightedDegreeClass w h` is surjective this characterises the inverse on
all of `ℤ`, so downstream code need not unfold the choice-based right inverse.
decls.statement:
lemma classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivInt_symm_weightedDegreeClass (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (weightedDegreeClass w h)) (c : S.ClassGroup) :
    (S.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivInt w h hsurj).symm (weightedDegreeClass w h c) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk c

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_range_eq_top_of_weight_one
decls.doc:
With a weight-one base point the descended weighted degree hits all of `ℤ`; this is the
weight-one specialization of `weightedDegreeClass_range_eq_top`.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_range_eq_top_of_weight_one (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) : (weightedDegreeClass w h).range = ⊤

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivIntOfWeightOne
decls.doc:
**The degree quotient at a weight-one base point.** With a weight-one base point the degree
section `n ↦ n • [x₀]` is a genuine right inverse of the descended weighted degree, so the class
group modulo the abstract `Pic⁰` is `ℤ`, `Cl(X) ⧸ Pic⁰ ≃+ ℤ`, with an explicit inverse. Together
with `DegreeSplitting`'s `Cl(X) ≃+ picZero × ℤ` this exhibits the degree as the projection to the
`ℤ` factor.
decls.title: The degree quotient at a weight-one base point

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivIntOfWeightOne_mk
decls.statement:
lemma classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivIntOfWeightOne_mk (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (c : S.ClassGroup) :
    S.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivIntOfWeightOne w h hx₀ (QuotientAddGroup.mk c) =
      weightedDegreeClass w h c

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivIntOfWeightOne_symm_apply
decls.statement:
lemma classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivIntOfWeightOne_symm_apply (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (n : ℤ) :
    (S.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivIntOfWeightOne w h hx₀).symm n =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (S.degreeSection x₀ n)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_le_of_le_of_nonneg_on_support
decls.doc:
With nonnegative weights on the support of the difference, a coefficientwise increase does
not decrease weighted degree.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_le_of_le
decls.doc:
With nonnegative weights, weighted degree is monotone for the coefficientwise divisor
order.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_le_of_le {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) {D E : WeilDivisor X}
    (hDE : D ≤ E) : weightedDegree w D ≤ weightedDegree w E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.monotone_weightedDegree
decls.doc: Bundled monotonicity of weighted degree for nonnegative weights.
decls.statement:
lemma monotone_weightedDegree {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) :
    Monotone (weightedDegree w : WeilDivisor X → ℤ)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_lt_of_le_of_ne_of_pos_on_support
decls.doc:
With positive weights on the support of the difference, a proper coefficientwise increase
strictly increases weighted degree.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_lt_of_le_of_ne_of_pos
decls.doc:
With everywhere-positive weights, a proper coefficientwise increase strictly increases
weighted degree.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_lt_of_le_of_ne_of_pos {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hDE : D ≤ E) (hne : D ≠ E) :
    weightedDegree w D < weightedDegree w E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_lt_of_lt_of_pos
decls.doc:
With everywhere-positive weights, strict coefficientwise inequality strictly increases
weighted degree.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_lt_of_lt_of_pos {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hDE : D < E) :
    weightedDegree w D < weightedDegree w E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.eq_of_le_of_weightedDegree_eq_of_pos_on_support
decls.doc:
With positive weights on the support of the difference, equality of weighted degrees under a
coefficientwise inequality forces equality of divisors.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.eq_of_le_of_weightedDegree_eq_of_pos
decls.doc:
With everywhere-positive weights, equality of weighted degrees under a coefficientwise
inequality forces equality of divisors.
decls.statement:
lemma eq_of_le_of_weightedDegree_eq_of_pos {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hDE : D ≤ E) (hdeg : weightedDegree w D = weightedDegree w E) :
    D = E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.strictMono_weightedDegree
decls.doc:
For positive weights, weighted degree is strictly monotone for the coefficientwise divisor
order.
decls.statement:
lemma strictMono_weightedDegree {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x) :
    StrictMono (weightedDegree w : WeilDivisor X → ℤ)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_le_of_le
decls.doc: The unweighted degree is monotone for the coefficientwise divisor order.
decls.statement: lemma degree_le_of_le {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hDE : D ≤ E) : degree D ≤ degree E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.monotone_degree
decls.doc: Bundled monotonicity of unweighted degree.
decls.statement: lemma monotone_degree : Monotone (degree : WeilDivisor X → ℤ)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_lt_of_le_of_ne
decls.doc: A proper coefficientwise increase strictly increases unweighted degree.
decls.statement:
lemma degree_lt_of_le_of_ne {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hDE : D ≤ E) (hne : D ≠ E) :
    degree D < degree E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_lt_of_lt
decls.doc: Strict coefficientwise inequality strictly increases unweighted degree.
decls.statement: lemma degree_lt_of_lt {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hDE : D < E) : degree D < degree E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.eq_of_le_of_degree_eq
decls.doc:
Equality of unweighted degrees under a coefficientwise inequality forces equality of
divisors.
decls.statement:
lemma eq_of_le_of_degree_eq {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hDE : D ≤ E) (hdeg : degree D = degree E) :
    D = E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.strictMono_degree
decls.doc: The unweighted degree is strictly monotone for the coefficientwise divisor order.
decls.statement: lemma strictMono_degree : StrictMono (degree : WeilDivisor X → ℤ)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_inf_add_degree_sup
decls.doc:
The lattice-ordered-group inclusion–exclusion identity for the unweighted degree:
`deg (D ⊓ E) + deg (D ⊔ E) = deg D + deg E`.
decls.statement:
lemma degree_inf_add_degree_sup (D E : WeilDivisor X) :
    degree (D ⊓ E) + degree (D ⊔ E) = degree D + degree E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_inf_add_weightedDegree_sup
decls.doc:
The lattice-ordered-group inclusion–exclusion identity for the weighted degree:
`w-deg (D ⊓ E) + w-deg (D ⊔ E) = w-deg D + w-deg E`.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_inf_add_weightedDegree_sup (w : X → ℤ) (D E : WeilDivisor X) :
    weightedDegree w (D ⊓ E) + weightedDegree w (D ⊔ E) =
      weightedDegree w D + weightedDegree w E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.degree_le_of_le
decls.doc:
If a fixed-degree effective divisor is coefficientwise below another, its degree index is
also bounded above.
decls.statement:
lemma degree_le_of_le {D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d} {E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e}
    (hDE : (D : WeilDivisor X) ≤ E) : d ≤ e

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeSection
decls.doc:
The homomorphism `n ↦ n • [x₀]`, sending an integer `n` to the class of `n` copies of
the base point `x₀`. When `w x₀ = 1`, it is a right inverse of `weightedDegreeClass`,
splitting the degree map.
decls.statement: def degreeSection (x₀ : X) : ℤ →+ S.ClassGroup

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeSection_apply
decls.statement:
lemma degreeSection_apply (x₀ : X) (n : ℤ) :
    S.degreeSection x₀ n = n • S.divisorClass (ofPoint x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeSection_one
decls.statement:
lemma degreeSection_one (x₀ : X) :
    S.degreeSection x₀ 1 = S.divisorClass (ofPoint x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_divisorClass_ofPoint
decls.doc: The descended weighted degree of the base-point class is the weight of the base point.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_divisorClass_ofPoint (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (x₀ : X) : weightedDegreeClass w h (S.divisorClass (ofPoint x₀)) = w x₀

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_degreeSection
decls.doc: The descended weighted degree of the degree section at `n` is `n * w x₀`.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_degreeSection (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (x₀ : X) (n : ℤ) :
    weightedDegreeClass w h (S.degreeSection x₀ n) = n * w x₀

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_comp_degreeSection
decls.doc:
With a weight-one base point, the degree section is a right inverse of the descended
weighted degree: `weightedDegreeClass ∘ degreeSection = id`.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_comp_degreeSection (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) :
    (weightedDegreeClass w h).comp (S.degreeSection x₀) = AddMonoidHom.id ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_degreeSection_of_weight_one
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_degreeSection_of_weight_one (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (n : ℤ) :
    weightedDegreeClass w h (S.degreeSection x₀ n) = n

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_surjective
decls.doc: With a weight-one base point, the descended weighted degree is surjective onto `ℤ`.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_surjective (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) : Function.Surjective (weightedDegreeClass w h)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeSection_injective
decls.doc: With a weight-one base point, the degree section is injective.
decls.statement:
lemma degreeSection_injective (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) : Function.Injective (S.degreeSection x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection
decls.doc:
The degree-correction homomorphism
`c ↦ c - (weightedDegreeClass w h c) • [x₀]`. With a weight-one base point its image lands in
`picZero`, and together with `degreeSection` it splits the class group as `picZero × ℤ`.
decls.statement:
def degreeCorrection (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) (x₀ : X) :
    S.ClassGroup →+ S.ClassGroup

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection_apply
decls.statement:
lemma degreeCorrection_apply (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) (x₀ : X)
    (c : S.ClassGroup) :
    S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ c =
      c - (weightedDegreeClass w h c) • S.divisorClass (ofPoint x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection_change_base
decls.doc:
Changing the base point in the class-group degree correction adds the weighted degree of the
class times the base-point-change divisor class.
decls.statement:
lemma degreeCorrection_change_base (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (x₀ y₀ : X) (c : S.ClassGroup) :
    S.degreeCorrection w h y₀ c =
      S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ c +
        weightedDegreeClass w h c • S.divisorClass (pointDifference x₀ y₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection_mem_picZero
decls.doc:
The degree correction lands in `picZero`: the degree-corrected class has weighted degree zero,
provided the base point has weight one.
decls.statement:
lemma degreeCorrection_mem_picZero (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (c : S.ClassGroup) :
    S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ c ∈ picZero w h

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection_divisorClass
decls.doc:
Degree correction acts on a divisor class by subtracting the base-point divisor scaled by the
weighted degree of any representative.
decls.statement:
lemma degreeCorrection_divisorClass (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) (x₀ : X)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ (S.divisorClass D) =
      S.divisorClass (D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection_eq_self_of_mem_picZero
decls.doc: A class already in `picZero` is unchanged by degree correction.
decls.statement:
lemma degreeCorrection_eq_self_of_mem_picZero (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (x₀ : X) {c : S.ClassGroup} (hc : c ∈ picZero w h) :
    S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ c = c

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection_coe_picZero
decls.doc:
The degree correction of a coerced `picZero` class is the same class in the ambient class
group.
decls.statement:
lemma degreeCorrection_coe_picZero (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (x₀ : X) (p : picZero w h) :
    S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ (p : S.ClassGroup) = p

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeSplitForward
decls.doc:
The forward map
`c ↦ (c - (weightedDegreeClass w h c) • [x₀], weightedDegreeClass w h c)` of the degree splitting
at a weight-one base point `x₀`: the first component is the weighted-degree-corrected class,
which lands in `picZero`, and the second is the descended weighted degree. Together with
`degreeSplitInverse` this assembles the product decomposition
`classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt`.
decls.statement:
def degreeSplitForward (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) : S.ClassGroup →+ picZero w h × ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeSplitForward_apply
decls.statement:
lemma degreeSplitForward_apply (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (c : S.ClassGroup) :
    S.degreeSplitForward w h hx₀ c =
      (⟨S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ c, S.degreeCorrection_mem_picZero w h hx₀ c⟩,
        weightedDegreeClass w h c)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeSplitInverse
decls.doc:
The inverse map `(p, n) ↦ p + n • [x₀]` of the degree splitting at a base point `x₀`:
add `n` copies of the base-point class to a class of weighted degree zero.
decls.statement:
def degreeSplitInverse (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) (x₀ : X) :
    picZero w h × ℤ →+ S.ClassGroup

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeSplitInverse_apply
decls.statement:
lemma degreeSplitInverse_apply (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) (x₀ : X)
    (p : picZero w h) (n : ℤ) :
    S.degreeSplitInverse w h x₀ (p, n) =
      (p : S.ClassGroup) + n • S.divisorClass (ofPoint x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeSplitInverse_degreeSplitForward
decls.statement:
lemma degreeSplitInverse_degreeSplitForward (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (c : S.ClassGroup) :
    S.degreeSplitInverse w h x₀ (S.degreeSplitForward w h hx₀ c) = c

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeSplitForward_degreeSplitInverse
decls.statement:
lemma degreeSplitForward_degreeSplitInverse (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (p : picZero w h) (n : ℤ) :
    S.degreeSplitForward w h hx₀ (S.degreeSplitInverse w h x₀ (p, n)) = (p, n)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt
decls.doc:
The class group of an order system with weighted-degree-zero principal divisors and a
weight-one base point splits as the direct product of the abstract `Pic⁰` and `ℤ`.

The forward map sends a class `c` to its weighted-degree-corrected part
`c - (weightedDegreeClass w h c) • [x₀]` in `picZero` together with
`weightedDegreeClass w h c`; the inverse sends `(p, n)` to `p + n • [x₀]`. This is the abstract
form of the splitting `Pic(X) ≃ Pic⁰(X) ⊕ ℤ` of a smooth proper curve with a rational point.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_apply
decls.statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_apply (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (c : S.ClassGroup) :
    S.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt w h hx₀ c =
      (⟨S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ c, S.degreeCorrection_mem_picZero w h hx₀ c⟩,
        weightedDegreeClass w h c)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_symm_apply
decls.statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_symm_apply (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (p : picZero w h) (n : ℤ) :
    (S.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt w h hx₀).symm (p, n) =
      (p : S.ClassGroup) + n • S.divisorClass (ofPoint x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_coe_picZero
decls.doc:
Under the splitting `Cl(X) ≃+ picZero × ℤ`, a coerced `picZero` class has `Pic⁰` component
itself and degree component `0`.
decls.statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_coe_picZero (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (p : picZero w h) :
    S.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt w h hx₀ (p : S.ClassGroup) = (p, 0)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.sum_zsmul_weightedPointBaseDifference
decls.doc:
The weighted closed form: subtracting `(weightedDegree w D) • [x₀]` from `D` expresses it as
the finite sum of the degree-corrected point divisors `D(x) • ([x] - w(x) • [x₀])`.
decls.statement:
lemma sum_zsmul_weightedPointBaseDifference (w : X → ℤ) (x₀ : X) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    (D.sum fun x n => n • weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x) =
      D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.eq_sum_zsmul_weightedPointBaseDifference
decls.doc:
A divisor of weighted degree zero is the finite integer combination
`Σ_x D(x) • ([x] - w(x) • [x₀])` of degree-corrected point divisors based at `x₀`.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.sub_weightedDegree_zsmul_ofPoint_mem_closure
decls.doc:
The degree-corrected representative `D - (weightedDegree w D) • [x₀]` lies in the subgroup
generated by the degree-corrected point divisors: it is the finite sum of the generators
`D(x) • ([x] - w(x) • [x₀])`, each of which is a multiple of a generator.
decls.statement:
lemma sub_weightedDegree_zsmul_ofPoint_mem_closure (w : X → ℤ) (x₀ : X)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀ ∈
      AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range fun x => weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup_eq_closure_weightedPointBaseDifference
decls.doc:
**The weighted degree-zero divisors are generated by the degree-corrected point divisors
`[x] - w(x) • [x₀]`.**  When the base point has weight one (the residue-field degree of a
`k`-rational point is one), the weighted degree-zero subgroup is generated by all the
`weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x`.  The weight-one hypothesis is what puts the generators inside
the subgroup; without it the generators need not have weighted degree zero.
decls.statement:
theorem weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup_eq_closure_weightedPointBaseDifference
    (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) :
    weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w =
      AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range fun x => weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.sum_zsmul_pointDifference
decls.doc:
The closed form for the base-point correction: subtracting `(degree D) • [x₀]` from `D`
expresses it as the finite sum of `D(x) • ([x] - [x₀])`.  Because the coefficients of `D` sum to
`degree D`, the base-point contributions collapse to a single `(degree D) • [x₀]` term.
decls.statement:
lemma sum_zsmul_pointDifference (x₀ : X) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    (D.sum fun x n => n • pointDifference x x₀) = D - degree D • ofPoint x₀

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.eq_sum_zsmul_pointDifference
decls.doc:
A divisor of degree zero is the finite integer combination `Σ_x D(x) • ([x] - [x₀])` of point
differences based at `x₀`.  This is the closed form of the Abel-Jacobi expansion of a degree-zero
divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma eq_sum_zsmul_pointDifference {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : degree D = 0) (x₀ : X) :
    D = D.sum fun x n => n • pointDifference x x₀

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup_one
decls.doc: At the constant weight `1`, the weighted degree-zero subgroup is the unweighted one.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup_one :
    weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) = degreeZeroSubgroup X

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degreeZeroSubgroup_eq_closure_pointDifference
decls.doc:
**The degree-zero divisors are generated by the point differences `[x] - [x₀]`.**  For any base
point `x₀`, the unweighted degree-zero subgroup is the subgroup generated by all point differences
based at `x₀`.  This is the formal-divisor form of Abel-Jacobi surjectivity onto the degree-zero
Picard group.
decls.title: The degree-zero divisors are generated by the point differences `[x] - [x₀]`
decls.statement:
theorem degreeZeroSubgroup_eq_closure_pointDifference (x₀ : X) :
    degreeZeroSubgroup X = AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range fun x => pointDifference x x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.eq_sum_coeff_smul_ofPoint
decls.doc:
Every Weil divisor is the finite sum of its coefficients times point divisors over its
support.
decls.statement:
lemma eq_sum_coeff_smul_ofPoint (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    D = ∑ x ∈ D.support, coeff D x • ofPoint x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofFinsupp
decls.doc: The Weil divisor associated to finitely supported natural-number multiplicities.
decls.statement: def ofFinsupp (m : X →₀ ℕ) : WeilDivisor X

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_ofFinsupp
decls.doc:
Coefficients of the divisor from finitely supported natural multiplicities are the
multiplicities.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_ofFinsupp (m : X →₀ ℕ) (x : X) :
    coeff (ofFinsupp m : WeilDivisor X) x = m x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.isEffective_ofFinsupp
decls.doc: Finitely supported natural multiplicities give effective divisors.
decls.statement: lemma isEffective_ofFinsupp (m : X →₀ ℕ) : IsEffective (ofFinsupp m : WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.support_ofFinsupp
decls.doc:
The support of a divisor from finitely supported natural multiplicities is the support of
those multiplicities.
decls.statement:
lemma support_ofFinsupp (m : X →₀ ℕ) :
    (ofFinsupp m : WeilDivisor X).support = m.support

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofFinsupp_eq_sum
decls.doc:
A divisor from finitely supported multiplicities is the corresponding sum of point divisors
over the support.
decls.statement:
lemma ofFinsupp_eq_sum (m : X →₀ ℕ) :
    ofFinsupp m = ∑ x ∈ m.support, (m x : ℤ) • ofPoint x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_ofFinsupp
decls.doc: The degree of a divisor from finitely supported multiplicities is the sum over the support.
decls.statement:
lemma degree_ofFinsupp (m : X →₀ ℕ) :
    degree (ofFinsupp m : WeilDivisor X) = ∑ x ∈ m.support, (m x : ℤ)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_ofFinsupp
decls.doc:
The weighted degree of a divisor from finitely supported multiplicities is the weighted sum over
the support.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_ofFinsupp (w : X → ℤ) (m : X →₀ ℕ) :
    weightedDegree w (ofFinsupp m : WeilDivisor X) =
      ∑ x ∈ m.support, (m x : ℤ) * w x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforward_ofFinsupp
decls.doc:
Pushing forward a divisor from finitely supported multiplicities applies the map to each point
in the support sum.
decls.statement:
lemma pushforward_ofFinsupp (f : X → Y) (m : X →₀ ℕ) :
    pushforward f (ofFinsupp m : WeilDivisor X) =
      ∑ x ∈ m.support, (m x : ℤ) • ofPoint (f x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_ofFinsupp_eq_zero_iff_of_pos
decls.doc:
With positive weights on the support, a divisor from finitely supported multiplicities has
weighted degree zero exactly when all multiplicities vanish.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_ofFinsupp_eq_zero_iff_of_pos
    (m : X →₀ ℕ) {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x ∈ m.support, 0 < w x) :
    weightedDegree w (ofFinsupp m : WeilDivisor X) = 0 ↔ m = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofFinsupp_mem_weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup_iff_of_pos
decls.doc:
With positive weights on the support, a divisor from finitely supported multiplicities lies in
the weighted degree-zero subgroup exactly when all multiplicities vanish.
decls.statement:
lemma ofFinsupp_mem_weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup_iff_of_pos
    (m : X →₀ ℕ) {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x ∈ m.support, 0 < w x) :
    (ofFinsupp m : WeilDivisor X) ∈ weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w ↔ m = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofFinsupp_mem_degreeZeroSubgroup_iff
decls.doc:
A divisor from finitely supported multiplicities has unweighted degree zero exactly when all
multiplicities vanish.
decls.statement:
lemma ofFinsupp_mem_degreeZeroSubgroup_iff (m : X →₀ ℕ) :
    (ofFinsupp m : WeilDivisor X) ∈ degreeZeroSubgroup X ↔ m = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofFinsetWithMultiplicity
decls.doc: The Weil divisor supported on a finite set with prescribed natural multiplicities.
decls.statement: def ofFinsetWithMultiplicity (s : Finset X) (m : X → ℕ) : WeilDivisor X

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity
decls.doc: Coefficients of the named finite-set divisor with prescribed multiplicities.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity [DecidableEq X] (s : Finset X) (m : X → ℕ) (x : X) :
    coeff (ofFinsetWithMultiplicity s m : WeilDivisor X) x = if x ∈ s then m x else 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_eq_sum
decls.doc:
The named finite-set divisor with multiplicities is the corresponding finite sum of point
divisors.
decls.statement:
lemma ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_eq_sum (s : Finset X) (m : X → ℕ) :
    ofFinsetWithMultiplicity s m = ∑ x ∈ s, (m x : ℤ) • ofPoint x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_empty
decls.doc: The named finite-set divisor with multiplicities over the empty set is zero.
decls.statement:
lemma ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_empty (m : X → ℕ) :
    ofFinsetWithMultiplicity (∅ : Finset X) m = (0 : WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_insert
decls.doc: Inserting a new point in a named finite-set divisor splits off its weighted point divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_insert [DecidableEq X] {s : Finset X} {x : X}
    (hx : x ∉ s) (m : X → ℕ) :
    ofFinsetWithMultiplicity (insert x s) m =
      (m x : ℤ) • ofPoint x + ofFinsetWithMultiplicity s m

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.isEffective_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity
decls.doc: A named finite-set divisor with natural multiplicities is effective.
decls.statement:
lemma isEffective_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity (s : Finset X) (m : X → ℕ) :
    IsEffective (ofFinsetWithMultiplicity s m : WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_mem_effectiveSubmonoid
decls.doc:
A named finite-set divisor with natural multiplicities belongs to the effective divisor
submonoid.
decls.statement:
lemma ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_mem_effectiveSubmonoid (s : Finset X) (m : X → ℕ) :
    ofFinsetWithMultiplicity s m ∈ effectiveSubmonoid X

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.support_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_subset
decls.doc:
The support of a named finite-set divisor with multiplicities is contained in the chosen
finite set. Points in the set whose multiplicity is zero may drop out of the support.
decls.statement:
lemma support_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_subset (s : Finset X) (m : X → ℕ) :
    (ofFinsetWithMultiplicity s m : WeilDivisor X).support ⊆ s

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.mem_support_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_iff
decls.doc:
A point is in the support of a named finite-set divisor with multiplicities exactly when it
is selected and has nonzero multiplicity.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_support_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_iff {s : Finset X} {m : X → ℕ} {x : X} :
    x ∈ (ofFinsetWithMultiplicity s m : WeilDivisor X).support ↔ x ∈ s ∧ m x ≠ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity
decls.doc:
The degree of a named finite-set divisor with multiplicities is the sum of the
multiplicities.
decls.statement:
lemma degree_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity (s : Finset X) (m : X → ℕ) :
    degree (ofFinsetWithMultiplicity s m : WeilDivisor X) = ∑ x ∈ s, (m x : ℤ)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity
decls.doc:
The weighted degree of a named finite-set divisor with multiplicities is the corresponding
weighted finite sum.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity (w : X → ℤ) (s : Finset X) (m : X → ℕ) :
    weightedDegree w (ofFinsetWithMultiplicity s m : WeilDivisor X) =
      ∑ x ∈ s, (m x : ℤ) * w x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforward_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity
decls.doc:
Pushing forward a named finite-set divisor with multiplicities applies the map to each
point in the finite sum.
decls.statement:
lemma pushforward_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity (f : X → Y) (s : Finset X) (m : X → ℕ) :
    pushforward f (ofFinsetWithMultiplicity s m : WeilDivisor X) =
      ∑ x ∈ s, (m x : ℤ) • ofPoint (f x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_eq_zero_iff_of_pos
decls.doc:
With positive weights at selected points with nonzero multiplicity, a named finite-set
divisor has weighted degree zero exactly when every selected multiplicity vanishes.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_eq_zero_iff_of_pos
    (s : Finset X) {w : X → ℤ} (m : X → ℕ) (hw : ∀ x ∈ s, m x ≠ 0 → 0 < w x) :
    weightedDegree w (ofFinsetWithMultiplicity s m : WeilDivisor X) = 0 ↔
      ∀ x ∈ s, m x = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_mem_weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup_iff_of_pos
decls.doc:
With positive weights at selected points with nonzero multiplicity, a named finite-set
divisor lies in the weighted degree-zero subgroup exactly when all selected multiplicities
vanish.
decls.statement:
lemma ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_mem_weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup_iff_of_pos
    (s : Finset X) {w : X → ℤ} (m : X → ℕ) (hw : ∀ x ∈ s, m x ≠ 0 → 0 < w x) :
    (ofFinsetWithMultiplicity s m : WeilDivisor X) ∈ weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w ↔
      ∀ x ∈ s, m x = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_mem_degreeZeroSubgroup_iff
decls.doc:
A named finite-set divisor with multiplicities has unweighted degree zero exactly when every
selected multiplicity vanishes.
decls.statement:
lemma ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_mem_degreeZeroSubgroup_iff (s : Finset X) (m : X → ℕ) :
    (ofFinsetWithMultiplicity s m : WeilDivisor X) ∈ degreeZeroSubgroup X ↔
      ∀ x ∈ s, m x = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofFinset
decls.doc: The Weil divisor with coefficient `1` on each point of a finite set.
decls.statement: def ofFinset (s : Finset X) : WeilDivisor X

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofFinset_eq_sum
decls.doc:
The named coefficient-one finite-set divisor is the corresponding finite sum of point
divisors.
decls.statement:
lemma ofFinset_eq_sum (s : Finset X) :
    ofFinset s = ∑ x ∈ s, ofPoint x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofFinset_empty
decls.doc: The named coefficient-one finite-set divisor over the empty set is zero.
decls.statement: lemma ofFinset_empty : ofFinset (∅ : Finset X) = (0 : WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofFinset_insert
decls.doc:
Inserting a new point in a named coefficient-one finite-set divisor splits off its point
divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma ofFinset_insert [DecidableEq X] {s : Finset X} {x : X} (hx : x ∉ s) :
    ofFinset (insert x s) = ofPoint x + ofFinset s

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_ofFinset
decls.doc:
Coefficients of the named coefficient-one finite-set divisor are `1` on the set and `0` off
it.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_ofFinset [DecidableEq X] (s : Finset X) (x : X) :
    coeff (ofFinset s : WeilDivisor X) x = if x ∈ s then 1 else 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.isEffective_ofFinset
decls.doc: The named coefficient-one finite-set divisor is effective.
decls.statement: lemma isEffective_ofFinset (s : Finset X) : IsEffective (ofFinset s : WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofFinset_mem_effectiveSubmonoid
decls.doc: The named coefficient-one finite-set divisor belongs to the effective divisor submonoid.
decls.statement:
lemma ofFinset_mem_effectiveSubmonoid (s : Finset X) :
    ofFinset s ∈ effectiveSubmonoid X

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.support_ofFinset
decls.doc:
The support of the named coefficient-one finite-set divisor is exactly the chosen finite
set.
decls.statement:
lemma support_ofFinset (s : Finset X) :
    (ofFinset s : WeilDivisor X).support = s

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_ofFinset
decls.doc: The degree of the named coefficient-one finite-set divisor is the finite set's cardinality.
decls.statement: lemma degree_ofFinset (s : Finset X) : degree (ofFinset s : WeilDivisor X) = s.card

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_ofFinset
decls.doc:
The weighted degree of the named coefficient-one finite-set divisor is the sum of weights on
it.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_ofFinset (w : X → ℤ) (s : Finset X) :
    weightedDegree w (ofFinset s : WeilDivisor X) = ∑ x ∈ s, w x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.pushforward_ofFinset
decls.doc: Pushing forward the named coefficient-one finite-set divisor applies the map to each point.
decls.statement:
lemma pushforward_ofFinset (f : X → Y) (s : Finset X) :
    pushforward f (ofFinset s : WeilDivisor X) = ∑ x ∈ s, ofPoint (f x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofFinset_mem_weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup_iff_of_pos
decls.doc:
For positive weights, a named coefficient-one finite-set divisor lies in the weighted
degree-zero subgroup exactly when the finite set is empty.
decls.statement:
lemma ofFinset_mem_weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup_iff_of_pos
    (s : Finset X) {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < w x) :
    (ofFinset s : WeilDivisor X) ∈ weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w ↔ s = ∅

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.ofFinset_mem_degreeZeroSubgroup_iff
decls.doc:
A named coefficient-one finite-set divisor has unweighted degree zero exactly when the set is
empty.
decls.statement:
lemma ofFinset_mem_degreeZeroSubgroup_iff (s : Finset X) :
    (ofFinset s : WeilDivisor X) ∈ degreeZeroSubgroup X ↔ s = ∅

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.add
decls.doc: Add fixed-degree effective divisors.  The degree index records additivity of degree.
decls.statement:
abbrev add (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X (d + e)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_add
decls.doc: The underlying Weil divisor of a fixed-degree sum is the sum of the underlying divisors.
decls.statement:
lemma coe_add (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (add D E : WeilDivisor X) = (D : WeilDivisor X) + E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coeff_add
decls.doc: The coefficient of a fixed-degree sum is the sum of the coefficients.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_add (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) (x : X) :
    coeff (add D E : WeilDivisor X) x = coeff (D : WeilDivisor X) x + coeff E x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.zero_add
decls.doc: Zero is a left identity for fixed-degree effective-divisor addition.
decls.statement:
lemma zero_add (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    add (zero X) D = EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast (Nat.zero_add d).symm D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.add_zero
decls.doc: Zero is a right identity for fixed-degree effective-divisor addition.
decls.statement:
lemma add_zero (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    add D (zero X) = EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast (Nat.add_zero d).symm D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.add_comm
decls.doc: Fixed-degree effective-divisor addition is commutative, up to the degree-index cast.
decls.statement:
lemma add_comm (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    add D E = EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast (Nat.add_comm e d) (add E D)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.add_assoc
decls.doc: Fixed-degree effective-divisor addition is associative, up to the degree-index cast.
decls.statement:
lemma add_assoc {n : ℕ} (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) (F : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X n) :
    add (add D E) F =
      EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast (Nat.add_assoc d e n).symm (add D (add E F))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.add_ofFinsupp
decls.doc:
Adding divisors built from finitely supported multiplicities corresponds to adding their
multiplicity functions.
decls.statement:
lemma add_ofFinsupp (m n : X →₀ ℕ) (hm : m.sum (fun _ k => k) = d)
    (hn : n.sum (fun _ k => k) = e) :
    add (ofFinsupp m hm) (ofFinsupp n hn) =
      ofFinsupp (m + n) (by
        rw [Finsupp.sum_add_index']
        · simp [hm, hn]
        · simp
        · simp)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.multiplicityFinsupp_add
decls.doc: The multiplicity function of a sum is the sum of the multiplicity functions.
decls.statement:
lemma multiplicityFinsupp_add (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (add D E).multiplicityFinsupp = D.multiplicityFinsupp + E.multiplicityFinsupp

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.equivSym_add
decls.doc: The symmetric-power equivalence sends fixed-degree divisor addition to `Sym.append`.
decls.statement:
lemma equivSym_add (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    equivSym (add D E) = (equivSym D).append (equivSym E)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.add_ofSym
decls.doc:
Adding the divisors associated to symmetric-power points is the divisor associated to
their appended unordered collection.
decls.statement:
lemma add_ofSym (s : Sym X d) (t : Sym X e) :
    add (ofSym s) (ofSym t) = ofSym (s.append t)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_ofSym_append
decls.doc:
The divisor associated to an appended symmetric-power point is the sum of the associated
fixed-degree divisors.
decls.statement:
lemma coe_ofSym_append (s : Sym X d) (t : Sym X e) :
    WeilDivisor.ofFinsupp
        (letI := Classical.decEq X; ((Sym.equivNatSum X (d + e)) (s.append t)).1) =
      (ofSym s : WeilDivisor X) + (ofSym t : WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.pushforward_add
decls.doc: Pushforward commutes with addition of fixed-degree effective divisors.
decls.statement:
lemma pushforward_add (f : X → Y) (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (add D E).pushforward f = add (D.pushforward f) (E.pushforward f)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.equivSym_pushforward_add
decls.doc:
On symmetric powers, pushforward compatibility for fixed-degree divisor addition is the
usual compatibility of `Sym.map` with `Sym.append`.
decls.statement:
lemma equivSym_pushforward_add (f : X → Y) (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    equivSym ((add D E).pushforward f) =
      (Sym.map f (equivSym D)).append (Sym.map f (equivSym E))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree
decls.doc: The effective Weil divisors of degree `d`.
decls.statement: abbrev EffectiveDivisorOfDegree (X : Type*) (d : ℕ) : Type _

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ext
decls.statement: lemma ext {D E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d} (h : (D : WeilDivisor X) = E) : D = E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.zero
decls.doc: The zero effective divisor, regarded as the unique effective divisor of degree `0`.
decls.statement: abbrev zero (X : Type*) : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_zero
decls.doc: The underlying Weil divisor of the degree-zero effective divisor is zero.
decls.statement: lemma coe_zero : (zero X : WeilDivisor X) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast
decls.doc: Change the degree index of a fixed-degree effective divisor along an equality.
decls.statement:
def cast {d e : ℕ} (h : d = e) :
    EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d ≃ EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast_rfl
decls.doc: Changing the degree index along `rfl` leaves a fixed-degree divisor unchanged.
decls.statement:
lemma cast_rfl (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast rfl D = D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_cast
decls.doc: Changing the degree index does not change the underlying Weil divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma coe_cast {d e : ℕ} (h : d = e) (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast h D : WeilDivisor X) = D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.isEffective
decls.statement: lemma isEffective (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) : IsEffective (D : WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.degree_eq
decls.statement: lemma degree_eq (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) : degree (D : WeilDivisor X) = d

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.mem_effectiveSubmonoid
decls.statement:
lemma mem_effectiveSubmonoid (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    (D : WeilDivisor X) ∈ effectiveSubmonoid X

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofFinsupp
decls.doc:
An effective divisor of degree `d` from finitely supported natural multiplicities whose
total multiplicity is `d`.
decls.statement:
abbrev ofFinsupp (m : X →₀ ℕ) (hm : m.sum (fun _ n => n) = d) :
    EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_ofFinsupp
decls.statement:
lemma coe_ofFinsupp (m : X →₀ ℕ) (hm : m.sum (fun _ n => n) = d) :
    (ofFinsupp m hm : WeilDivisor X) = WeilDivisor.ofFinsupp m

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coeff_ofFinsupp
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_ofFinsupp (m : X →₀ ℕ) (hm : m.sum (fun _ n => n) = d) (x : X) :
    coeff (ofFinsupp m hm : WeilDivisor X) x = m x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.multiplicityFinsupp
decls.doc: The finitely supported natural multiplicity function underlying an effective divisor.
decls.statement: abbrev multiplicityFinsupp (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) : X →₀ ℕ

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.multiplicityFinsupp_apply
decls.statement:
lemma multiplicityFinsupp_apply (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (x : X) :
    D.multiplicityFinsupp x = (coeff (D : WeilDivisor X) x).toNat

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofFinsupp_multiplicityFinsupp
decls.doc:
Rebuilding an effective divisor from its natural multiplicity function recovers the
underlying Weil divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma ofFinsupp_multiplicityFinsupp (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    WeilDivisor.ofFinsupp D.multiplicityFinsupp = (D : WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.sum_multiplicityFinsupp
decls.doc: The natural multiplicity function of a degree-`d` effective divisor has total mass `d`.
decls.statement:
lemma sum_multiplicityFinsupp (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    D.multiplicityFinsupp.sum (fun _ n => n) = d

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofFinsupp_multiplicityFinsupp_eq
decls.doc:
Rebuilding an effective divisor from its natural multiplicity function recovers the
original fixed-degree divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma ofFinsupp_multiplicityFinsupp_eq (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    ofFinsupp D.multiplicityFinsupp D.sum_multiplicityFinsupp = D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.multiplicityFinsupp_ofFinsupp
decls.doc:
The natural multiplicity function of a divisor built from a finitely supported function is
that function.
decls.statement:
lemma multiplicityFinsupp_ofFinsupp (m : X →₀ ℕ) (hm : m.sum (fun _ n => n) = d) :
    (ofFinsupp m hm).multiplicityFinsupp = m

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.equivFinsupp
decls.doc:
Fixed-degree effective divisors are equivalently finitely supported natural multiplicities
with total mass `d`.
decls.statement:
abbrev equivFinsupp :
    EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d ≃ {m : X →₀ ℕ // m.sum (fun _ n => n) = d}

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.equivFinsupp_apply_coe
decls.statement:
lemma equivFinsupp_apply_coe (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    (equivFinsupp D : X →₀ ℕ) = D.multiplicityFinsupp

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.equivFinsupp_symm_apply
decls.statement:
lemma equivFinsupp_symm_apply (m : {m : X →₀ ℕ // m.sum (fun _ n => n) = d}) :
    (equivFinsupp.symm m : WeilDivisor X) = WeilDivisor.ofFinsupp m.1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym
decls.doc: The effective divisor associated to an unordered degree-`d` collection of points.
decls.statement: def ofSym (s : Sym X d) : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_ofSym
decls.statement:
lemma coe_ofSym (s : Sym X d) :
    (ofSym s : WeilDivisor X) =
      WeilDivisor.ofFinsupp (letI := Classical.decEq X; (Sym.equivNatSum X d s).1)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coeff_ofSym
decls.doc:
The symmetric-power divisor has coefficient equal to the multiplicity of the point in the
unordered collection.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_ofSym (s : Sym X d) (x : X) :
    coeff (ofSym s : WeilDivisor X) x =
      (letI := Classical.decEq X; (s : Multiset X).count x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.equivSym
decls.doc:
Effective degree-`d` divisors are the same data as the `d`-th symmetric power of the
underlying point type.
decls.statement: def equivSym : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d ≃ Sym X d

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.equivSym_apply
decls.doc:
Applying the symmetric-power equivalence is the same as applying Mathlib's multiplicity
equivalence to the fixed-degree divisor's multiplicity function.
decls.statement:
lemma equivSym_apply (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    equivSym D =
      (letI := Classical.decEq X; (Sym.equivNatSum X d).symm (equivFinsupp D))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.equivSym_symm_apply
decls.doc: The inverse of the symmetric-power equivalence is `ofSym`.
decls.statement:
lemma equivSym_symm_apply (s : Sym X d) :
    (equivSym.symm s : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) = ofSym s

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym_equivSym
decls.doc: Converting a divisor to the symmetric power and back gives the original divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma ofSym_equivSym (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    ofSym (equivSym D) = D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.equivSym_ofSym
decls.doc:
Converting a symmetric-power point to a divisor and back gives the original symmetric-power
point.
decls.statement:
lemma equivSym_ofSym (s : Sym X d) :
    equivSym (ofSym s) = s

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.pushforward
decls.doc: Pushing forward a fixed-degree effective divisor preserves its degree.
decls.statement:
abbrev pushforward (f : X → Y) (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    EffectiveDivisorOfDegree Y d

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_pushforward
decls.statement:
lemma coe_pushforward (f : X → Y) (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    (D.pushforward f : WeilDivisor Y) = WeilDivisor.pushforward f D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.pushforward_id
decls.doc: Pushing forward along the identity function is the identity on fixed-degree divisors.
decls.statement:
lemma pushforward_id (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    D.pushforward (fun x : X => x) = D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.pushforward_comp
decls.doc: Pushforwards of fixed-degree divisors compose functorially.
decls.statement:
lemma pushforward_comp {Z : Type*} (g : Y → Z) (f : X → Y) (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    (D.pushforward f).pushforward g = D.pushforward (g ∘ f)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.pushforward_ofFinsupp
decls.doc: Pushing forward a divisor built from multiplicities corresponds to `Finsupp.mapDomain`.
decls.statement:
lemma pushforward_ofFinsupp (f : X → Y) (m : X →₀ ℕ) (hm : m.sum (fun _ n => n) = d) :
    (ofFinsupp m hm).pushforward f = ofFinsupp (m.mapDomain f) (by
      exact (Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index_addMonoidHom
        (f := f) (s := m) (fun _ : Y => AddMonoidHom.id ℕ)).trans hm)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.multiplicityFinsupp_pushforward
decls.doc: The multiplicity function of a pushforward is the pushed-forward multiplicity function.
decls.statement:
lemma multiplicityFinsupp_pushforward (f : X → Y) (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    (D.pushforward f).multiplicityFinsupp = D.multiplicityFinsupp.mapDomain f

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.equivSym_pushforward
decls.doc: The symmetric-power equivalence sends divisor pushforward to `Sym.map`.
decls.statement:
lemma equivSym_pushforward (f : X → Y) (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    equivSym (D.pushforward f) = Sym.map f (equivSym D)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.subOfLe
decls.doc:
The residual fixed-degree effective divisor `D - E`, defined when `E ≤ D`.

If `D` has degree `e` and `E` has degree `d`, the residual has degree `e - d`.
decls.statement:
def subOfLe (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (hED : (E : WeilDivisor X) ≤ D) : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X (e - d)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_subOfLe
decls.doc:
The underlying Weil divisor of a residual fixed-degree divisor is the difference of the
underlying Weil divisors.
decls.statement:
lemma coe_subOfLe (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (hED : (E : WeilDivisor X) ≤ D) :
    (subOfLe D E hED : WeilDivisor X) = (D : WeilDivisor X) - E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coeff_subOfLe
decls.doc: The coefficient of a residual fixed-degree divisor is the difference of coefficients.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_subOfLe (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (hED : (E : WeilDivisor X) ≤ D) (x : X) :
    coeff (subOfLe D E hED : WeilDivisor X) x =
      coeff (D : WeilDivisor X) x - coeff (E : WeilDivisor X) x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.multiplicityFinsupp_subOfLe
decls.doc:
The multiplicity function of a residual divisor is the truncated difference of the
multiplicity functions.
decls.statement:
lemma multiplicityFinsupp_subOfLe (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (hED : (E : WeilDivisor X) ≤ D) :
    (subOfLe D E hED).multiplicityFinsupp =
      D.multiplicityFinsupp - E.multiplicityFinsupp

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.equivFinsupp_subOfLe_coe
decls.doc:
The finitely supported multiplicity representation of a residual divisor is the
truncated difference of the representations of the original divisors.
decls.statement:
lemma equivFinsupp_subOfLe_coe (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (hED : (E : WeilDivisor X) ≤ D) :
    (equivFinsupp (subOfLe D E hED) : X →₀ ℕ) =
      (equivFinsupp D : X →₀ ℕ) - (equivFinsupp E : X →₀ ℕ)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.equivSym_subOfLe
decls.doc:
Under the symmetric-power equivalence, a residual divisor is represented by the truncated
difference of multiplicity functions.
decls.statement:
lemma equivSym_subOfLe (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (hED : (E : WeilDivisor X) ≤ D) :
    equivSym (subOfLe D E hED) =
      (letI := Classical.decEq X;
        (Sym.equivNatSum X (e - d)).symm
          ⟨D.multiplicityFinsupp - E.multiplicityFinsupp, by
            rw [← multiplicityFinsupp_subOfLe D E hED]
            exact (subOfLe D E hED).sum_multiplicityFinsupp⟩)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.degree_subOfLe
decls.doc: The degree of the residual divisor is the difference of the degree indices.
decls.statement:
lemma degree_subOfLe (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (hED : (E : WeilDivisor X) ≤ D) :
    degree (subOfLe D E hED : WeilDivisor X) = ((e - d : ℕ) : ℤ)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.add_subOfLe
decls.doc:
Adding a sub-divisor back to its residual recovers the original divisor, up to the cast
identifying `d + (e - d)` with `e`.
decls.statement:
lemma add_subOfLe (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (hED : (E : WeilDivisor X) ≤ D) :
    add E (subOfLe D E hED) =
      EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast
        (Nat.add_sub_of_le (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.degree_le_of_le hED)).symm D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.subOfLe_add
decls.doc:
Adding the residual on the left also recovers the original divisor, up to the cast
identifying `(e - d) + d` with `e`.
decls.statement:
lemma subOfLe_add (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (hED : (E : WeilDivisor X) ≤ D) :
    add (subOfLe D E hED) E =
      EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast
        (Nat.sub_add_cancel (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.degree_le_of_le hED)).symm D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.subOfLe_zero
decls.doc:
Subtracting the zero fixed-degree divisor leaves the original divisor, up to the cast
identifying `d - 0` with `d`.
decls.statement:
lemma subOfLe_zero (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    subOfLe D (zero X) (by
      rw [← WeilDivisor.isEffective_iff_zero_le]
      exact D.isEffective) =
      EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast (Nat.sub_zero d).symm D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.subOfLe_self
decls.doc: Subtracting a fixed-degree divisor from itself gives the zero residual divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma subOfLe_self (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    subOfLe D D le_rfl = EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast (Nat.sub_self d).symm (zero X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisor
decls.doc:
The **Weil divisor of an invertible fractional ideal**: the formal sum `Σ_v count K v I · [v]`
of the `v`-adic multiplicities of `I` over the height-one primes `v` of `R`, as a homomorphism from
the group of invertible fractional ideals to the free Weil-divisor group. The multiplicity is zero
for all but finitely many `v` (`FractionalIdeal.finite_factors`), and the multiplicativity of
`FractionalIdeal.count` makes this additive.
decls.statement:
def fractionalIdealDivisor :
    Additive (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ →+ WeilDivisor (HeightOneSpectrum R)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_fractionalIdealDivisor
decls.doc:
The coefficient of `fractionalIdealDivisor R K I` at a height-one prime `v` is the
`v`-adic multiplicity `FractionalIdeal.count K v I` of the invertible fractional ideal `I`.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_fractionalIdealDivisor (I : Additive (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ)
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    coeff (fractionalIdealDivisor R K I) v =
      FractionalIdeal.count K v (Units.val (Additive.toMul I))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisor_injective
decls.doc:
The divisor map is injective: an invertible fractional ideal is recovered from its
multiplicities through the factorization `I = ∏_v v^(count K v I)`.
decls.statement:
lemma fractionalIdealDivisor_injective :
    Function.Injective (fractionalIdealDivisor R K)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.prod_asIdeal_zpow_ne_zero
decls.doc:
The product `∏_v v^(D v)` of prime fractional ideals `v.asIdeal` raised to the multiplicities
`D v` of a Weil divisor `D` is nonzero, hence an invertible fractional ideal. This is the value of
the inverse of `fractionalIdealDivisor`.
decls.statement:
lemma prod_asIdeal_zpow_ne_zero (D : WeilDivisor (HeightOneSpectrum R)) :
    (D.prod fun v e => (v.asIdeal : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) ^ e) ≠ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisor_surjective
decls.doc:
The divisor map is surjective: a Weil divisor `D` is the divisor of the invertible fractional
ideal `∏_v v^(D v)`.
decls.statement:
lemma fractionalIdealDivisor_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (fractionalIdealDivisor R K)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv
decls.doc:
**The Weil ≃ Cartier dictionary for the affine Dedekind chart.** The group of invertible
fractional ideals of a Dedekind domain `R` is isomorphic to the free Weil-divisor group on the
height-one primes of `R`, by taking `v`-adic multiplicities. The inverse sends a divisor `D` to the
fractional ideal `∏_v v^(D v)`.
decls.title: The Weil ≃ Cartier dictionary for the affine Dedekind chart
decls.statement:
def fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv :
    Additive (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ ≃+ WeilDivisor (HeightOneSpectrum R)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
On forward application the packaged equivalence `fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv` agrees with the
underlying homomorphism `fractionalIdealDivisor`.
decls.statement:
lemma fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_apply (I : Additive (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv R K I = fractionalIdealDivisor R K I

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc:
The inverse of `fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv` sends a Weil divisor `D` to the invertible
fractional ideal `∏_v v^(D v)`: the product of the prime ideals `v.asIdeal` raised to the
multiplicities `D v`. This gives the canonical formula for the inverse, which
`AddEquiv.ofBijective` otherwise leaves as an unspecified choice inverse.
decls.statement:
lemma fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_symm_apply (D : WeilDivisor (HeightOneSpectrum R)) :
    (fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv R K).symm D =
      Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (D.prod fun v e => (v.asIdeal : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) ^ e)
        (prod_asIdeal_zpow_ne_zero R K D))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisor_toPrincipalIdeal
decls.doc:
The divisor of the principal fractional ideal `(x)` of a nonzero rational function `x` is the
principal divisor of `x`: the isomorphism carries principal fractional ideals to principal divisors.
This is the compatibility on principal elements needed to later identify the ideal class group with
the divisor class group `Cl(X)`; that quotient-level isomorphism is not proved here.
decls.statement:
lemma fractionalIdealDivisor_toPrincipalIdeal (x : Kˣ) :
    fractionalIdealDivisor R K (Additive.ofMul (toPrincipalIdeal R K x)) =
      (OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).principalDivisor (Additive.ofMul x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_toPrincipalIdeal
decls.doc:
Applying the isomorphism `fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv` to the principal fractional ideal
`(x)` of a nonzero rational function `x` yields the principal divisor of `x`, restating
`fractionalIdealDivisor_toPrincipalIdeal` for the packaged equivalence.
decls.statement:
lemma fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_toPrincipalIdeal (x : Kˣ) :
    fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv R K (Additive.ofMul (toPrincipalIdeal R K x)) =
      (OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).principalDivisor (Additive.ofMul x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisor_asIdeal
decls.doc:
The divisor of a prime `v`, regarded as an invertible fractional ideal, is the point divisor
`[v]`. This is the non-vacuity check identifying the divisor map on generators.
decls.statement:
lemma fractionalIdealDivisor_asIdeal (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    fractionalIdealDivisor R K
        (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (v.asIdeal : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)
          (FractionalIdeal.coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr v.ne_bot))) = ofPoint v

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.integralFractionalIdealSubmonoid
decls.doc: The additive submonoid of invertible fractional ideals contained in `R`.
decls.statement:
def integralFractionalIdealSubmonoid :
    AddSubmonoid (Additive (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.mem_integralFractionalIdealSubmonoid
decls.doc:
Membership in `integralFractionalIdealSubmonoid` means that the fractional ideal is contained
in the base ring.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_integralFractionalIdealSubmonoid
    (I : Additive (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    I ∈ integralFractionalIdealSubmonoid R K ↔
      Units.val (Additive.toMul I) ≤ 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.isEffective_fractionalIdealDivisor_of_le_one
decls.doc:
The divisor of an integral fractional ideal (one contained in `R`, i.e. `≤ 1`) is effective:
integral ideals have no poles, only zeros. This is the affine "effective divisor ↔ integral ideal"
half of the dictionary.
decls.statement:
lemma isEffective_fractionalIdealDivisor_of_le_one (I : Additive (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ)
    (hI : Units.val (Additive.toMul I) ≤ 1) :
    IsEffective (fractionalIdealDivisor R K I)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.le_one_of_isEffective_fractionalIdealDivisor
decls.doc:
If the divisor of an invertible fractional ideal is effective, then the fractional ideal is
integral. This is the converse of `isEffective_fractionalIdealDivisor_of_le_one`.
decls.statement:
lemma le_one_of_isEffective_fractionalIdealDivisor
    (I : Additive (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ)
    (hI : IsEffective (fractionalIdealDivisor R K I)) :
    Units.val (Additive.toMul I) ≤ 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.isEffective_fractionalIdealDivisor_iff
decls.doc:
An invertible fractional ideal is integral exactly when its associated Weil divisor is
effective.
decls.statement:
lemma isEffective_fractionalIdealDivisor_iff
    (I : Additive (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    IsEffective (fractionalIdealDivisor R K I) ↔
      Units.val (Additive.toMul I) ≤ 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.isEffective_fractionalIdealDivisor_iff_mem
decls.doc:
The divisor of an invertible fractional ideal is effective exactly when that ideal belongs to
the integral fractional-ideal submonoid.
decls.statement:
lemma isEffective_fractionalIdealDivisor_iff_mem
    (I : Additive (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    IsEffective (fractionalIdealDivisor R K I) ↔
      I ∈ integralFractionalIdealSubmonoid R K

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.integralFractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv
decls.doc:
The affine Weil--Cartier equivalence restricted to positive objects: integral invertible
fractional ideals correspond exactly to effective Weil divisors.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coe_integralFractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv
decls.doc:
The restricted equivalence agrees with `fractionalIdealDivisor` after forgetting
effectivity.
decls.statement:
lemma coe_integralFractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv
    (I : integralFractionalIdealSubmonoid R K) :
    ((integralFractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv R K I :
        effectiveSubmonoid (HeightOneSpectrum R)) :
      WeilDivisor (HeightOneSpectrum R)) =
      fractionalIdealDivisor R K I

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coe_integralFractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_symm
decls.doc:
The inverse restricted equivalence agrees with the unrestricted inverse after forgetting
integrality.
decls.statement:
lemma coe_integralFractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_symm
    (D : effectiveSubmonoid (HeightOneSpectrum R)) :
    (((integralFractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv R K).symm D :
        integralFractionalIdealSubmonoid R K) :
      Additive (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) =
      (fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv R K).symm D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.add_mem_completeLinearSystem
decls.doc:
Members of complete linear systems add to a member of the complete linear system of the sum
class.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.add_mem_completeLinearSystem_left
decls.doc: Left addition by a fixed member of `|D|` sends `|D'|` into `|D + D'|`.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.add_mem_completeLinearSystem_right
decls.doc: Right addition by a fixed member of `|D'|` sends `|D|` into `|D + D'|`.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.nonempty_completeLinearSystem_add
decls.doc:
If two complete linear systems are nonempty, then the complete linear system of the sum of
their divisor classes is nonempty.
decls.statement:
lemma nonempty_completeLinearSystem_add {D D' : WeilDivisor X}
    (hD : (S.completeLinearSystem D).Nonempty)
    (hD' : (S.completeLinearSystem D').Nonempty) :
    (S.completeLinearSystem (D + D')).Nonempty

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.add_effective_mem_completeLinearSystem
decls.doc: Translating a member of `|D|` by an effective divisor `A` gives a member of `|D + A|`.
decls.statement:
lemma add_effective_mem_completeLinearSystem {D A E : WeilDivisor X} (hA : IsEffective A)
    (hE : E ∈ S.completeLinearSystem D) :
    E + A ∈ S.completeLinearSystem (D + A)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.mapsTo_add_effective_completeLinearSystem
decls.doc: Translation by an effective divisor `A` sends `|D|` into `|D + A|`.
decls.statement:
lemma mapsTo_add_effective_completeLinearSystem {D A : WeilDivisor X} (hA : IsEffective A) :
    Set.MapsTo (fun E => E + A) (S.completeLinearSystem D) (S.completeLinearSystem (D + A))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.nonempty_completeLinearSystem_add_effective
decls.doc:
Adding an effective divisor to the indexing divisor preserves nonemptiness of complete
linear systems.
decls.statement:
lemma nonempty_completeLinearSystem_add_effective {D A : WeilDivisor X} (hA : IsEffective A)
    (hD : (S.completeLinearSystem D).Nonempty) :
    (S.completeLinearSystem (D + A)).Nonempty

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.sum_mem_completeLinearSystem
decls.doc:
A finite sum of members of complete linear systems is a member of the complete linear system
of the finite sum of the indexing divisors.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.completeLinearSystem_add_principalDivisor_eq
decls.doc:
Adding a principal divisor to the indexing divisor does not change the complete linear
system.
decls.statement:
