lemma completeLinearSystem_add_principalDivisor_eq (D : WeilDivisor X) (g : G) :
    S.completeLinearSystem (D + S.principalDivisor g) = S.completeLinearSystem D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.completeLinearSystem_sub_principalDivisor_eq
decls.doc:
Subtracting a principal divisor from the indexing divisor does not change the complete
linear system.
decls.statement:
lemma completeLinearSystem_sub_principalDivisor_eq (D : WeilDivisor X) (g : G) :
    S.completeLinearSystem (D - S.principalDivisor g) = S.completeLinearSystem D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.add_principalDivisor_mem_completeLinearSystem
decls.doc: An effective principal translate of `D` is a member of the complete linear system `|D|`.
decls.statement:
lemma add_principalDivisor_mem_completeLinearSystem (D : WeilDivisor X) (g : G)
    (hEff : IsEffective (D + S.principalDivisor g)) :
    D + S.principalDivisor g ∈ S.completeLinearSystem D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.sub_principalDivisor_mem_completeLinearSystem
decls.doc:
An effective negative principal translate of `D` is a member of the complete linear system
`|D|`.
decls.statement:
lemma sub_principalDivisor_mem_completeLinearSystem (D : WeilDivisor X) (g : G)
    (hEff : IsEffective (D - S.principalDivisor g)) :
    D - S.principalDivisor g ∈ S.completeLinearSystem D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.completeLinearSystem
decls.doc:
The **complete linear system** `|D|` of a Weil divisor `D` with respect to an order system
`S`: the set of effective divisors linearly equivalent to `D`.

Classically these are the divisors `D + div f` for a rational function `f` with `D + div f`
effective; see `mem_completeLinearSystem_iff_exists_principalDivisor`.
decls.statement: def completeLinearSystem (D : WeilDivisor X) : Set (WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.mem_completeLinearSystem
decls.statement:
lemma mem_completeLinearSystem {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    E ∈ S.completeLinearSystem D ↔ IsEffective E ∧ S.LinearlyEquivalent D E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.isEffective_of_mem_completeLinearSystem
decls.statement:
lemma isEffective_of_mem_completeLinearSystem {D E : WeilDivisor X}
    (hE : E ∈ S.completeLinearSystem D) : IsEffective E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.linearlyEquivalent_of_mem_completeLinearSystem
decls.statement:
lemma linearlyEquivalent_of_mem_completeLinearSystem {D E : WeilDivisor X}
    (hE : E ∈ S.completeLinearSystem D) : S.LinearlyEquivalent D E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.self_mem_completeLinearSystem
decls.doc: An effective divisor lies in its own complete linear system.
decls.statement:
lemma self_mem_completeLinearSystem {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D) :
    D ∈ S.completeLinearSystem D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.mem_completeLinearSystem_iff_divisorClass
decls.doc:
Membership in the complete linear system in terms of the divisor class: `|D|` consists of
the effective divisors whose class equals that of `D`.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_completeLinearSystem_iff_divisorClass {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    E ∈ S.completeLinearSystem D ↔ IsEffective E ∧ S.divisorClass D = S.divisorClass E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.divisorClass_eq_of_mem_completeLinearSystem
decls.doc: Every member of `|D|` has the same divisor class as `D`.
decls.statement:
lemma divisorClass_eq_of_mem_completeLinearSystem {D E : WeilDivisor X}
    (hE : E ∈ S.completeLinearSystem D) : S.divisorClass E = S.divisorClass D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.mem_completeLinearSystem_iff_exists_principalDivisor
decls.doc:
The classical description of the complete linear system: its members are exactly the
effective divisors `D + div g` obtained from `D` by adding a principal divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_completeLinearSystem_iff_exists_principalDivisor {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    E ∈ S.completeLinearSystem D ↔ IsEffective E ∧ ∃ g, E = D + S.principalDivisor g

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.completeLinearSystem_eq_of_divisorClass_eq
decls.doc:
The complete linear system depends only on the divisor class: linearly equivalent divisors
have the same complete linear system.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.completeLinearSystem_eq_of_linearlyEquivalent
decls.doc: The complete linear systems of linearly equivalent divisors coincide.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.mem_completeLinearSystem_zero
decls.doc:
The complete linear system of the zero divisor consists of the effective principal
divisors.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_completeLinearSystem_zero {E : WeilDivisor X} :
    E ∈ S.completeLinearSystem 0 ↔ IsEffective E ∧ ∃ g, E = S.principalDivisor g

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegree_eq_of_mem_completeLinearSystem
decls.doc:
When principal divisors have weighted degree zero, every member of `|D|` has the same
weighted degree as `D`.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_eq_of_mem_completeLinearSystem {w : X → ℤ} (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hE : E ∈ S.completeLinearSystem D) :
    weightedDegree w E = weightedDegree w D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.completeLinearSystem_eq_empty_of_weightedDegree_neg
decls.doc:
With nonnegative weights and weighted-degree-zero principal divisors, a divisor of negative
weighted degree has empty complete linear system.
decls.statement:
lemma completeLinearSystem_eq_empty_of_weightedDegree_neg {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : weightedDegree w D < 0) :
    S.completeLinearSystem D = ∅

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.eq_zero_of_mem_completeLinearSystem_of_weightedDegree_zero
decls.doc:
With positive weights and weighted-degree-zero principal divisors, every member of the
complete linear system of a weighted-degree-zero divisor is zero.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.mem_completeLinearSystem_iff_eq_zero_and_divisorClass_eq_zero_of_weightedDegree_zero
decls.doc:
With positive weights and weighted-degree-zero principal divisors, membership in the
complete linear system of a weighted-degree-zero divisor is equivalent to being the zero divisor
and the divisor class being zero.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_completeLinearSystem_iff_eq_zero_and_divisorClass_eq_zero_of_weightedDegree_zero
    {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hD : weightedDegree w D = 0) :
    E ∈ S.completeLinearSystem D ↔ E = 0 ∧ S.divisorClass D = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.mem_completeLinearSystem_iff_eq_zero_and_linearlyEquivalent_zero_of_weightedDegree_zero
decls.doc:
With positive weights and weighted-degree-zero principal divisors, membership in the
complete linear system of a weighted-degree-zero divisor is equivalent to being zero and
linearly equivalent to zero.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_completeLinearSystem_iff_eq_zero_and_linearlyEquivalent_zero_of_weightedDegree_zero
    {w : X → ℤ} (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hD : weightedDegree w D = 0) :
    E ∈ S.completeLinearSystem D ↔ E = 0 ∧ S.LinearlyEquivalent D 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.nonempty_completeLinearSystem_iff_divisorClass_eq_zero_of_weightedDegree_zero
decls.doc:
With positive weights and weighted-degree-zero principal divisors, nonemptiness of the
complete linear system of a weighted-degree-zero divisor is equivalent to the divisor class
being zero.
decls.statement:
lemma nonempty_completeLinearSystem_iff_divisorClass_eq_zero_of_weightedDegree_zero

    {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : weightedDegree w D = 0) :
    (S.completeLinearSystem D).Nonempty ↔ S.divisorClass D = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.completeLinearSystem_eq_singleton_zero_iff_divisorClass_eq_zero_of_isWeightedDegreeZero
decls.doc:
With positive weights and weighted-degree-zero principal divisors, the complete linear system

decls.statement:
lemma completeLinearSystem_eq_singleton_zero_iff_divisorClass_eq_zero_of_isWeightedDegreeZero

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.completeLinearSystem_eq_singleton_zero_iff_linearlyEquivalent_zero_of_isWeightedDegreeZero
decls.doc:
With positive weights and weighted-degree-zero principal divisors, the complete linear system

decls.statement:
lemma completeLinearSystem_eq_singleton_zero_iff_linearlyEquivalent_zero_of_isWeightedDegreeZero

decls.doc:
With positive weights and weighted-degree-zero principal divisors, a weighted-degree-zero

decls.statement:
lemma nonempty_completeLinearSystem_iff_linearlyEquivalent_zero_of_weightedDegree_zero

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degree_eq_of_mem_completeLinearSystem
decls.doc:
When principal divisors have unweighted degree zero, every member of `|D|` has the same

decls.statement:
lemma degree_eq_of_mem_completeLinearSystem (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hE : E ∈ S.completeLinearSystem D) : degree E = degree D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.completeLinearSystem_eq_empty_of_degree_neg
decls.doc:
With unweighted-degree-zero principal divisors, a divisor of negative degree has empty

decls.statement:
lemma completeLinearSystem_eq_empty_of_degree_neg (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.eq_zero_of_mem_completeLinearSystem_of_degree_zero
decls.doc:
In the unweighted theory, every member of the complete linear system of a degree-zero

decls.statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_mem_completeLinearSystem_of_degree_zero (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hE : E ∈ S.completeLinearSystem D) (hD : degree D = 0) : E = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.mem_completeLinearSystem_iff_eq_zero_and_divisorClass_eq_zero_of_degree_zero
decls.doc:
Assuming unweighted-degree-zero principal divisors, membership in the complete linear system

decls.statement:
lemma mem_completeLinearSystem_iff_eq_zero_and_divisorClass_eq_zero_of_degree_zero

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.mem_completeLinearSystem_iff_eq_zero_and_linearlyEquivalent_zero_of_degree_zero
decls.doc:
Assuming unweighted-degree-zero principal divisors, membership in the complete linear system

decls.statement:
lemma mem_completeLinearSystem_iff_eq_zero_and_linearlyEquivalent_zero_of_degree_zero

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.nonempty_completeLinearSystem_iff_divisorClass_eq_zero_of_degree_zero
decls.doc:
Assuming unweighted-degree-zero principal divisors, a degree-zero divisor has a nonempty

decls.statement:
lemma nonempty_completeLinearSystem_iff_divisorClass_eq_zero_of_degree_zero

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.completeLinearSystem_eq_singleton_zero_iff_divisorClass_eq_zero_of_principal_degree_zero
decls.doc:
Assuming unweighted-degree-zero principal divisors, the complete linear system of `D` is
`{0}` exactly when its divisor class is zero.
decls.statement:
lemma completeLinearSystem_eq_singleton_zero_iff_divisorClass_eq_zero_of_principal_degree_zero
    (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero) {D : WeilDivisor X} :
    S.completeLinearSystem D = {0} ↔ S.divisorClass D = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.completeLinearSystem_eq_singleton_zero_iff_linearlyEquivalent_zero_of_principal_degree_zero
decls.doc:
Assuming unweighted-degree-zero principal divisors, the complete linear system of `D` is
`{0}` exactly when it is linearly equivalent to zero.
decls.statement:
lemma completeLinearSystem_eq_singleton_zero_iff_linearlyEquivalent_zero_of_principal_degree_zero
    (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero) {D : WeilDivisor X} :

decls.doc:
Assuming unweighted-degree-zero principal divisors, a degree-zero divisor has a nonempty
complete linear system exactly when it is linearly equivalent to zero.
decls.statement:
lemma nonempty_completeLinearSystem_iff_linearlyEquivalent_zero_of_degree_zero
    (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero) {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : degree D = 0) :

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.nonempty_completeLinearSystem_iff
decls.doc:
A complete linear system is nonempty exactly when the divisor class of `D` contains an
effective divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma nonempty_completeLinearSystem_iff {D : WeilDivisor X} :
    (S.completeLinearSystem D).Nonempty ↔
      ∃ E, IsEffective E ∧ S.divisorClass E = S.divisorClass D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.add_sub_mem_completeLinearSystem_of_le
decls.doc:
If `D ≤ D'`, then translating a member of `|D|` by the effective difference `D' - D`
gives a member of `|D'|`.
decls.statement:
lemma add_sub_mem_completeLinearSystem_of_le {D D' E : WeilDivisor X} (hDD' : D ≤ D')
    (hE : E ∈ S.completeLinearSystem D) :
    E + (D' - D) ∈ S.completeLinearSystem D'

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.mapsTo_add_sub_completeLinearSystem_of_le
decls.doc: The order-induced translation map sends `|D|` into `|D'|` whenever `D ≤ D'`.
decls.statement:
lemma mapsTo_add_sub_completeLinearSystem_of_le {D D' : WeilDivisor X} (hDD' : D ≤ D') :
    Set.MapsTo (fun E => E + (D' - D)) (S.completeLinearSystem D)
      (S.completeLinearSystem D')

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.nonempty_completeLinearSystem_of_le
decls.doc: Nonemptiness of complete linear systems is monotone for the divisor order.
decls.statement:
lemma nonempty_completeLinearSystem_of_le {D D' : WeilDivisor X} (hDD' : D ≤ D')
    (hD : (S.completeLinearSystem D).Nonempty) :
    (S.completeLinearSystem D').Nonempty

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.le_iff
decls.doc: One Weil divisor is `≤` another exactly when it is so coefficientwise.
decls.statement: lemma le_iff {D E : WeilDivisor X} : D ≤ E ↔ ∀ x, coeff D x ≤ coeff E x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_le_coeff
decls.doc: The coefficientwise order projects to coefficients: `D ≤ E` gives `coeff D x ≤ coeff E x`.
decls.statement: lemma coeff_le_coeff {D E : WeilDivisor X} (h : D ≤ E) (x : X) : coeff D x ≤ coeff E x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.isEffective_iff_zero_le
decls.doc: Effectivity is exactly nonnegativity in the coefficientwise order.
decls.statement: lemma isEffective_iff_zero_le {D : WeilDivisor X} : IsEffective D ↔ 0 ≤ D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.mem_effectiveSubmonoid_iff_zero_le
decls.doc: Membership in the effective submonoid is nonnegativity in the coefficientwise order.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_effectiveSubmonoid_iff_zero_le {D : WeilDivisor X} :
    D ∈ effectiveSubmonoid X ↔ 0 ≤ D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.le_iff_isEffective_sub
decls.doc: `D ≤ E` exactly when the difference `E - D` is effective.
decls.statement: lemma le_iff_isEffective_sub {D E : WeilDivisor X} : D ≤ E ↔ IsEffective (E - D)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_sup
decls.doc: The coefficient of a pointwise maximum is the maximum of the coefficients.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_sup (D E : WeilDivisor X) (x : X) :
    coeff (D ⊔ E) x = coeff D x ⊔ coeff E x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_inf
decls.doc: The coefficient of a pointwise minimum is the minimum of the coefficients.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_inf (D E : WeilDivisor X) (x : X) :
    coeff (D ⊓ E) x = coeff D x ⊓ coeff E x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.IsEffective.sup
decls.doc: The pointwise maximum of an effective divisor with any divisor is effective.
decls.statement:
lemma IsEffective.sup {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D) :
    IsEffective (D ⊔ E)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.IsEffective.inf
decls.doc: The pointwise minimum of two effective divisors is effective.
decls.statement:
lemma IsEffective.inf {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hD : IsEffective D) (hE : IsEffective E) :
    IsEffective (D ⊓ E)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.isEffective_inf_iff
decls.doc: A pointwise minimum is effective exactly when both divisors are effective.
decls.statement:
lemma isEffective_inf_iff {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    IsEffective (D ⊓ E) ↔ IsEffective D ∧ IsEffective E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.sub_inf_inf_sub_inf_eq_zero
decls.doc: Removing the infimum from each of two Weil divisors leaves disjoint residual divisors.
decls.statement:
lemma sub_inf_inf_sub_inf_eq_zero (D E : WeilDivisor X) :
    ((D - D ⊓ E) ⊓ (E - D ⊓ E)) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_posPart
decls.doc: The coefficient of the positive part is the positive part of the coefficient.
decls.statement: lemma coeff_posPart (D : WeilDivisor X) (x : X) : coeff D⁺ x = coeff D x ⊔ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_negPart
decls.doc: The coefficient of the negative part is the negative part of the coefficient.
decls.statement: lemma coeff_negPart (D : WeilDivisor X) (x : X) : coeff D⁻ x = -coeff D x ⊔ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.isEffective_posPart
decls.doc: The positive part of a Weil divisor is effective.
decls.statement: lemma isEffective_posPart (D : WeilDivisor X) : IsEffective D⁺

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.isEffective_negPart
decls.doc: The negative part of a Weil divisor is effective.
decls.statement: lemma isEffective_negPart (D : WeilDivisor X) : IsEffective D⁻

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.support_posPart_disjoint_negPart
decls.doc:
The positive and negative parts of a Weil divisor have disjoint supports: no point carries
both a positive and a negative coefficient.
decls.statement:
lemma support_posPart_disjoint_negPart (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    Disjoint D⁺.support D⁻.support

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.negPart_eq_zero_iff_isEffective
decls.doc: A divisor is effective exactly when its negative part vanishes.
decls.statement: lemma negPart_eq_zero_iff_isEffective {D : WeilDivisor X} : D⁻ = 0 ↔ IsEffective D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.posPart_eq_self_iff_isEffective
decls.doc: A divisor is effective exactly when it equals its own positive part.
decls.statement: lemma posPart_eq_self_iff_isEffective {D : WeilDivisor X} : D⁺ = D ↔ IsEffective D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.weightedDegree_posPart_sub_weightedDegree_negPart
decls.doc: The weighted degree splits over the positive/negative part decomposition.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegree_posPart_sub_weightedDegree_negPart (w : X → ℤ) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    weightedDegree w D⁺ - weightedDegree w D⁻ = weightedDegree w D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.degree_posPart_sub_degree_negPart
decls.doc: The unweighted degree splits over the positive/negative part decomposition.
decls.statement:
lemma degree_posPart_sub_degree_negPart (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    degree D⁺ - degree D⁻ = degree D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.posPart_pointDifference
decls.doc: For distinct points the positive part of `[x] - [y]` is the point divisor `[x]`.
decls.statement:
lemma posPart_pointDifference {x y : X} (h : x ≠ y) :
    (pointDifference x y)⁺ = ofPoint x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.negPart_pointDifference
decls.doc: For distinct points the negative part of `[x] - [y]` is the point divisor `[y]`.
decls.statement:
lemma negPart_pointDifference {x y : X} (h : x ≠ y) :
    (pointDifference x y)⁻ = ofPoint y

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalSubgroupOfWeightedDegreeZero
decls.doc:
Principal divisors inside the weighted-degree-zero divisor group: a degree-zero
divisor belongs to this subgroup exactly when its underlying divisor is principal.
decls.statement:
def principalSubgroupOfWeightedDegreeZero (w : X → ℤ) :
    AddSubgroup (weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.mem_principalSubgroupOfWeightedDegreeZero
decls.statement:
lemma mem_principalSubgroupOfWeightedDegreeZero {w : X → ℤ}
    {D : weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w} :
    D ∈ S.principalSubgroupOfWeightedDegreeZero w ↔
      (D : WeilDivisor X) ∈ S.principalSubgroup

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom
decls.doc:
The natural map from weighted-degree-zero divisors to the abstract degree-zero divisor
class group `Pic⁰`, sending a divisor to its divisor class.
decls.statement:
def weightedDegreeZeroClassHom (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) :
    weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w →+ S.picZero w h

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.coe_weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_apply
decls.statement:
lemma coe_weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_apply {w : X → ℤ} (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (D : weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w) :
    (S.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom w h D : S.ClassGroup) =
      S.divisorClass (D : WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_apply
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_apply {w : X → ℤ} (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (D : weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w) :
    S.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom w h D =
      ⟨S.divisorClass (D : WeilDivisor X), by
        rw [divisorClass_mem_picZero]
        exact weightedDegree_coe_weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w D⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_surjective
decls.doc:
The natural map from weighted-degree-zero divisors to `Pic⁰` is surjective: every
degree-zero divisor class has a weighted-degree-zero representative.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_surjective {w : X → ℤ} (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) :
    Function.Surjective (S.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom w h)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_eq_zero_iff
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_eq_zero_iff {w : X → ℤ}
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {D : weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w} :
    S.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom w h D = 0 ↔
      (D : WeilDivisor X) ∈ S.principalSubgroup

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_ker
decls.doc:
The kernel of the map from weighted-degree-zero divisors to `Pic⁰` is exactly the subgroup
of principal divisors inside the weighted-degree-zero divisor group.
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_ker {w : X → ℤ} (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) :
    (S.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom w h).ker =
      S.principalSubgroupOfWeightedDegreeZero w

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero
decls.doc:
The quotient of weighted-degree-zero divisors by principal divisors is the abstract
degree-zero divisor class group `Pic⁰`.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero_mk
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero_mk {w : X → ℤ}
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) (D : weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w) :
    S.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero w h
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk D) = S.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom w h D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.coe_weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero_mk
decls.statement:
lemma coe_weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero_mk {w : X → ℤ}
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) (D : weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w) :
    (S.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero w h
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk D) : S.ClassGroup) =
      S.divisorClass (D : WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.posPart
decls.doc: The positive part of a Weil divisor, packaged as an effective divisor of its own degree.
decls.statement:
abbrev posPart (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X (degree D⁺).toNat

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.negPart
decls.doc: The negative part of a Weil divisor, packaged as an effective divisor of its own degree.
decls.statement:
abbrev negPart (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X (degree D⁻).toNat

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_posPart
decls.doc: The underlying Weil divisor of the packaged positive part is `D⁺`.
decls.statement:
lemma coe_posPart (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    (posPart D : WeilDivisor X) = D⁺

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_negPart
decls.doc: The underlying Weil divisor of the packaged negative part is `D⁻`.
decls.statement:
lemma coe_negPart (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    (negPart D : WeilDivisor X) = D⁻

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.posPart_coe_of_isEffective
decls.doc:
If a divisor is already effective, its packaged positive part is the divisor itself, up to
the degree-index cast.
decls.statement:
lemma posPart_coe_of_isEffective (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    posPart (D : WeilDivisor X) =
      EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast (by
        rw [WeilDivisor.posPart_eq_self_iff_isEffective.mpr D.isEffective, D.degree_eq]
        simp) D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.negPart_coe_of_isEffective
decls.doc: If a divisor is effective, its packaged negative part is the zero divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma negPart_coe_of_isEffective (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    negPart (D : WeilDivisor X) =
      EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast (by
        rw [WeilDivisor.negPart_eq_zero_iff_isEffective.mpr D.isEffective]
        simp) (zero X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.posPart_pointDifference
decls.doc: For distinct points, the packaged positive part of `[x] - [y]` is `[x]`.
decls.statement:
lemma posPart_pointDifference {x y : X} (h : x ≠ y) :
    posPart (WeilDivisor.pointDifference x y) =
      EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast (by
        rw [WeilDivisor.posPart_pointDifference h, WeilDivisor.degree_ofPoint]
        simp) (ofSym (Sym.oneEquiv x))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.negPart_pointDifference
decls.doc: For distinct points, the packaged negative part of `[x] - [y]` is `[y]`.
decls.statement:
lemma negPart_pointDifference {x y : X} (h : x ≠ y) :
    negPart (WeilDivisor.pointDifference x y) =
      EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast (by
        rw [WeilDivisor.negPart_pointDifference h, WeilDivisor.degree_ofPoint]
        simp) (ofSym (Sym.oneEquiv y))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem
decls.doc:
An *order system* on a type of points `X` with values in a group `G`: a family of
`ℤ`-valued homomorphisms `ord x : G →+ ℤ`, the orders of vanishing at each point, such that
every `g : G` vanishes to nonzero order at only finitely many points.

Instantiate `G` with `Additive Kˣ` for the multiplicative group of a function field `K`: then
`ord x` is the order of vanishing `ord_x(f)` of a rational function at the point `x`, and the
finiteness condition records that a rational function has zeros and poles at only finitely many
points. The principal divisor of `f` is `Σ_x ord_x(f) · [x]`.
decls.statement: structure OrderSystem (X G : Type*) [AddCommGroup G]

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalDivisor
decls.doc: The principal divisor `Σ_x ord_x(g) · [x]` attached to `g : G`.
decls.statement: def principalDivisor (g : G) : WeilDivisor X

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.coeff_principalDivisor
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_principalDivisor (g : G) (x : X) :
    coeff (S.principalDivisor g) x = S.ord x g

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalHom
decls.doc: Principal divisors as a homomorphism `G →+ WeilDivisor X`.
decls.statement: def principalHom : G →+ WeilDivisor X

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalHom_apply
decls.statement: lemma principalHom_apply (g : G) : S.principalHom g = S.principalDivisor g

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalDivisor_zero
decls.statement: lemma principalDivisor_zero : S.principalDivisor 0 = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalDivisor_add
decls.statement:
lemma principalDivisor_add (g₁ g₂ : G) :
    S.principalDivisor (g₁ + g₂) = S.principalDivisor g₁ + S.principalDivisor g₂

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalDivisor_neg
decls.statement: lemma principalDivisor_neg (g : G) : S.principalDivisor (-g) = -S.principalDivisor g

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalDivisor_sub
decls.statement:
lemma principalDivisor_sub (g₁ g₂ : G) :
    S.principalDivisor (g₁ - g₂) = S.principalDivisor g₁ - S.principalDivisor g₂

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalSubgroup
decls.doc: The subgroup of principal divisors.
decls.statement: def principalSubgroup : AddSubgroup (WeilDivisor X)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.mem_principalSubgroup
decls.statement:
lemma mem_principalSubgroup {D : WeilDivisor X} :
    D ∈ S.principalSubgroup ↔ ∃ g, S.principalDivisor g = D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalSubgroup_eq_range
decls.doc: The subgroup of principal divisors is the range of the principal-divisor homomorphism.
decls.statement: lemma principalSubgroup_eq_range : S.principalSubgroup = S.principalHom.range

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalDivisor_mem_principalSubgroup
decls.statement:
lemma principalDivisor_mem_principalSubgroup (g : G) :
    S.principalDivisor g ∈ S.principalSubgroup

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.LinearlyEquivalent
decls.doc:
Two Weil divisors are *linearly equivalent* with respect to `S` when their difference is a
principal divisor. This is the equivalence relation whose quotient is the divisor class
group.
decls.statement: def LinearlyEquivalent (D E : WeilDivisor X) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.linearlyEquivalent_iff
decls.statement:
lemma linearlyEquivalent_iff {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    S.LinearlyEquivalent D E ↔ D - E ∈ S.principalSubgroup

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.linearlyEquivalent_iff_exists_principalDivisor
decls.doc:
Two Weil divisors are linearly equivalent exactly when their difference is the principal
divisor of some `g : G`. This is the direct introduction/elimination form of
`LinearlyEquivalent`, exposing the witnessing function.
decls.statement:
lemma linearlyEquivalent_iff_exists_principalDivisor {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    S.LinearlyEquivalent D E ↔ ∃ g, S.principalDivisor g = D - E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.LinearlyEquivalent.refl
decls.statement: lemma LinearlyEquivalent.refl (D : WeilDivisor X) : S.LinearlyEquivalent D D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.LinearlyEquivalent.symm
decls.statement:
lemma LinearlyEquivalent.symm {D E : WeilDivisor X} (h : S.LinearlyEquivalent D E) :
    S.LinearlyEquivalent E D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.LinearlyEquivalent.trans
decls.statement:
lemma LinearlyEquivalent.trans {D E F : WeilDivisor X} (h₁ : S.LinearlyEquivalent D E)
    (h₂ : S.LinearlyEquivalent E F) : S.LinearlyEquivalent D F

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.LinearlyEquivalent.add
decls.doc: Linear equivalence is compatible with adding equivalent divisors on both sides.
decls.statement:
lemma LinearlyEquivalent.add {D D' E E' : WeilDivisor X} (hD : S.LinearlyEquivalent D D')
    (hE : S.LinearlyEquivalent E E') : S.LinearlyEquivalent (D + E) (D' + E')

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.LinearlyEquivalent.add_right
decls.doc: Adding the same divisor on the right preserves linear equivalence.
decls.statement:
lemma LinearlyEquivalent.add_right {D D' : WeilDivisor X} (hD : S.LinearlyEquivalent D D')
    (E : WeilDivisor X) : S.LinearlyEquivalent (D + E) (D' + E)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.LinearlyEquivalent.add_left
decls.doc: Adding the same divisor on the left preserves linear equivalence.
decls.statement:
lemma LinearlyEquivalent.add_left {E E' : WeilDivisor X} (hE : S.LinearlyEquivalent E E')
    (D : WeilDivisor X) : S.LinearlyEquivalent (D + E) (D + E')

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.linearlyEquivalent_add_principalDivisor
decls.doc: A divisor plus a principal divisor is linearly equivalent to the original divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma linearlyEquivalent_add_principalDivisor (D : WeilDivisor X) (g : G) :
    S.LinearlyEquivalent (D + S.principalDivisor g) D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.linearlyEquivalent_sub_principalDivisor
decls.doc:
Subtracting a principal divisor from a divisor is linearly equivalent to the original
divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma linearlyEquivalent_sub_principalDivisor (D : WeilDivisor X) (g : G) :
    S.LinearlyEquivalent (D - S.principalDivisor g) D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.equivalence_linearlyEquivalent
decls.statement: lemma equivalence_linearlyEquivalent : Equivalence S.LinearlyEquivalent

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.ClassGroup
decls.doc:
The *divisor class group* `Cl(X) = WeilDivisor X ⧸ (principal divisors)` of an order
system `S`.
decls.statement: abbrev ClassGroup : Type _

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.divisorClass
decls.doc: The divisor class of a Weil divisor in the divisor class group.
decls.statement: def divisorClass : WeilDivisor X →+ S.ClassGroup

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.divisorClass_eq_mk'
decls.doc:
The divisor-class map is the canonical additive quotient projection
`WeilDivisor X → Cl(X)`. This is the definitional equation, exposed so that downstream files can
rewrite between `divisorClass` and `QuotientAddGroup.mk'`.
decls.statement:
lemma divisorClass_eq_mk' (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.divisorClass D = QuotientAddGroup.mk' S.principalSubgroup D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.divisorClass_surjective
decls.statement: lemma divisorClass_surjective : Function.Surjective S.divisorClass

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.divisorClass_principalDivisor
decls.statement:
lemma divisorClass_principalDivisor (g : G) :
    S.divisorClass (S.principalDivisor g) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.divisorClass_eq_iff
decls.doc:
Two Weil divisors have the same divisor class exactly when they are linearly equivalent,
that is, when their difference is a principal divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma divisorClass_eq_iff {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    S.divisorClass D = S.divisorClass E ↔ S.LinearlyEquivalent D E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.divisorClass_eq_zero_iff
decls.statement:
lemma divisorClass_eq_zero_iff {D : WeilDivisor X} :
    S.divisorClass D = 0 ↔ D ∈ S.principalSubgroup

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.ClassGroup.lift
decls.doc:
The universal property of the divisor class group: a homomorphism `φ : WeilDivisor X →+ H`
that sends every principal divisor to `0` descends to a homomorphism `Cl(X) →+ H`.
decls.statement:
def ClassGroup.lift {H : Type*} [AddCommGroup H] (φ : WeilDivisor X →+ H)
    (hφ : ∀ g, φ (S.principalDivisor g) = 0) : S.ClassGroup →+ H

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.ClassGroup.lift_divisorClass
decls.statement:
lemma ClassGroup.lift_divisorClass {H : Type*} [AddCommGroup H] (φ : WeilDivisor X →+ H)
    (hφ : ∀ g, φ (S.principalDivisor g) = 0) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    ClassGroup.lift S φ hφ (S.divisorClass D) = φ D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.IsWeightedDegreeZero
decls.doc:
An order system has *weighted-degree-zero principal divisors* for a weight `w : X → ℤ` when
every principal divisor has weighted degree zero.

For a smooth proper curve over a field `k`, the intended weight is the residue-field degree
`x ↦ [κ(x) : k]`; this is the geometric fact that a rational function has as many zeros as
poles, counted with residue-field degrees.
decls.statement: def IsWeightedDegreeZero (w : X → ℤ) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.IsWeightedDegreeZero.principalSubgroup_le_weightedDegree_ker
TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass
decls.doc:
When principal divisors have weighted degree zero, the weighted degree map descends to the
divisor class group: linearly equivalent divisors have the same weighted degree.
decls.statement:
def weightedDegreeClass (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) :
    S.ClassGroup →+ ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_divisorClass
decls.statement:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_divisorClass (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    weightedDegreeClass w h (S.divisorClass D) = weightedDegree w D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.picZero
decls.doc:
The weighted-degree-zero part of the divisor class group, the abstract `Pic⁰` of the
Jacobian roadmap: the kernel of the weighted degree map on divisor classes.
decls.statement:
def picZero (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) :
    AddSubgroup S.ClassGroup

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.mem_picZero
decls.statement:
lemma mem_picZero (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {c : S.ClassGroup} :
    c ∈ picZero w h ↔ weightedDegreeClass w h c = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.divisorClass_mem_picZero
decls.doc:
The class of a Weil divisor lies in `picZero` exactly when that representative has weighted
degree zero; the value is well defined because the weighted degree descends to the class.
decls.statement:
lemma divisorClass_mem_picZero (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {D : WeilDivisor X} :
    S.divisorClass D ∈ picZero w h ↔ weightedDegree w D = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.IsUnweightedDegreeZero
decls.doc:
An order system has *unweighted-degree-zero principal divisors* when every principal
divisor has unweighted degree zero. This is the specialization of `IsWeightedDegreeZero` to the
constant weight `1`, appropriate for the algebraically closed/unweighted formal setting.
decls.statement: def IsUnweightedDegreeZero : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.IsUnweightedDegreeZero.principalSubgroup_le_ker
decls.statement:
lemma IsUnweightedDegreeZero.principalSubgroup_le_ker (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero) :
    S.principalSubgroup ≤ (degree : WeilDivisor X →+ ℤ).ker

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.unweightedDegreeClass
decls.doc:
The unweighted degree map on divisor classes, for the algebraically closed/unweighted
specialization: the descended degree `weightedDegreeClass` at the constant weight `1`. For
curves over a general field, use `weightedDegreeClass`.
decls.statement: def unweightedDegreeClass (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero) : S.ClassGroup →+ ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.unweightedDegreeClass_divisorClass
decls.statement:
lemma unweightedDegreeClass_divisorClass (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    unweightedDegreeClass h (S.divisorClass D) = degree D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalKernel
decls.doc:
The subgroup of functions whose principal divisor is zero.

In geometric applications this is the subgroup quotiented out before passing from rational
functions to principal divisors. Identifying it with constants requires additional geometric
input, such as a global-units or constant-field theorem.
decls.statement: abbrev principalKernel : AddSubgroup G

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.mem_principalKernel
decls.statement:
lemma mem_principalKernel {g : G} :
    g ∈ S.principalKernel ↔ S.principalDivisor g = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.mem_principalKernel_iff_forall_ord_eq_zero
decls.doc: A function has zero principal divisor exactly when all of its orders vanish.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_principalKernel_iff_forall_ord_eq_zero {g : G} :
    g ∈ S.principalKernel ↔ ∀ x, S.ord x g = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.zero_mem_principalKernel
decls.statement: lemma zero_mem_principalKernel : (0 : G) ∈ S.principalKernel

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalKernel_eq_bot_iff
decls.statement:
lemma principalKernel_eq_bot_iff :
    S.principalKernel = ⊥ ↔ Function.Injective S.principalHom

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalHom_injective_of_principalKernel_eq_bot
decls.doc:
If the only function with zero principal divisor is zero, the principal-divisor map is
injective.
decls.statement:
lemma principalHom_injective_of_principalKernel_eq_bot (h : S.principalKernel = ⊥) :
    Function.Injective S.principalHom

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalKernel_eq_bot_of_principalHom_injective
decls.doc: An injective principal-divisor map has trivial kernel.
decls.statement:
lemma principalKernel_eq_bot_of_principalHom_injective
    (h : Function.Injective S.principalHom) : S.principalKernel = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.PrincipalFunctionClass
decls.doc:
The quotient of the function group by functions with zero principal divisor.

In geometric applications this is the group of rational functions modulo the subgroup with
zero principal divisor. Under further hypotheses identifying that subgroup with the base-field
constants, it specializes to the usual rational-functions-modulo-constants group.
decls.statement: abbrev PrincipalFunctionClass : Type _

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalFunctionClassDivisor
decls.doc:
The principal divisor associated to a function class, as a homomorphism into all Weil
divisors.
decls.statement: def principalFunctionClassDivisor : S.PrincipalFunctionClass →+ WeilDivisor X

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalFunctionClassDivisor_mk
decls.statement:
lemma principalFunctionClassDivisor_mk (g : G) :
    S.principalFunctionClassDivisor (QuotientAddGroup.mk g) = S.principalDivisor g

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalFunctionClassDivisor_injective
decls.doc: The map from function classes to principal divisors is injective.
decls.statement:
lemma principalFunctionClassDivisor_injective :
    Function.Injective S.principalFunctionClassDivisor

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalFunctionClassDivisor_mem_principalSubgroup
decls.doc: Every divisor attached to a function class is principal.
decls.statement:
lemma principalFunctionClassDivisor_mem_principalSubgroup (q : S.PrincipalFunctionClass) :
    S.principalFunctionClassDivisor q ∈ S.principalSubgroup

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalFunctionClassDivisor_range
decls.doc:
The image of function classes in all Weil divisors is exactly the subgroup of principal
divisors.
decls.statement:
lemma principalFunctionClassDivisor_range :
    S.principalFunctionClassDivisor.range = S.principalSubgroup

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalFunctionClassEquivPrincipalSubgroup
decls.doc:
The quotient of functions by the zero-principal-divisor subgroup is canonically equivalent
to the subgroup of principal divisors.
decls.statement:
def principalFunctionClassEquivPrincipalSubgroup :
    S.PrincipalFunctionClass ≃+ S.principalSubgroup

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalFunctionClassEquivPrincipalSubgroup_mk
decls.statement:
lemma principalFunctionClassEquivPrincipalSubgroup_mk (g : G) :
    S.principalFunctionClassEquivPrincipalSubgroup (QuotientAddGroup.mk g) =
      ⟨S.principalDivisor g, S.principalDivisor_mem_principalSubgroup g⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.coe_principalFunctionClassEquivPrincipalSubgroup
decls.statement:
lemma coe_principalFunctionClassEquivPrincipalSubgroup (q : S.PrincipalFunctionClass) :
    ((S.principalFunctionClassEquivPrincipalSubgroup q : S.principalSubgroup) : WeilDivisor X) =
      S.principalFunctionClassDivisor q

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalFunctionClassDivisor_eq_zero_iff
decls.statement:
lemma principalFunctionClassDivisor_eq_zero_iff {q : S.PrincipalFunctionClass} :
    S.principalFunctionClassDivisor q = 0 ↔ q = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalDivisor_eq_iff_mk_eq_mk
decls.doc: Equality of principal divisors is equality of the corresponding function classes.
decls.statement:
lemma principalDivisor_eq_iff_mk_eq_mk {g h : G} :
    S.principalDivisor g = S.principalDivisor h ↔
      QuotientAddGroup.mk g = (QuotientAddGroup.mk h : S.PrincipalFunctionClass)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.mk_eq_mk_iff_principalDivisor_eq
decls.doc:
Two functions define the same class modulo the zero-principal-divisor subgroup exactly when
their principal divisors are equal.
decls.statement:
lemma mk_eq_mk_iff_principalDivisor_eq {g h : G} :
    QuotientAddGroup.mk g = (QuotientAddGroup.mk h : S.PrincipalFunctionClass) ↔
      S.principalDivisor g = S.principalDivisor h

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.mk_eq_zero_iff_principalDivisor_eq_zero
decls.doc: A function class is zero exactly when the representative has zero principal divisor.
decls.statement:
lemma mk_eq_zero_iff_principalDivisor_eq_zero {g : G} :
    (QuotientAddGroup.mk g : S.PrincipalFunctionClass) = 0 ↔ S.principalDivisor g = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.CodimensionOnePoint
decls.doc: A codimension-one point of a scheme. Such a point is the generic point of a prime divisor.
decls.statement: abbrev CodimensionOnePoint (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor
decls.doc: A Weil divisor on a scheme is a finite formal integer sum of its codimension-one points.
decls.statement: abbrev SchemeWeilDivisor (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.algebraicCycleOfFinsupp
decls.doc: Regard a finitely supported function as an algebraic cycle.
decls.statement: def algebraicCycleOfFinsupp : (X →₀ ℤ) →+ AlgebraicCycle X ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.algebraicCycleOfFinsupp_apply
decls.statement:
lemma algebraicCycleOfFinsupp_apply (D : X →₀ ℤ) (x : X) :
    algebraicCycleOfFinsupp D x = D x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.toAlgebraicCycle
decls.doc:
Extend a scheme-theoretic Weil divisor by zero away from codimension one, obtaining
an algebraic cycle on the underlying scheme.
decls.statement: def toAlgebraicCycle : SchemeWeilDivisor X →+ AlgebraicCycle X ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.toAlgebraicCycle_apply
decls.doc: Extension by zero preserves the coefficient at a codimension-one point.
decls.statement:
lemma toAlgebraicCycle_apply (D : SchemeWeilDivisor X) (x : CodimensionOnePoint X) :
    toAlgebraicCycle D x = D x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.toAlgebraicCycle_apply_of_coheight_ne_one
decls.doc: Extension by zero vanishes at points whose codimension is not one.
decls.statement:
lemma toAlgebraicCycle_apply_of_coheight_ne_one (D : SchemeWeilDivisor X) (x : X)
    (hx : coheight x ≠ 1) :
    toAlgebraicCycle D x = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.support_toAlgebraicCycle
decls.doc:
The support of a scheme-theoretic Weil divisor viewed as an algebraic cycle is the image of
its finite support under the inclusion of codimension-one points.
decls.statement:
lemma support_toAlgebraicCycle (D : SchemeWeilDivisor X) :
    (toAlgebraicCycle D).support =
      Subtype.val '' (D.support : Set (CodimensionOnePoint X))

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.finite_support_toAlgebraicCycle
decls.doc: A scheme-theoretic Weil divisor has finite support when regarded as an algebraic cycle.
decls.statement:
lemma finite_support_toAlgebraicCycle (D : SchemeWeilDivisor X) :
    (toAlgebraicCycle D).support.Finite

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.coheight_eq_one_of_mem_support_toAlgebraicCycle
decls.doc: The cycle associated to a scheme-theoretic Weil divisor is supported in codimension one.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.toAlgebraicCycle_injective
decls.doc: Extension by zero embeds scheme-theoretic Weil divisors into algebraic cycles.
decls.statement:
lemma toAlgebraicCycle_injective :
    Function.Injective (toAlgebraicCycle : SchemeWeilDivisor X → AlgebraicCycle X ℤ)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.toAlgebraicCycle_inj
decls.doc:
Two scheme-theoretic Weil divisors have the same associated cycle exactly when they are
equal.
decls.statement:
lemma toAlgebraicCycle_inj {D E : SchemeWeilDivisor X} :
    toAlgebraicCycle D = toAlgebraicCycle E ↔ D = E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.finiteCodimensionOneCycles
decls.doc: Algebraic cycles with finite support contained in codimension one.
decls.statement: def finiteCodimensionOneCycles (X : Scheme.{u}) : AddSubgroup (AlgebraicCycle X ℤ)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.mem_finiteCodimensionOneCycles_iff
decls.doc:
Membership in `finiteCodimensionOneCycles` means finite support contained in codimension
one.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_finiteCodimensionOneCycles_iff {C : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ} :
    C ∈ finiteCodimensionOneCycles X ↔
      C.support.Finite ∧ ∀ x ∈ C.support, coheight x = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.ofFiniteCodimensionOneCycle
decls.doc: Restrict a finite codimension-one cycle to its codimension-one points.
decls.statement:
def ofFiniteCodimensionOneCycle (C : finiteCodimensionOneCycles X) :
    SchemeWeilDivisor X

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.ofFiniteCodimensionOneCycle_apply
decls.statement:
lemma ofFiniteCodimensionOneCycle_apply
    (C : finiteCodimensionOneCycles X) (x : CodimensionOnePoint X) :
    ofFiniteCodimensionOneCycle C x = C.1 x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.equivFiniteCodimensionOneCycles
decls.doc:
Scheme-theoretic Weil divisors are additively equivalent to the finite algebraic cycles
supported entirely in codimension one.
decls.statement:
def equivFiniteCodimensionOneCycles :
    SchemeWeilDivisor X ≃+ finiteCodimensionOneCycles X

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.coe_equivFiniteCodimensionOneCycles_apply
decls.doc: The forward direction of `equivFiniteCodimensionOneCycles` is extension by zero.
decls.statement:
lemma coe_equivFiniteCodimensionOneCycles_apply (D : SchemeWeilDivisor X) :
    ((equivFiniteCodimensionOneCycles D : finiteCodimensionOneCycles X) :
      AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) =
      toAlgebraicCycle D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.equivFiniteCodimensionOneCycles_symm_apply_apply
decls.doc:
The inverse of `equivFiniteCodimensionOneCycles` recovers coefficients by restriction to
codimension-one points.
decls.statement:
lemma equivFiniteCodimensionOneCycles_symm_apply_apply
    (C : finiteCodimensionOneCycles X) (x : CodimensionOnePoint X) :
    equivFiniteCodimensionOneCycles.symm C x = C.1 x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.relativeDegree
decls.doc: The degree of a scheme-theoretic Weil divisor weighted by the residue degrees of `f`.
decls.statement: def relativeDegree (f : X ⟶ Y) : SchemeWeilDivisor X →+ ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.relativeDegree_apply
decls.doc: The relative degree is the finite sum of coefficients times residue degrees.
decls.statement:
lemma relativeDegree_apply (f : X ⟶ Y) (D : SchemeWeilDivisor X) :
    relativeDegree f D = D.sum fun x n ↦ n * (f.residueDegree x : ℤ)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.relativeDegree_ofPoint
decls.doc: A prime divisor has relative degree equal to the residue degree of its generic point.
decls.statement:
lemma relativeDegree_ofPoint (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : CodimensionOnePoint X) :
    relativeDegree f (WeilDivisor.ofPoint x) = (f.residueDegree x : ℤ)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.relativeDegree_comp
decls.doc: Relative degree along a composite uses the product of the successive residue degrees.
decls.statement:
lemma relativeDegree_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (D : SchemeWeilDivisor X) :
    relativeDegree (f ≫ g) D =
      WeilDivisor.weightedDegree
        (fun x : CodimensionOnePoint X ↦
          (g.residueDegree (f x) : ℤ) * f.residueDegree x) D

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.orderAt
decls.doc:
The order of a nonzero rational function at a codimension-one point, as an additive
homomorphism from the additive form of the unit group of the function field.
decls.statement:
def orderAt (x : CodimensionOnePoint X) :
    Additive (X.functionFieldˣ) →+ ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeWeilDivisor.orderAt_apply
decls.doc: Evaluating `orderAt` gives Mathlib's integer-valued order of vanishing.
decls.statement:
lemma orderAt_apply (x : CodimensionOnePoint X) (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) :
    orderAt x f = X.ord ((Additive.toMul f : X.functionFieldˣ) : X.functionField) x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.exists_sup
decls.statement:
lemma exists_sup (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    ∃ F : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X (degree ((D : WeilDivisor X) ⊔ E)).toNat,
      (F : WeilDivisor X) = (D : WeilDivisor X) ⊔ E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.sup
decls.doc:
The union of two fixed-degree effective divisors.

Its underlying Weil divisor is the pointwise maximum `D ⊔ E`; its degree index is the actual
degree of that maximum.
decls.statement:
def sup (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X (degree ((D : WeilDivisor X) ⊔ E)).toNat

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_sup
decls.statement:
lemma coe_sup (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (sup D E : WeilDivisor X) = (D : WeilDivisor X) ⊔ E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coeff_sup
decls.doc: The coefficient of the union is the maximum of the two coefficients.
decls.statement:
lemma coeff_sup (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e)
    (x : X) :
    coeff (sup D E : WeilDivisor X) x =
      coeff (D : WeilDivisor X) x ⊔ coeff (E : WeilDivisor X) x

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.multiplicityFinsupp_sup
decls.doc: The multiplicity function of the union is the pointwise maximum of multiplicities.
decls.statement:
lemma multiplicityFinsupp_sup (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (sup D E).multiplicityFinsupp = D.multiplicityFinsupp ⊔ E.multiplicityFinsupp

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.equivSym_sup
decls.doc:
The symmetric-power representative of the union is the pointwise maximum of multiplicity
functions.
decls.statement:
lemma equivSym_sup (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    equivSym (sup D E) =
      (letI := Classical.decEq X;
        (Sym.equivNatSum X (degree ((D : WeilDivisor X) ⊔ E)).toNat).symm
          ⟨D.multiplicityFinsupp ⊔ E.multiplicityFinsupp, by
            rw [← multiplicityFinsupp_sup D E]
            exact (sup D E).sum_multiplicityFinsupp⟩)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.le_sup_left
decls.doc: The left input divisor lies below the union.
decls.statement:
lemma le_sup_left (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (D : WeilDivisor X) ≤ sup D E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.le_sup_right
decls.doc: The right input divisor lies below the union.
decls.statement:
lemma le_sup_right (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (E : WeilDivisor X) ≤ sup D E

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.sup_le
decls.doc: Any Weil divisor above both inputs lies above their union.
decls.statement:
lemma sup_le {F : WeilDivisor X} {D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d}
    {E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e} (hDF : (D : WeilDivisor X) ≤ F)
    (hEF : (E : WeilDivisor X) ≤ F) :
    (sup D E : WeilDivisor X) ≤ F

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.sup_eq_left
decls.doc: The union is the left input exactly when the right input is below the left input.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.sup_eq_right
decls.doc: The union is the right input exactly when the left input is below the right input.

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.sup_comm
decls.doc: The union is symmetric in its inputs, up to the natural degree-index cast.
decls.statement:
lemma sup_comm (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    sup D E =
      EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast (by rw [_root_.sup_comm]) (sup E D)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.left_le_degree_sup
decls.doc: The left degree index is bounded above by the degree of the union.
decls.statement:
lemma left_le_degree_sup (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    d ≤ (degree ((D : WeilDivisor X) ⊔ E)).toNat

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.right_le_degree_sup
decls.doc: The right degree index is bounded above by the degree of the union.
decls.statement:
lemma right_le_degree_sup (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    e ≤ (degree ((D : WeilDivisor X) ⊔ E)).toNat

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.degree_inf_toNat_add_degree_sup_toNat
decls.doc:
Inclusion–exclusion on the degree indices: the degrees of the common part and the union
sum to `d + e`.
decls.statement:
lemma degree_inf_toNat_add_degree_sup_toNat (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (degree ((D : WeilDivisor X) ⊓ E)).toNat + (degree ((D : WeilDivisor X) ⊔ E)).toNat =
      d + e

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.degree_sup_toNat
decls.doc: The degree of the union is `d + e` minus the degree of the common part.
decls.statement:
lemma degree_sup_toNat (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (degree ((D : WeilDivisor X) ⊔ E)).toNat =
      d + e - (degree ((D : WeilDivisor X) ⊓ E)).toNat

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.inf_add_sup
decls.doc:
Inclusion–exclusion for fixed-degree effective divisors: the common part plus the union
recover the sum of the two divisors, up to the natural degree-index cast.
decls.statement:
lemma inf_add_sup (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    add (inf D E) (sup D E) =
      EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast
        (degree_inf_toNat_add_degree_sup_toNat D E).symm (add D E)

decls.name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.sup_add_inf
decls.doc:
The union plus the common part also recover the sum of the two divisors, up to the natural
degree-index cast.
decls.statement:
lemma sup_add_inf (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    add (sup D E) (inf D E) =
      EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast
        (by have := degree_inf_toNat_add_degree_sup_toNat D E; omega)
        (add D E)
